entry.summary: Shows weak-to-strong preference learning fails under zero-shot distribution shift, with strong students overfitting to source-domain features. Proposes Representation Anchoring as a regularizer to maintain transferable preference representations.

entry.title: Machine Learning Multiscale Interactions

author.name: \`Alex Sol\'e, Sergio Su\'arez-Dou, Albert Mosella-Montoro, Silvia G\'omez-Coca, Eliseo Ruiz, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Javier Ruiz-Hidalgo

entry.summary: MuSE introduces Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling for ML force fields, enabling hierarchical multiscale modeling that captures long-range many-body effects missed by standard message-passing. Architecture-agnostic and tested with SO3krates, MACE, and PaiNN.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Systems are Mixtures of Experts: Who Becomes an Influencer?

author.name: Franka Bause, Jonas Niederle, Martin Pawelczyk, Rebekka Burkholz

entry.summary: Frames multi-agent LLM systems through Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics, showing FJ parameters are input-dependent which makes multi-agent deliberation a mixture-of-experts. Analyzes when multi-agent systems outperform single agents.

entry.title: Faithful or Fabricated? A Causal Framework for Rationalization Bias in LLM Judges

author.name: Riya Tapwal, Abhishek Kumar, Carsten Maple

entry.summary: Introduces DRinQ-like cue-invariance tests for LLM judges, with perturbations like Blind, Truth, Flip, Placebo to detect rationale anchoring, label-aligned rhetoric, and explanation drift. Reveals fabricated rationalizations in LLM-as-judge evaluations.

entry.title: AERIC: Anticipatory Hidden-State Monitoring for Implicit Harmful Dialogue

author.name: Jihyung Park, Saleh Afroogh, Junfeng Jiao

entry.summary: AERIC uses hidden-state monitoring during decoding to anticipate implicit harmful drift before overt toxic text is generated, providing same-pass lightweight safety monitoring. Targets implicit harm not captured by response-level guards.

entry.title: WhenLoss: Diagnosing Write and Retrieval Bottlenecks in Long-Context Memory Systems

author.name: Jiangnan Yu, Kisson Songqi Lin, Jilong Wu

entry.summary: WhenLoss provides a four-condition diagnostic (TFC, OE, CSM, RM) for long-context memory systems showing write-side gaps exceed retrieval-side gaps in most baselines. Proposes Expected Predictive Compression to push retention decisions to write time using an LLM.

entry.title: Quantifying the Impact of Translation Errors on Multilingual LLM Evaluation

author.name: Klaudia-Doris Thellmann, Bernhard Stadler, Michael F\"arber, Jens Lehmann

entry.summary: Quantifies how much translation errors in machine-translated multilingual benchmarks explain LLM accuracy drops, comparing MQM-style LLM judge spans against expert annotations. Finds target-side translation errors significantly contribute to apparent multilingual gaps.

entry.title: NITP: Next Implicit Token Prediction for LLM Pre-training

author.name: Xiangdong Zhang, Debing Zhang, Shaofeng Zhang, Xiaohan Qin, Yu Cheng, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: NITP augments standard next-token prediction with dense continuous supervision in latent space, training the model to predict the implicit semantic content of the next token using shallow-layer representations as self-supervised targets.

entry.title: Knowing but Not Showing: LLMs Recognize Ambiguity but Rarely Ask Clarifying Questions

author.name: Jinyan Su, Claire Cardie

entry.summary: Demonstrates a gap between LLMs recognizing ambiguity and actually behaving accordingly, finding that models can judge queries as ambiguous but still answer directly rather than asking clarifying questions.

entry.title: Tool-Call Dependency Structure is Linearly Decodable in LLM Agent Residual Streams

author.name: Tianda Sun, Dimitar Kazakov

entry.summary: Shows that tool-call dependency graph structure is linearly decodable from Qwen3-32B residual streams, with the signal tracking abstract topology rather than identifier values via counterfactual analysis.

entry.title: Is Inference Mediated by Distinct Semantic Structures in LLMs? A Mechanistic Interpretation

author.name: Nura Aljaafari, Marco Valentino, Andr\'e Freitas

entry.summary: Mechanistic interpretability study using SVD-derived subspaces and activation steering to show that semantic operations in NLI are encoded in partially distinct latent subspaces rather than just label-level features.

entry.title: Selective Latent Thinking: Adaptive Compression of LLM Reasoning Chains

author.name: Hui Xie, Jie Liu, Ziyue Qiao, Joaquin Vanschore

entry.summary: Selective Latent Thinking compresses redundant reasoning spans into latent representations while preserving precision-critical spans as explicit chain-of-thought, using a lightweight decoder to anticipate upcoming reasoning.

entry.title: When Do LLM Agents Treat Surface Noise Differently from Semantic Noise? A 68-Cell Measurement Study with a Held-Out Trace-Level Validation

author.name: Liyun Zhang, Jiayi Guo

entry.summary: 68-cell measurement study across 10 LLMs from 7 architecture families showing that meaning-bearing perturbations alter agent answers more often than presentation perturbations with an average +19.69pp gap that survives multiple severity audits.

entry.title: What Makes a Medical Checker Trainable? Diagnosing Signal Collapse and Reward Hacking in Checker-Guided RAG for Biomedical QA

author.name: Yuelyu Ji, Min Gu Kwak, Hang Zhang, Xizhi Wu, Chenyu Li, Yanshan Wan

entry.summary: Diagnoses that NLI checker training-time output distribution (not held-out accuracy) determines gradient quality in checker-guided RAG, with LLM log-probability scoring causing signal collapse via 97% neutral labels.

entry.title: DUEL: Adversarial Self-Play for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Lin Qiu, Hanqing Zeng, Yao Liu, Bingjun Sun, Guangdeng Liao, Ji Liu

entry.summary: DUEL is a self-evolving adversarial post-training framework for VLMs where a Challenger generates image-grounded true claims with hard-negative perturbations and a Solver verifies both against the image, removing need for costly annotations.

entry.title: STORM: Internalized Modeling for Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models

author.name: Yiming Liang, Yixiao Chen, Yiyang Zhou, Yixuan Wang, Shoubin Yu, Andong Deng, Fuxiao Liu, Qin Zhang, Chen Chen, Mohit Bansal, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: STORMS is a two-stage framework that teaches LVLMs to perform spatial-temporal reasoning internally rather than externalizing it through textual chain-of-thought or keyframe selection. Aims to reduce inference latency while maintaining video reasoning quality.

entry.title: VideoOdyssey: A Benchmark for Ultra-Long-Context and Omni-Modal Video Understanding

author.name: Haichen He, Jiayi Zhou, Sifeng Shang, Yihan Hu, Yuanhan Zhang, Kaiyang Zhou

entry.summary: VideoOdyssey benchmarks ultra-long-context video understanding, introducing continuous certificate length as a metric for cognitive load. Targets the gap where existing long-video benchmarks still only require short-segment comprehension.

entry.title: DRIVESPATIAL: A Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Intelligence in VLMs for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Hao Vo, Khoa Vo, Phu Loc Nguyen, Sieu Tran, Duc Minh Nguyen, Ngo Xuan Cuong, Gladys Gawugah, Sreevenkata Anjani Tishita Godavarthi, Chase Rainwater, Nghi D. Q. Bui, Anh Nguyen, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Ngan Le

entry.summary: DriveSpatial is a benchmark with 15.6K human-verified QA pairs evaluating VLM spatiotemporal intelligence for autonomous driving across multi-view, dynamic scenes. Evaluates four key abilities including cognitive scene construction and future dynamics reasoning.

entry.title: DFSAttn: Dynamic Fine-grained Sparse Attention for Efficient Video Generation

author.name: Jie Hu, Zixiang Gao, Yutong He, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: DFSAttn proposes dynamic fine-grained sparse attention for video diffusion transformers, deriving a theoretical lower bound on attention recall to guide design. Addresses quality degradation in existing block sparse attention at high sparsity ratios.

entry.title: VINS-120K: Ultra High-Resolution Image Editing with A Large-Scale Dataset

author.name: Zhizhou Chen, Shanyan Guan, Zhanxin Gao, En Ci, Yanhao Ge, Wei Li, Zhenyu Zhang, Jian Yang, Ying Tai

entry.summary: VINS-120K is the first large-scale dataset for instruction-based ultra-high-resolution (>=4K) image editing with 120K curated triplets. Introduces a high-frequency-aware post-adaptation strategy and VINS-4KEval benchmark.

entry.title: Not Too Generative, Not Too Discriminative: The Human Alignment Sweet Spot

author.name: Jorge Chang Ortega, Bastien Le Lan, Thomas Serre, Victor Boutin

entry.summary: Uses Joint Energy-Based Models to interpolate between discriminative and generative training within a fixed architecture, isolating learning objective effects on human visual alignment. Finds an intermediate sweet spot best matches human perception.

entry.title: PGT: Procedurally Generated Tasks for improving visual grounding in MLLMs

author.name: Rim Assouel, Amir Bar, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero-Soriano

entry.summary: PGT overlays geometric primitives on images to create procedurally generated tasks for training MLLMs on fine-grained visual grounding, also acting as a diagnostic for perception failures. From Meta FAIR-affiliated authors.

entry.title: GenRecon: Bridging Generative Priors for Multi-View 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Katharina Schmid, Nicolas von L\"utzow, Jozef Hladk\'y, Angela Dai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner

entry.summary: GenRecon couples multi-view 3D reconstruction with strong generative priors (Trellis.2) using projection-based conditioning over spatial chunks. From Niessner/Dai TUM group.

entry.title: Precise: SDE-Consistent Stochastic Sampling for RL Post-Training of Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Jade Zou, Tao Huang, Weijie Kong, Junzhe Li, Yue Wu, Qi Tian, Jiangfeng Xiong, Jianwei Zhang, Liefeng Bo, Zhao Zhong

entry.summary: Precise analyzes the design of stochastic samplers as part of the policy in RL post-training of flow-matching models, decomposing exploration choice and SDE discretization. Authors include Tencent/Hunyuan team.

entry.title: MuGen: Multi-Skill Generative Locomotion Controller for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Yusen Feng, Xiang Wang, Heyuan Yao, Zixi Kang, Xinyu Huo, Boyang Yu, Pengyun Qiu, Ruijie Zhao, Baoquan Chen, Libin Liu

entry.summary: MuGen learns multi-skill humanoid locomotion via VQ-VAE-based generative motion representation trained with model-based RL and distilled to a deployable policy.

entry.title: FOUND-IT: Foundation-model-first Task-driven 3D Scene Graphs with Granularity on Demand

author.name: Dominic Maggio, Nicolas Gorlo, Luca Carlone

entry.summary: Presents the first real-time hierarchical task-driven 3D scene graph approach using uncalibrated monocular cameras, leveraging geometric foundation models like VGGT with task-adaptive granularity. Notable work from Luca Carlone's lab at MIT.

entry.title: Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models

author.name: Noam Michael, Daniel BenShushan, Jacob Bien, Don A. Moore

entry.summary: A preregistered study finds LLMs exhibit a human-like hard-easy effect in confidence calibration: overconfidence on hard tasks, underconfidence on easy ones. The authors introduce LifeEval, a benchmark for evaluating calibration across difficulty levels.

entry.title: LGMT: Logic-Grounded Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating the Reasoning Reliability of LLMs

author.name: Zenghui Zhou, Man Li, Xiaoke Fang, Xinyi Zhou, Weibin Li, Zheng Zheng

entry.summary: LGMT uses first-order logic equivalences to generate metamorphic test cases for LLM reasoning, detecting defects through consistency checks without oracle labels. Reveals hidden defects on six SOTA LLMs.

entry.title: Identifying and Mitigating Systemic Measurement Bias in Production LLM Inference Benchmarks

author.name: Ashok Chandrasekar, Jason Kramberger

entry.summary: Identifies that widely-used Python asyncio LLM benchmarking clients introduce M/G/1 queuing bias inflating TTFT and TPOT measurements due to the GIL. Proposes a corrected benchmarking architecture.

entry.title: Beyond Final Answers: Auditing Trajectory-Level Hallucinations in Multi-Agent Industrial Workflows

author.name: Harshada Badave, Santosh Borse, Andrea Gomez, Harshitha Narahari, Sara Carter, Vishwa Bhatt, Aishani Rachakonda, Shuxin Lin, Dhaval Patel

entry.summary: Trajel introduces a trajectory-level hallucination taxonomy and dataset for multi-agent industrial workflows, finding common failure modes are missed by output-only evaluation. Covers five hallucination types.

entry.title: Beyond Inference-Only Deployment: Comparing Weight-Based Consolidation Against Cascading Compaction

author.name: Simon Dennis, Kevin Shabahang, Hao Guo, Rivaan Patil

entry.summary: Compares nightly LoRA-based weight consolidation of conversational knowledge against context-based memory under cascading compaction, showing 36.8% retention for compaction across three cycles in dev workflows.

entry.title: Emotional intelligence in large language models is fragmented across perception, cognition, and interaction

author.name: Minghao Lv, Lu Chen, Enchang Zhang, Anji Zhou, Xiaoran Xue, Hanyi Zhang, Fenghua Tang, Zhuo Rachel Han, Mengyue Wu

entry.summary: FACET is a psychometrically grounded emotional intelligence benchmark with 480 expert items based on Mayer-Salovey-Caruso four-branch ability model, finding LLM EI is fragmented across perception, cognition, and interaction.

entry.title: Energy Shields for Fairness

author.name: Filip Cano, Thomas A. Henzinger, Konstantin Kueffner

entry.summary: Energy shields are lightweight adaptive controllers using physics-inspired energy functions to enforce runtime fairness probabilistically and smoothly over sequences of decisions, rather than deterministic abrupt interventions.

entry.title: StructBreak: Structural Cognitive Overload-Induced Safety Failures in MLLMs

author.name: Yang Luo, Xinran Liu, Tiantian Ji, Zhiyi Yin, Lingyun Peng, Shuyu Li

entry.summary: StructBreak is an automated framework identifying Structural Cognitive Overload as a black-box higher-order attack paradigm against MLLMs, exploiting contention between deep reasoning and safety alignment to bypass guardrails.

entry.title: Momentum Streams for Optimizer-Inspired Transformers

author.name: Jingchu Gai, Nai-Chieh Huang, Jiayun Wu

entry.summary: Reinterprets Transformer residual updates as optimizer steps and builds optimizer-inspired Transformer variants (Adam, Muon, SOAP, triple-momentum). Triple-momentum TMMFormer achieves lowest validation loss in pretraining.

entry.title: Measuring the Depth of LLM Unlearning via Activation Patching

author.name: Jaeung Lee, Dohyun Kim, Jaemin Jo

entry.summary: Proposes Unlearning Depth Score, a metric using activation patching to quantify mechanistic depth of LLM unlearning beyond output-level checks. Identifies layers encoding target knowledge using retain-model baseline.

entry.title: Bilevel Optimization of Synthetic Trajectories for Multi-Turn LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Shresth Verma, Mauricio Tec, Cheol Woo Kim, Kai Wang, Milind Tambe

entry.summary: BOOST is a bilevel optimization framework for multi-turn LLM fine-tuning that learns trajectory-level weights for synthetic data using a held-out real validation set. Addresses heterogeneous synthetic trajectory quality.

entry.title: CausalFlow: Causal Attribution and Counterfactual Repair for LLM Agent Failures

author.name: Akash Bonagiri, Devang Borkar, Gerard Janno Anderias, Setareh Rafatirad, Houman Homayoun

entry.summary: CausalFlow analyzes LLM agent failures using counterfactual interventions to identify which steps caused failures, then generates minimally edited repairs to flip outcomes. Produces contrastive supervision pairs for improvement.

entry.title: Evo-Attacker: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool Attacks on LLM-MAS

author.name: Bingyu Yan, Xiaoming Zhang, Jinyu Hou, Chaozhuo Li, Ziyi Zhou, Yiming Hei, Litian Zhang

entry.summary: Evo-Attacker formulates LLM multi-agent tool attacks as self-evolving memory-augmented RL with deliberative reasoning. Introduces Attack-Flow GRPO to optimize intermediate reasoning steps in adversarial settings.

entry.title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation

author.name: Changyu Chen, Xiting Wang, Rui Yan

entry.summary: Investigates extreme off-policy RL for LLMs, finding aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid gains but causes entropy collapse and trajectory drift. Proposes Extreme Region Policy Distillation to balance the tradeoff.

entry.title: DRScaffold: Boosting Dense-Scene Reasoning in Lightweight Vision Language Models

author.name: Xinrui Shi, Kai Liu, Ziqing Zhang, Jianze Li, Anqi Li, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: DRScaffold improves dense-scene reasoning in lightweight VLMs with explicit grounding between reasoning steps and visual entities. Includes DRBench with 14,573 questions across 2,943 images.

entry.title: OrpQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization

author.name: Maoyang Xiang, Bo Wang, Tao Luo

entry.summary: OrpQuant uses geometric orthogonal residual projection for multiplier-free power-of-two transformer quantization. Targets sub-4-bit edge deployment of LLMs and ViTs.

entry.title: RL with Learnable Textual Feedback: A Bilevel Approach

author.name: Utsav Singh, Sidhaarth Sredharan, Souradip Chakraborty, Amrit Singh Bedi

entry.summary: Bilevel approach to RL with learnable textual feedback where critic feedback must demonstrably improve actor policy when provided in context, not just be correct.

entry.title: Scene Reconstruction as Mapping Priors for 3D Detection

author.name: Yang Fu, Yuliang Zou, Hao Xiang, Xin Huang, Yijing Bai, Chen Song, Weijing Shi, Govind Thattai, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan, Yingwei Li

entry.summary: Proposes automatically building dense mapping priors from aggregated data to improve 3D object detection in autonomous driving, avoiding expensive HD map maintenance. Demonstrates how scene reconstruction can serve as a robust structural prior for perception.

entry.title: The TIME Machine: On The Power of Motion for Efficient Perception

author.name: Mantas Skackauskas, Xinyue Hao, Laura Sevilla-Lara

entry.summary: Proposes using motion (point tracks) as a central modality for video representation learning, addressing temporal understanding weaknesses in language-trained video models. Aims to reduce reliance on language captions which limit conceptual coverage.

entry.title: IntentionNav: A Benchmark for Intent-Driven Object Navigation from Implicit Human Instruction

author.name: Lin Qian, Shijie Li, Sihao Lin, Xuan Zhang, Bangya Liu, Yanran Li, Hujun Yin

entry.summary: IntentionNav is a benchmark for intent-driven object navigation where agents must infer target objects from implicit human instructions like wanting to warm food. Contains 500 intents across 176 Isaac Sim scenes and 64 target categories.

entry.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering

author.name: Mingfang Zhang, Jingjing Pan, Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Mustafa Erdogan, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, Quan Kong

entry.summary: CaST-Bench evaluates causal chain-grounded spatio-temporal video reasoning in VLMs with 2,066 questions requiring identification and localization of causal evidence chains across video. Built through a human-AI collaborative pipeline with temporal segment annotations.

entry.title: ChainFlow-VLA: Causal Flow Planning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiyang Wang, Xinlin Wang, Tingguang Zhou, Gong Chen, Xingtai Gui, Zhi Xu, Xiaolei Wu, Feiyang Tan, Hangning Zhou, Mu Yang

entry.summary: ChainFlow-VLA proposes causal flow planning combining autoregressive temporal causal reasoning with diffusion-style global trajectory optimization for autonomous driving. Aims to unify causal modeling and global optimization within a single trajectory distribution.

entry.title: One-Forcing: Towards Stable One-Step Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Jiaqi Feng, Justin Cui, Yuanhao Ban, Cho-Jui Hsieh

entry.summary: One-Forcing addresses one-step autoregressive video generation stability, augmenting Self-Forcing-style DMD approaches to mitigate quality degradation when reducing sampling steps. Targets the practical latency bottleneck of 4-step generation.

entry.title: B-GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation

author.name: Mario Markov (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"), Stefan Maria Ailuro (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"), Mohammad Mahdi (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"), Luc Van Gool (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"), Danda Pani Paudel (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski")

entry.summary: B-GRTO extends Group Relative Policy Optimization to optimize trainable tools (e.g., segmentation decoders) within RL frameworks for referring segmentation. Bridges differentiable tool training with RL-based VLM reasoning.

entry.title: DualMem: Bypassing the Objectness Bottleneck for Calibrated Unknown-Stream Filtering in Open-World Object Detection

author.name: Yingjun Xiao (a), Xi Chen (b), Gang Fang (c), Siyuan Chen (b)

entry.summary: DualMem identifies that the unknown prediction streams of OWOD detectors are heavily polluted by background false positives due to an objectness bottleneck. Shows that linear probes on decoder queries achieve high AUROC while the final scalar objectness drops sharply.

entry.title: LaMo: Self-Supervised Latent Motion Priors for Physical Realism in Video Generation

author.name: Bo Jiang, Depu Meng, Yihan Hu, Yichen Xie, Tianshuo Xu, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: LaMo extracts self-supervised motion priors from unlabeled videos used to train diffusion models, exposed via Motion Drift Loss and Motion Prior Guidance to improve physical consistency without external simulators.

entry.title: Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation for Real-Time Robot Control Using Diffusion Models

author.name: Lei Zheng, Peiqi Yu, Zengqi Peng, Changliu Liu, Armin Lederer

entry.summary: Distills multi-step diffusion planners into a single forward pass via a Factorized Dynamic Koopman layer, enabling real-time closed-loop control while preserving multimodal expressivity.

entry.title: X-DiffVLA: X-Embodied Diffusion Action Heads for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Boyu Li, Chaoyi Xu, Haoqi Yuan, Xinrun Xu, B\"orje F. Karlsson, Dongbin Zhao, Haoran Li, Zongqing Lu

entry.summary: X-DiffVLA is a diffusion-based VLA model with a unified cross-embodied action head for shared bases with heterogeneous end-effectors, enabling cross-embodiment generalization.

entry.title: VisAnalog: A Diagnostic Suite for Visual Concept Transfer on Natural Images

author.name: Zhaonan Li, Kyle R. Chickering, Bangzheng Li, Jacob Dineen, Xiao Ye, Zhikun Xu, Shijie Lu, Yuxi Huang, Ming Shen, Bach Nguyen, Jaya Adithya Pavuluri, Mau Son Nguyen, Sanika Chavan, Ngoc Minh Thu Le, Muhao Chen, Ben Zhou

entry.summary: VisAnalog tests visual concept transfer on natural images through analogy-style questions where models must preserve and manipulate concept-level properties under transformations. Contains 617 human-validated multi-step transformation questions.

entry.title: VDE: Training-Free Accelerating Rectified Flow Model via Velocity Decomposition and Estimation

author.name: Junwen Tan, Jinglin Liang, Hongyuan Chen, Shuangping Huang

entry.summary: VDE is a training-free acceleration method for rectified flow models that decomposes velocity into parallel and orthogonal components for input-adaptive estimation. Shifts from caching-reusing to decomposing-estimating to maintain fidelity.

entry.title: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning

author.name: Xirui Liu, Sihang Zhou, Yanning Hou, Rong Zhou, Haoyuan Chen, Maolin He, Siwei Wang, Hao Chen, Jian Huang

entry.summary: DRIVE separates web agent skills into reasoning (transferable across sites) and interaction (site-specific) levels for continual learning. Addresses the dilemma between generalization and executability.

entry.title: QUIVER: A Formal Framework for Quantifying Perturbation Propagation and Bifurcation in Compound AI Systems

author.name: Prashanti Nilayam, Sankalp Nayak

entry.summary: QUIVER formalizes how perturbations propagate through compound AI systems built as directed LLM call graphs, defining sensitivity matrices, trajectory divergence, and bifurcation analysis. Provides quantitative reliability tools.

entry.title: LC-ERD: Mining Latent Logic for Self-Evolving Reasoning via Consistency-Regulated Reward Decomposition

author.name: Yanyu Chen, Jiyue Jiang, Dianzhi Yu, Zheng Wu, Jiahong Liu, Jiaming Han, Xiao Guo, Jinhu Qi, Yu Li, Yifei Zhang, Irwin King

entry.summary: LC-ERD introduces logic-consistent endogenous reward decomposition to provide fine-grained supervision for self-evolving LLM reasoning, addressing label noise, sparse rewards, and distributional collapse.

entry.title: MAPLE: Multi-State Aggregated Policy Evaluation for AlphaZero in Imperfect-Information Games

author.name: Qian-Rong Li, Hung Guei, I-Chen Wu, Ti-Rong Wu

entry.summary: MAPLE aggregates policy and value evaluations from multiple sampled world states in a single search tree for AlphaZero-style training in imperfect-information games. Combines PIMC and IS-MCTS advantages.

entry.title: HyperGuide: Hyperbolic Guidance for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuyu Liu, Haotian Xu, Yanan He, Sarang Rajendra Patil, Mengjia Xu, Tengfei Ma

entry.summary: HyperGuide uses hyperbolic geometric signals to guide step-by-step LLM reasoning, exploiting the asymmetry between exponentially numerous dead ends and few solution-bearing states. Improves efficiency over tree search.

entry.title: Benchmarking the Limits of In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Ad-Hoc Teamwork

author.name: Yuheng Jing, Kai Li, Ziwen Zhang, Jiajun Zhang, Zeyao Ma, Jiaxi Yang, Lei Zhang, Zhe Wu, Jinmin He, Junliang Xing, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: ICRL4AHT benchmarks in-context RL algorithms for ad-hoc teamwork using a high-throughput JAX Overcooked-V2 implementation with diverse teammate suites. Tests adaptation to unknown partners.

entry.title: SAM: State-Adaptive Memory for Long-Horizon Reasoning Agent

author.name: Yuyang Hu, Hongjin Qian, Shuting Wang, Jiongnan Liu, Ziliang Zhao, Jiejun Tan, Zheng Liu, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: SAM proposes state-adaptive memory for long-horizon reasoning agents, explicitly modeling how access to past interaction should adapt to evolving agent state rather than uniform truncation or retrieval.

entry.title: AgentFugue: Agent Scaling for Long-Horizon Tasks through Collective Reasoning

author.name: Yuyang Hu, Hongjin Qian, Shuting Wang, Jiongnan Liu, Tong Zhao, Xiaoxi Li, Zheng Liu, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: AgentFugue scales out long-horizon tasks via peer agents sharing a reasoning hub that records concise notes on attempts and findings, enabling collective reasoning without role specialization.

entry.title: PALoRA: Projection-Adaptive LoRA for Preserving Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Mustafa Hayri Bilgin, Mariam Barry, Albert Bifet, Azzedine Idir Ait Said, Soumya Banerjee

entry.summary: PALoRA is a projection-adaptive LoRA framework that preserves reasoning while injecting new factual knowledge, motivated by analysis showing reasoning-critical information is distributed across the singular spectrum.

entry.title: Hera: Learning Long-Horizon Coordination for Device-Cloud Collaborative LLM Agents

author.name: Yuxin Zhang, Mengxue Hu, Zheng Lin, Xiaoyi Fan, Fan Xie, Zihan Fang, Jing Yang, Wenjun Zhu, Zhiwen Chen, Chengfei Lv, Zhe Chen

entry.summary: Hera is a step-level device-cloud LLM agent coordinator that decides per-step which model handles long-horizon agent tasks, using two-stage training (imitation learning then RL). Targets performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent deployment.

entry.title: Lattice theory and algebraic models for deep convolutional learning based on mathematical morphology

author.name: Gustavo (Jesus), Angulo

entry.summary: Develops a rigorous algebraic framework grounding CNNs, ResNets, and UNets in lattice theory and mathematical morphology via the MMBB universal representation theory, showing CNN pipelines are cross-lattice morphological operators.

entry.title: AVBench: Human-Aligned and Automated Evaluation Benchmark for Audio-Video Generative Models

author.name: Jialiang Yang, Bin Xia, Ruihang Chu, Dingdong Wang, Wanke Xia, Zhun Mou, Tianyang Zhong, Yiting Zhao, Wenming Yang

entry.summary: AVBench is an automated benchmark for audio-video generative models targeting human-centric scenarios with ten fine-grained evaluation dimensions, addressing the gap in coarse current AV generation evaluation.

entry.title: When Mean CE Fails: Median CE Can Better Track Language Model Quality

author.name: Hao Guo, Simon Dennis, Rivaan Patil, Kevin Shabahang

entry.summary: Demonstrates that median cross-entropy tracks language model quality better than mean CE in SFT and distillation scenarios, where mean CE can rise while task accuracy stays high.

entry.title: MDIA: A Multi-Agent Diagnostic Intelligence Pipeline on HealthBench Professional

author.name: Roberto Cruz, David Rey-Blanco

entry.summary: MDIA is a 7-node specialty-routed multi-agent clinical reasoning pipeline that scores 0.6272 on the full HealthBench Professional benchmark using GPT-5.4, attributing gains to architecture rather than prompt engineering.

entry.title: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation

author.name: Yubo Li, Yidi Miao, Haotian Shen, Yuxin Liu

entry.summary: PANDO is a single-rollout online skill-distillation framework for multimodal web agents that maintains a structured Skill Library with progress reflection, confidence-based demotion, hierarchical routing, and cache-aware prompting.

entry.title: Beyond the Frontier: Stochastic Backtracking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Dao Tran, Duc Anh Le, Ngoc Luu, Quan Pham, Tung Pham, Hung Bui

entry.summary: Stochastic backtracking method for test-time scaling that maintains a persistent pool of historical prefixes for revisiting, addressing premature commitment and diversity collapse in PRM-guided frontier-only methods.

entry.title: Representation Without Control: Testing the Realization Effect in Language Models

author.name: Ciar\'an Walsh, Emilio Barkett

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs exhibit the realization effect (a behavioral economics finding) at three levels: prompt sensitivity, linear readout of internals, and activation steering. Finds prompt behavior diverges from human pattern despite linear readout of representations.

entry.title: Security of OpenClaw Agents: Fundamentals, Attacks, and Countermeasures

author.name: Yuntao Wang, Jianle Ba, Han Liu, Yanghe Pan, Jintao Wei, Zhou Su, Tom H. Luan, Linkang Du

entry.summary: Survey of security threats to OpenClaw open-source agent frameworks operating as continuously running systems with persistent memory, covering skill poisoning, cognitive manipulation, multi-agent cascading failures, and supply-chain vulnerabilities.

entry.title: What Gets Cited: Competitive GEO in AI Answer Engines

author.name: Rahul Vishwakarma, Shushant Kumar, Ratnesh Jamidar

entry.summary: Studies competitive Generative Engine Optimization through 252k controlled paired-document RAG comparisons across six LLMs and 18 content factors to determine what makes a source more likely to be cited first.

entry.title: Personalize-then-Store: Benchmarking and Learning Personalized Memory for Long-horizon Agents

author.name: Yeonjun In, Wonjoong Kim, Sangwu Park, Kanghoon Yoon, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: PerMemBench is the first benchmark for personalized memory in LLM-based memory systems with multi-year multi-domain interaction histories across user personas, plus session-level storage gating for personalized memory policies.

entry.title: Back to Parsimonious Latents: Learning Task-Centric World Models from Visual Foundations

author.name: Minghao Fu, Fan Feng, Nicklas Hansen, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: TC-WM learns task-centric world models from visual foundation model embeddings for offline reward-free planning, producing compact task-sufficient state representations by filtering task-irrelevant detail from foundation features.

entry.title: Learning to Search and Searching to Learn for Generalization in Planning

author.name: Michael Aichm\"uller, Yannik Hesse, Hector Geffner

entry.summary: Self-improving WA* learning framework with relational graph neural network heuristics for combinatorial generalization in classical planning, replacing demonstrations and random walks with best-first search.

entry.title: Behind EvoMap: Characterizing a Self-Evolving Agent-to-Agent Collaboration Network

author.name: Qiming Ye, Peixain Zhang, Yupeng He, Zifan Peng, Gareth Tyson

entry.summary: Empirical study of an agent-to-agent collaboration network analyzing 1.5M assets and 128K agents, revealing how credit-based incentive design leads to mass-production over genuine reusability. Provides one of the first large-scale views into emerging A2A ecosystems.

entry.title: Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World

author.name: Yusong Lin, Xinyuan Liang, Haiyang Wang, Qipeng Gu, Siqi Cheng, Jiangui Chen, Shuzhe Wu, Feiyang Pan, Lue Fan, Sanyuan Zhao, Dandan Tu

entry.summary: Introduces Claw-Anything, a benchmark for always-on personal assistants with broad access to user digital context including long activity histories, backend services, and GUI/CLI interaction. Simulates months of synthetic user activity.

entry.title: VineLM: Trie-Based Fine-Grained Control for Agentic Workflows

author.name: Nikos Pagonas, Matthew Lou, Tianyi Peng, Dan Rubenstein, Kostis Kaffes

entry.summary: VineLM is a workflow manager that selects models per stage invocation in agentic pipelines using a trie of model-choice prefixes. Enables fine-grained cost-accuracy tradeoffs versus static workflow-level routing.

entry.title: MemForest: An Efficient Agent Memory System with Hierarchical Temporal Indexing

author.name: Han Chen, Zining Zhang, Wenqi Pei, Bingsheng He, Ming Wu, Jason Zeng, Michael Heinrich, Wei Wu, Hongbao Zhang

entry.summary: MemForest reformulates LLM agent memory as a write-efficient temporal data management problem with hierarchical temporal indexing. Addresses scalability bottlenecks in serve-and-update memory pipelines via parallel updates.

entry.title: A World Model of Radiologist Reading for Medical Image Representation Learning

author.name: Yiwei Li, Zihao Wu, Huaqin Zhao, Yifan Zhou, Chao Cao, Dajiang Zhu, Tianming Liu, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: GazeWorld is a medical imaging world model trained on radiologist eye-tracking data, autoregressively predicting fixation trajectories. At inference, generates gaze patches from images alone for medical representation learning.

entry.title: Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction

author.name: Siqiao Huang, Partha Kaushik, Michael Chen, Hengkai Pan, Omar Chehab, Fernando Moreno-Pino, Max Simchowitz

entry.summary: Nano World Models provides a minimalist, reproducible codebase for studying future video prediction with diffusion forcing. Unifies design choices for generative objectives, action conditioning, and long-horizon rollouts.

entry.title: IVR-R1: Refining Trajectories through Iterative Visual-Grounded Reasoning in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chenghao Li, Fusheng Hao, Xikai Zhang, Likang Xiao, Yanwei Ren, Fuxiang Wu, Quan Chen, Liu Liu

entry.summary: IVR-R1 introduces iterative visual-grounded reasoning in reinforcement learning to address visual hallucination in long-horizon multimodal tasks. Dynamically realigns visual grounding as reasoning chains unfold.

entry.title: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL

author.name: Junyi Wu, Weijian Luo, Haoyang Zheng, Runzhe Zhang, Guang Lin Haoyang Zheng Runzhe Zhang Guang Lin

entry.summary: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR) is a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework for one-step generators derived from Integral KL minimization. Addresses reward hacking in image-space optimization for one-step text-to-image models.

entry.title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation

author.name: Xiaotian Liu, Shuyuan Shang, Xiaopeng Wang, Pu Ren, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators recast neural PDE surrogates as learned fixed-point solvers with provable contraction properties. Targets spectral bias by progressively resolving high-frequency components.

entry.title: Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle

author.name: Alexander Okezue Bell

entry.summary: Tests 1,536 Gaussian release covariances for hidden-state privacy and proves a Fisher-ball lower bound showing no full-rank Gaussian release achieves both moderate utility and privacy. Identifies an optimal diagonal mechanism.

entry.title: LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs

author.name: Sanchit Kabra, Nikhil Abhyankar, Saaketh Desai, Prasad Iyer, Chandan K Reddy

entry.summary: LLM-AutoSciLab is a closed-loop framework coupling hypothesis generation with experiment selection for scientific discovery. Iteratively proposes experiments to resolve mechanistic uncertainty rather than fitting to passive datasets.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark: Do Protein-Ligand Models Learn Binding Sites or Just Binding Likelihood?

author.name: Zhaohan Meng, Zhen Bai, Ke Yuan, Iadh Ounis, Zaiqiao Meng, Hao Xu, Joseph Loscalzo

entry.summary: InteractBind is a 100k protein-ligand pair dataset with binding-site localization tasks evaluating whether models learn binding sites or only binding likelihood. Provides fine-grained protein-residue and ligand-atom benchmarks.

entry.title: Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence

author.name: Fuming Yang

entry.summary: Develops a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics with a label-free phase coordinate to detect concept emergence in real time. Predicts a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian.

entry.title: Verified SHAP: Provable Bounds for Exact Shapley Values of Neural Networks

author.name: David Boetius, Shahaf Bassan, Guy Katz, Stefan Leue, Tobias Sutter

entry.summary: Verified SHAP computes provable bounds on exact Shapley values for neural networks using neural network verification techniques. Scales exact SHAP to orders of magnitude larger feature spaces than prior methods.

entry.title: AvalancheBench: Evaluating Enterprise Data Agents Through Latent World Recovery

author.name: Darek Kleczek, Fuheng Zhao, Alexander W. Lee, Julien Tissier, Pawel Liskowski, Ugur Cetintemel, Anupam Datta

entry.summary: AvalancheBench is a benchmark for enterprise data agents focused on recovering latent world structure (segments, drivers, events) rather than pipeline completion. Provides ground truth for partial credit on analytical understanding.

entry.title: Filtered Posterior Mean Collections: A Unified Framework for Analytical Models of Diffusion Generalization

author.name: Matthew Niedoba, Berend Zwartsenberg, Frank Wood

entry.summary: Unifies analytical models of diffusion generalization under a Filtered Posterior Mean Collections (FPMC) framework defined by query precision, response weights, and source distributions. Recovers existing patch-aggregation models as special cases.

entry.title: An Interactive Paradigm for Deep Research

author.name: Lin Ai, Victor S. Bursztyn, Xiang Chen, Julia Hirschberg, Saayan Mitra

entry.summary: SteER is a deep research framework adding interpretable mid-process user control to long-horizon research workflows. Uses cost-benefit reasoning to decide when to pause for user input vs. proceed autonomously.

entry.title: ArtSplat: Feed-Forward Articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-State Uncalibrated Views

author.name: Inseo Lee, Yoonji Kim, Eugene Sohn, Jiwoong Lee, Jungmin You, Joonseok Lee, Jin-Hwa Kim

entry.summary: ArtSplat is a feed-forward framework for articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse multi-state uncalibrated views. Reconstructs geometry and joint parameters jointly in a single forward pass.

entry.title: MX-SAFE: Versatile Inference- and Training-Proof Microscaling Format with On-the-Fly Exponent and Mantissa Bit Allocation

author.name: Dahoon Park, Jahyun Koo, Sangwoo Hwang, Jaeha Kung

entry.summary: MX-SAFE is a versatile MXFP format with on-the-fly exponent and mantissa bit allocation. Combines MXINT precision strengths with MXFP dynamic range for deep learning quantization.

entry.title: Is Decentralized AI Governable? From Regulative Policy to Constitutive Protocol

author.name: Botao Amber Hu, Helena Rong

entry.summary: Conceptual paper arguing decentralized AI creates a governance vacuum across six layers (model, training, compute, harness, identity, ownership). Distinguishes accountability gaps from enforcement gaps.

entry.title: LAPLEX: The FFT of Learnable Laplace Kernels

author.name: {\L}ukasz Struski, Hanna Blazhko, Piotr Kubaty, Jacek Tabor

entry.summary: LAPLEX introduces a class of exact, trainable Laplace-kernel operators with FFT-like scaling supporting trainable matrix-vector ops up to 10^9 dimensions on GPUs. Yields full-rank dense matrices implicitly defined by learnable anchors.

entry.title: Correcting Visual Blur Induced by Attention Distraction to Reduce Hallucinations: Algorithm and Theory

author.name: Quanjiang Li, Zhiming Liu, Wei Luo, Tingjin Luo, Chenping Hou

entry.summary: Identifies attention distraction phenomenon in MLLMs causing object hallucinations via spatial inconsistency in multi-head attention and temporal fading. Proposes an attention correction method with theoretical analysis.

entry.title: Beyond the Aggregation Dilemma: Prior-Retaining Decoupled Learning for Multimodal Graphs

author.name: Hao Yan, Xuanru Wang, Jun Yin, Shirui Pan, Senzhang Wang, Chengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies an aggregation dilemma in multimodal attributed graph learning under strong LFM priors, where MAGL architectures underperform MLPs. Proposes prior-retaining decoupled learning to address SNR degradation.

entry.title: The Path Matters: Learning a Token-Commitment Policy for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Bohang Sun, Max Zhu, Francesco Caso, Jindong Gu, Junchi Yu, Philip Torr, Pietro Li\`o, Jialin Yu

entry.summary: TraceLock is a learned token commitment policy for diffusion language models that uses future stability as self-supervision. Plug-in controller for frozen DLMs that replaces hand-designed acceptance rules.

entry.title: Complement Submodular Information Measures for Balanced and Robust Data Selection

author.name: Rishabh Iyer

entry.summary: Introduces Complement Submodular Information (CSI), a new class of functions that explicitly preserve structural information between selected subsets and their complements. Applications include train/val/test splitting and benchmark construction.

entry.title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM

author.name: Yubo Li, Yidi Miao

entry.summary: CONF-KV proposes a KV cache eviction policy that dynamically adjusts cache budget based on the model's per-step prediction confidence, retaining more context when uncertain. This addresses memory bottlenecks in long-horizon LLM inference with a simple but useful signal.

entry.title: Divide-and-Conquer Inference for Large-Scale Visual Recognition with Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Zhipeng Ye, Jiaqi Huang, Feng Jiang, Qiufeng Wang, Yikang Duan, Dawei Wang, Xihang Zhou, Qian Qiao

entry.summary: Identifies performance collapse in MLLMs on large-label-space classification due to attention dilution, and proposes Divide-and-Conquer Inference to mitigate it. Useful insight on scaling limitations of MLLMs in long-prompt regimes.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Energy-Guided Diffusion Generation for Off-Dynamics Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yu Yang, Yihong Guo, Anqi Liu, Pan Xu

entry.summary: CEDGE uses energy-guided diffusion to generate target-domain trajectories for off-dynamics offline RL, moving beyond transition-level synthesis to reduce long-horizon error accumulation. Addresses a real limitation in cross-domain offline RL.

entry.title: Reflect-Guard: Enhancing LLM Safeguards against Adversarial Prompts via Logical Self-Reflection

author.name: Lixing Lin, Juli You, Yue Li, Luyun Lin, Yiqing Wang, Zhen Zhang, Moxuan Zheng

entry.summary: Reflect-Guard adds chain-of-thought self-reflection to Llama Guard via QLoRA fine-tuning with GPT-4o-mini-distilled annotations, improving robustness to adversarial jailbreaks. Efficient safety classifier enhancement.

entry.title: APT-Agent: Automated Penetration Testing using Large Language Models

author.name: William Guanting Li (University of Queensland), Alsharif Abuadbba (CSIRO Data61), Kristen Moore (CSIRO Data61), Dan Dongseong Kim (University of Queensland)

entry.summary: APT-Agent is an LLM-driven automated penetration testing framework with hybrid hallucination correction and command-specific memory across reconnaissance, exploitation, and exfiltration. Addresses real LLM weaknesses in agentic security tasks.

entry.title: MinerU-Popo: Universal Post-Processing Model for Structured Document Parsing

author.name: Bangrui Xu, Ziyang Miao, Xuanhe Zhou, Yiming Lin, Zirui Tang, Xiaomeng Zhao, Fan Wu, Cheng Tan, Fan Wu, Bin Wang, Conghui He

entry.summary: MinerU-Popo is a universal post-processing model that reconstructs document-level structures (cross-page paragraphs, tables) from OCR/VLM outputs for better RAG-ready parsing. Practical document AI tool.

entry.title: Language Bias in LVLMs: From In-Depth Analysis to Simple and Effective Mitigation

author.name: Yangneng Chen, Jing Li

entry.summary: Identifies modality misalignment in VIT and DPO training as the root of language bias in LVLMs, and proposes mitigation. Diagnostic plus practical fix for hallucination.

entry.title: Scale When Needed: Adaptive Neuron-level Mixed Precision Quantization Aware Training

author.name: Ayush K. Varshney, Konstantinos Vandikas, \v{S}ar\=unas Girdzijauskas, Adam Orucu, Aneta Vulgarakis Feljan

entry.summary: NMP-QAT learns per-neuron precision via differentiable surrogates during quantization-aware training, expanding bit-width only when needed. Fine-grained mixed precision for edge deployment.

entry.title: Security in the Fine-Tuning Lifecycle of Large Language Models: Threats, Defenses,Evaluation, and Future Directions

author.name: Wenjuan Li, Yitao Liu, Runze Chen, Rajkumar Buyya

entry.summary: Systematic survey of fine-tuning security threats and defenses across pre-, during-, and post-tuning phases for LLMs, with empirical evaluation. Useful taxonomic resource.

entry.title: Courant: a State-Adaptive Perceiver-Based Neural Surrogate with Local Support and Interpretable Field Decomposition

author.name: Anuj Kumar, Josiah Bjorgaard, Nikolaos Bouklas, Matteo Salvador, Alexander Lavin

entry.summary: Courant is a Perceiver-based neural surrogate with adaptive latent specialization and local support resembling hp-refinement, for solving PDEs end-to-end. Combines interpretability with competitive accuracy.

entry.title: AME-TS: Anchored Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Rui Wang, Renhao Xue, Ray Razi, Huan Song, Hannah R. Marlowe

entry.summary: AME-TS is a sparse mixture-of-experts time series foundation model with a regime predictor that aligns expert routing with interpretable temporal structure (forecastability, seasonality, etc). Addresses MoE specialization stability.

entry.title: Beyond Killer Robots: General AI Attitudes and Public Support for Military AI in Nine Countries

author.name: Andreas Jungherr, Antonia Schlude, Adrian Rauchfleisch

entry.summary: Survey of 9000 respondents across nine countries on public attitudes toward military AI, finding general AI attitudes shape support for military uses. Empirical social science contribution.

entry.title: On the Epistemic Uncertainty of Overparametrized Neural Networks

author.name: David R\"ugamer

entry.summary: Analysis showing epistemic uncertainty persists in overparametrized neural networks even with infinite data due to non-identifiability and symmetries, characterizing posterior structure for one-hidden-layer ReLU nets. Foundational uncertainty result.

entry.title: Constraint-Anchored Attribution: Feasibility-Certified Counterfactuals and Bonferroni-PAC Sufficient Subsets for Neural CO Policies

author.name: Sohaib Lafifi

entry.summary: Constraint-anchored attribution for neural combinatorial optimization policies using LP duals, CSP feasibility certification, and Bonferroni-PAC sufficient subsets. Provides certified counterfactual explanations for CO policies.

entry.title: Guess the Unified Model: How Much Can We Recover from Generated Images?

author.name: Jasin Cekinmez, Ryo Mitsuhashi, Addison J. Wu, Yida Yin

entry.summary: Investigates attribution of unified-model-generated images across seven models, showing high separability and robustness to corruptions and prompt languages. Contributes to AI provenance research.

entry.title: First, do no harm: Breaking suicidogenic echo chambers in media recommendation

author.name: Alberto D\'iaz-\'Alvarez, Ra\'ul Lara-Cabrera, Fernando Ortega-Requena, V\'ictor Ramos-Osuna

entry.summary: RankAid is a re-ranking add-on that prioritizes clinical safety in recommender systems for users showing suicidal ideation, penalizing risky content and boosting therapeutic items. Safety-aware recsys contribution.

entry.title: READER: Reasoning-Enhanced AI-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Pingfan Su, Kai Ye, Shijin Gong, Erhan Xu, Jin Zhu, Giulia Livieri, Chengchun Shi

entry.summary: READER is a 1.5B reasoning-enhanced AI-generated text detector that produces structured rationales alongside labels. Claims to outperform larger detectors via fine-tuning on curated rationale data.

entry.title: UWM-JEPA: Predictive World Models That Imagine in Belief Space

author.name: Santosh Kumar Radha, Oktay Goktas

entry.summary: UWM-JEPA proposes a world model with density-matrix latent on a joint system-environment space and a unitary predictor, preserving uncertainty during rollouts. Targets partial observability with belief-space imagination.

entry.title: A general tensor-structured compression scheme for efficient large language models

author.name: Ying Lu, Peng-Fei Zhou, Qi-Xuan Fang, Pan Zhang, Shi-Ju Ran, Gang Su

entry.summary: MixT introduces tensor-structured compression that replaces dense linear layers with mixtures of tensor operators, evaluated on Qwen3-8B and LLaMA2-7B. Identifies broad regime where MMLU accuracy is preserved.

entry.title: Parallel Differentiable Reachability for Learning and Planning with Certified Neural Dynamics and Controllers

author.name: Keyi Shen, Glen Chou

entry.summary: Parallelizable differentiable reachability framework in JAX combining Taylor-model flowpipes with CROWN-style bounds for certified neural dynamics and controllers. Bridges formal verification with learning pipelines.

entry.title: Certified Robustness from Approximate Gaussian Mixture Structures in Pretrained Latent Spaces

author.name: Konstantinos Emmanouilidis, Tianjiao Ding, Nghia Nguyen, Nicolas Loizou, Ren\'e Vidal

entry.summary: Framework for certifiably robust classifiers leveraging Gaussian mixture structure in pretrained latent spaces. Derives existence conditions and constructs classifiers exploiting latent structure for tighter certified bounds.

entry.title: CollectionLoRA: Collecting 50 Effects in 1 LoRA via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Fangtai Wu, Hailong Guo, Shijie Huang, Jiayi Song, Yubo Huang, Mushui Liu, Zhao Wang, Yunlong Yu, Jiaming Liu, Ruihua Huang

entry.summary: CollectionLoRA distills up to 50 effect LoRAs along with few-step generation into a single LoRA via multi-teacher on-policy distillation. Addresses deployment overhead and concept bleeding in customized image editing.

entry.title: Autoregression-Free Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs

author.name: Jiaquan Zhang, Caiyan Qin, Haoyu Bian, Libin Cai, Yi Lu, Chaoning Zhang, Wei Dong, Yuanfang Guo, Yang Yang, Hen Tao Shen

entry.summary: AFNO learns neural operators for time-dependent PDEs without autoregressive rollouts by mapping evolution into latent space and modeling continuous-time vector fields. Avoids error accumulation in long horizons.

entry.title: SeqRoute: Global Budget-Aware Sequential LLM Routing via Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhongling Xu, Shunan Zheng, Wei Wang

entry.summary: SeqRoute formulates multi-turn LLM routing as a finite-horizon MDP solved via Conservative Q-Learning offline RL. Incorporates remaining budget into state space to learn delayed gratification across sessions.

entry.title: TopoAlign: Topology-Aware Visual Representation Alignment

author.name: Xinyuan Yan, Rita Sevastjanova, Mennatallah El-Assady, Bei Wang

entry.summary: TopoAlign is a topology-aware framework for visually comparing model representations, going beyond neighborhood and cluster similarity. From El-Assady group focused on visualization and interpretability.

entry.title: Keep the Proof State Live: Snapshotting for Efficient Tactic Search in Lean 4

author.name: Austin Shen, Yunong Shi

entry.summary: Snapshots Lean 4 proof states to avoid expensive re-elaboration in parallel tactic search. Reports >99% per-branch time savings, making portfolio-based proof search practical at scale.

entry.title: Mosaic: Compositional Multi-Concept Erasure via Vector Field Blending

author.name: Junseok Ko, Jungwoo Kim, Jong-Seok Lee

entry.summary: Mosaic introduces compositional multi-concept erasure for text-to-image models via vector field blending. CoME-Bench accompanies for evaluation of simultaneous concept removal.

entry.title: Geometric Flow Matching for Molecular Conformation Generation via Manifold Decomposition

author.name: Yunqing Liu, Yi Zhou, Wenqi Fan

entry.summary: Geometric flow matching for molecular conformation generation respecting manifold decomposition into stiff bond lengths/angles and flexible torsions. Addresses misalignment between physical reality and standard treatment.

entry.title: Benchmarking Pathology Foundation Models for Spatial Domain Understanding

author.name: Bokai Zhao, Yiyang Zhang, Yuanchi Zhu, Hanqing Chao, Long Bai, Tai Ma, Minfeng Xu, Ming Song, Tianzi Jiang

entry.summary: SpaPath-Bench benchmarks pathology foundation models on spatial domain identification using paired WSI and spatial transcriptomics. Diagnoses representation-level spatial capability beyond clinical endpoints.

entry.title: Concept Unlearning via Cross-Attention Activation Projection for Diffusion Models

author.name: Saemi Moon, Suhyeon Jun, Seoyeon Lee, Dongwoo Kim

entry.summary: Argues concept unlearning in diffusion models should target cross-attention activation space rather than text embedding space. Closed-form edit method robust to paraphrased prompts.

entry.title: OASIS: Observation-Action Space Alignment via SE(3) Trajectory Prediction for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinzhe Chen, Sihua Ren, Liqi Huang, Haowen Sun, Mingyang Li, Xingyu Chen, Zeyang Liu, Xuguang Lan

entry.summary: OASIS aligns VLA intermediate representations with action space via SE(3) end-effector trajectory prediction, fusing vision-language with metric-depth features. Shares rigid-body geometry between representation and action.

entry.title: Clarify, Abstain or Answer? Strategising in Conversation with Belief-Augmented Generation

author.name: Joris Baan, Wilker Aziz, Barbara Plank, Raquel Fern\'andez

entry.summary: Belief-Augmented Generation grounds LLMs in their own sampled belief state via prompting, enabling them to choose clarify/answer/abstain strategies. Studied in multi-turn ambiguous QA.

entry.title: Can LLMs Time Travel? Enhancing Temporal Consistency in Legal Agentic Search through Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Wei Fan, Yining Zhou, Mufan Zhang, Yanbing Weng, Yiran HU, Tianshi Zheng, Baixuan Xu, Chunyang Li, Jianhui Yang, Haoran Li, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: LegalSearch-R1 is an RL framework for legal agentic search that enforces temporal consistency, ensuring applicable statutes match each case's temporal context. Addresses retroactive application errors in legal LLMs.

entry.title: EchoPilot: Training-Free Ultrasound Video Segmentation via Scale-Space Semantic Prompting and Reliability-Gated Memory

author.name: Ruiqiang Xiao, Zhaohu Xing, Yijun Yang, Zhenyan Han, Weiming Wang, Kaishun Wu, Lei Zhu

entry.summary: EchoPilot is training-free framework for ultrasound video segmentation using VLM/VFM combo from single point click. Addresses speckle noise and temporal drift in medical video segmentation.

entry.title: VEN-VL: A Visual Ensemble MoE Framework for Effective and Efficient Multi-Modal Understanding

author.name: Yinghao Wu, Zhuoyan Luo, Yiyao Yu, Zhaojian Yu, Yujiu Yang, Xiao-Ping Zhang

entry.summary: VEN-VL uses visual ensemble MoE framework with enrich-then-compact principle for efficient multimodal understanding. Addresses information bottleneck in current pruning-based approaches.

entry.title: Step-TP: A Grounded, Step-Level Dataset with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-Guided Tensor Program Optimization

author.name: Mengfan Liu, Da Zheng, Junwei Su, Chuan Wu

entry.summary: Step-TP provides step-level supervision with CoT reasoning for LLM-guided tensor program optimization. Addresses lack of verifiable intermediate supervision in existing datasets.

entry.title: SafeCtrl-RL: Inference-Time Adaptive Behaviour Control for LLM Dialogue via RL-Driven Prompt Optimisation

author.name: Michael Orme, Yanchao Yu, Zhiyuan Tan

entry.summary: SafeCtrl-RL provides inference-time behavioral control for LLM dialogue via RL-driven prompt optimization, without retraining. Frames generation as sequential decision process.

entry.title: Learning in Low-Dimensional Subspaces: Orthogonal Bottlenecks for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Aleksandar Todorov, Matthia Sabatelli

entry.summary: Inserts fixed orthonormal projection bottleneck into RL encoders to constrain features to low-dimensional subspace. Proves preserved expressivity under realizability with no auxiliary objectives.

entry.title: Confidence and Calibration of Activation Oracles for Reliable Interpretation of Language Model Internals

author.name: Federico Torrielli, Peter Schneider-Kamp, Lukas Galke Poech

entry.summary: Investigates uncertainty quantification methods for activation oracle interpretability outputs. Finds bootstrap mode frequency best calibrated (5.7% ECE vs 25.5% baseline).

entry.title: When Gradients Collide: Failure Modes of Multi-Objective Prompt Optimization for LLM Judges

author.name: Parth Darshan, Abhishek Divekar

entry.summary: Studies failure modes of multi-objective textual gradient prompt optimization for LLM judges. Finds optimization frequently fails to improve over initial prompts (6/10 configs).

entry.title: Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark

author.name: Xu Yao, Siyuan Zhou, Wu Zhenbo, Chaochuan Hou, Shuang Liang, Shiping wang, Hailiang Huang, Songqiao Han, Minqi Jiang

entry.summary: WSADBench unifies evaluation across incomplete/inexact/inaccurate weakly supervised anomaly detection with 36 algorithms across 4 modalities. Over 700K experiments.

entry.title: Squeezing Capacity from Multimodal Large Language Models for Subject-driven Generation

author.name: Shuhong Zheng, Aashish Kumar Misraa, Yu-Teng Li, Yu-Jhe Li, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Conditions diffusion on MLLMs jointly encoding text+reference images plus VAE-based identity conditioning. Dual Layer Aggregation module for multi-level MLLM features.

entry.title: PrivFusion: A Privacy-preserving Multi-Agent Framework for Harmonizing Distributed Datasets

author.name: Anisa Halimi, Liubov Nedoshivina, Kieran Fraser, Stefano Braghin

entry.summary: PrivFusion is privacy-preserving multi-agent framework that automates harmonization of heterogeneous structured datasets across institutions before federated training. From IBM Research.

entry.title: Rethinking Continual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmarking Under Realistic Industrial Conditions

author.name: Chad Weatherly, Sen Lin

entry.summary: Unified benchmark for continual anomaly detection on edge with realistic drift protocols. Proposes DINOSaur, a training-free method that often outperforms existing CAD methods.

entry.title: A lift for input-convex neural network training

author.name: Ali Siahkoohi, Anirudh Thatipelli

entry.summary: Lifting approach for input-convex neural network training that avoids stiff PGD projection and softplus gradient stalling. Addresses ICNN training instabilities for OT/Bayesian applications.

entry.title: Private Adaptive Covariance Estimation via Gaussian Graphical Models

author.name: Cecilia Ferrando, Miguel Fuentes, Brett Mullins, Cameron Musco, Daniel Sheldon

entry.summary: PACE-GGM is data-adaptive differentially private covariance estimation that concentrates privacy budget on most informative entries via Gaussian graphical models.

entry.title: Omissive Bias in Religious Representation: Benchmarking LLM Answers to Everyday Ethical Decision-making

author.name: David Wingate, Sheryl Carty, Joshua Coates, Daniel Feldman, Nancy Fulda, Larry Howell, Brett Israelson, Dallin Jacobs, Jonathan Karr, John Paul Kimes, Elisabeth Kincaid, Paul Martens, Gavin Mobley, Suzana Pinheiro, Lindsay Slemboski, Peter Whiting

entry.summary: AllFaith Religious Representation Benchmark with 150 ethical questions tests whether LLMs invoke religious frameworks when relevant. Introduces concept of omissive bias for missing representations.

entry.title: Evolving Robustness--Exploration Trade-off in Online Reinforcement Learning via Quantile Bayesian Risk MDPs

author.name: Meichen Song, Yuhao Wang, Enlu Zhou

entry.summary: Quantile Bayesian risk-aware MDP for online RL where quantile level controls posterior uncertainty in Bellman backup. Asymptotic normality enables time-varying robustness-exploration trade-off.

entry.title: Refined Analysis of Entropy-Regularized Actor-Critic

author.name: Safwan Labbi, Paul Mangold, Daniil Tiapkin, Eric Moulines

entry.summary: Refined analysis showing exact critic baseline in entropy-regularized actor-critic achieves variance reduction matching deterministic policy gradient sample complexity (log(1/eps)).

entry.title: Learning Laplacian Eigenspace with Mass-Aware Neural Operators on Point Clouds

author.name: Zherui Yang, Tao Du, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: Neural Eigenspace Operator predicts Laplace-Beltrami spectrum directly from point clouds by learning invariant low-frequency subspace, avoiding sign/rotation ambiguities of eigenvector regression.

entry.title: LLMTabBench: Evaluating LLMs on Binary Tabular Classification From Zero to Few Shots

author.name: Daria Grushina, Kseniia Kuvshinova, Alina Kostromina, Aziz Temirkhanov, Mile Mitrovic, Dmitry Simakov

entry.summary: LLMTabBench systematically evaluates LLMs on zero/few-shot binary tabular classification, comparing against state-of-the-art TabPFN.

entry.title: CAffNet: Hard Constraint-Affine Neural Networks

author.name: Yang Zhao, Jungeun Lee, Jeong hwan Jeon, Sze Zheng Yong

entry.summary: CAffNet embeds input-dependent affine hard constraints into NN architectures via trainable constraint-affine layer, beyond fixed orthogonal projections.

entry.title: The Normalized Maximum Likelihood for Regular Non-Smooth Models: Measure-Theoretic Foundations and Geometric Sampling

author.name: Trenton Lau, Gary P. T. Choi

entry.summary: Provides rigorous geometric measure theory framework for computing Normalized Maximum Likelihood codelength for non-smooth path-differentiable Lipschitz estimators like Lasso and Sparse SVMs.

entry.title: MindAlign: Bridging EEG, Vision, and Language for Zero-Shot Visual Decoding

author.name: Zexuan Chen, Sichao Liu, Runhao Lu, Huichao Qi, Alexandra Woolgar, Xi Vincent Wang, Lihui Wang

entry.summary: MindAlign tri-modal contrastive framework aligns EEG, visual, and textual representations for zero-shot visual decoding from brain signals via two-stage pre-training.

entry.title: Deep ZakaiJ: Structured Filtering for Jump-Diffusion Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yan Leng, Thibaut Mastrolia, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Deep ZakaiJ embeds Zakai nonlinear filtering equation into neural encoder-decoder for partially observed jump-diffusion time series. Uses Strang splitting for interpretable substeps.

entry.title: WLNO: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Muhammad Abid, Arth Sojitra, Omer San

entry.summary: WLNO combines Haar wavelet multi-scale spatial decomposition with Laplace-domain pole-residue formulation for solving PDEs. Captures both transient dynamics and multi-scale spatial features.

entry.title: Feature Learning in Wide Neural Networks under $\mu$P: Identifiability and Sparse-Dictionary Decomposition of the Mean-Field Limit

author.name: Akmal Xodarev

entry.summary: Establishes structural results for feature learning in wide two-layer neural networks under the muP parametrization, including mean-field limit existence, identifiability, and sparse-dictionary decomposition. Provides theoretical foundation for understanding how scaling impacts feature learning.

entry.title: Hermite-NGP: Gradient-Augmented Hash Encoding for Learning PDEs

author.name: Jinjin He, Zhiqi Li, Sinan Wang, Bo Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces Hermite-NGP, a gradient-augmented multi-resolution hash encoding that explicitly stores values and partial derivatives for analytic gradient computation in neural PDE solvers. Enables fully analytic differential operators.

entry.title: Global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs

author.name: Ziyue Chen, David \v{S}i\v{s}ka, Lukasz Szpruch

entry.summary: Establishes global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient with linear function approximation beyond tabular MDPs. Identifies feature regimes for non-uniform PL inequalities.

entry.title: Blocked Gibbs meets Diffusion Transformers: Unsupervised Learning for Constraint Optimization

author.name: Yudong W. Xu, Wenhao Li, Xiaoyu Wang, Scott Sanner, Elias B. Khalil

entry.summary: Investigates Diffusion Transformers for unsupervised constraint optimization with blocked Gibbs-style updates to address mismatch between standard diffusion and constraint solving. Extends beyond binary variables and GNN-based approaches.

entry.title: Localization then Neutralization: Gradient-guided Token Suppression against Visual Prompt Injection Attack

author.name: Dongpeng Zhang, Ke Ma, Yangbangyan Jiang, Gaozheng Pei, Longtao Huang, Qianqian Xu, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient Token Masking (GTM), which localizes critical adversarial tokens via gradient analysis on multimodal LLMs. Uses Hidden-State Gradient attribution rather than first-token output probability.

entry.title: When Interpretability Becomes a Liability: Adversarial Attacks on CBM Concept Layers

author.name: Aditya Sridhar

entry.summary: Studies adversarial vulnerabilities in concept bottleneck layers of CBMs, showing minimal pixel perturbations can manipulate semantic representations to cause catastrophic misclassification. Develops theoretical framework and metrics for concept-space robustness.

entry.title: PDEInvBench: A Comprehensive Dataset and Design Space Exploration of Neural Networks for PDE Inverse Problems

author.name: Divyam Goel, Nithin Chalapathi, Sanjeev Raja, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan

entry.summary: Introduces PDEInvBench, a comprehensive benchmark for neural network methods on PDE inverse problems including time-dependent and time-independent PDEs. Fills a gap left by forward-problem benchmarks.

entry.title: Not only where, But when: Temporal Scheduling for RLVR

author.name: Jinghao Zhang, Ruilin Li, Feng Zhao, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: Argues that when learning signals are scheduled across training matters as much as where they are allocated across tokens in RLVR. Introduces temporal scheduling to overcome stagnant credit allocation criteria.

entry.title: JacQuant: STE-Free Quantization-Aware Training via Learned Jacobian Surrogates

author.name: Kai Yi, Vignesh Vivekraja, Harshit Khaitan, Steven Li

entry.summary: Introduces JacQuant, a STE-free quantization-aware training method using learned Jacobian surrogates to capture local sensitivity to parameter changes. Provides convergence guarantees for non-convex objectives.

entry.title: SAE-FD: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Distillation for Continual Learning of Large Language Models

author.name: Mingxu Zhang, Yuhan Li, Lujundong Li, Dazhong Shen, Hui Xiong, Ying Sun

entry.summary: Proposes SAE-FD, a sparse autoencoder feature distillation method for continual learning of LLMs. Anchors representations in sparse feature space to mitigate catastrophic forgetting via feature superposition.

entry.title: On Reliability of Efficient Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation

author.name: Joonas J\"alk\"o, Gauri Pradhan, Ossi R\"ais\"a, Antti Honkela

entry.summary: Studies reliability of efficient membership inference attack evaluations, showing biases when averaging over multiple individuals and target models. Demonstrates pitfalls in current MIA empirical privacy assessment practices.

entry.title: When Self-Belief Misleads: Active Label Acquisition for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Li Wang, Xiaodong Lu, Xiaohan Wang, Yikun Ban, Jiajun Chai, Wei Lin, Tianhao Peng, Guojun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes RLAVR, an active label acquisition framework for RLVR that selectively acquires ground-truth labels for selected samples and integrates them with pseudo-labels. Mitigates training collapse in unsupervised RLVR.

entry.title: Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models

author.name: Benedikt Schesch, Michael D. Ernst

entry.summary: Constructs Merge-Bench dataset of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories and trains LLMergeJ using GRPO online reinforcement learning. Addresses version control merging with LLMs.

entry.title: Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio

author.name: Georgios Milis, Yubin Qin, Yihan Wu, Heng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a gradient-free watermarking scheme for synthetic audio that exploits vocabulary redundancy in tokenizers via community detection. Avoids the typical need to fine-tune tokenizers for watermark embedding.

entry.title: Deployment-complete benchmarking

author.name: El Mustapha Mansouri, Keigo Arai

entry.summary: Introduces deployment-complete benchmarking, a framework distinguishing whether benchmark evidence actually determines deployment decisions versus merely scoring responses. Shows conformal coverage can transfer poorly across channels.

entry.title: Learning Protein Structure-Function Relationships through Knowledge-guided Representation Decomposition

author.name: Mingqing Wang, Zhiwei Nie, Athanasios V. Vasilakos, Yonghong He, Zhixiang Ren

entry.summary: ProtDiS decomposes pretrained protein micro-environment embeddings into biologically interpretable dimensions using an information bottleneck principle. Shows improvements across 12 downstream protein tasks.

entry.title: Quantification of atmospheric carbon dioxide from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES East)

author.name: Aaron Sonabend-W, Sean Campbell, John Platt, Christopher Van Arsdale, Anna M. Michalak

entry.summary: Uses GOES-East geostationary satellite imagery to infer atmospheric CO2 variability at high temporal resolution. Leverages existing weather satellites for greenhouse gas monitoring.

entry.title: Optimal Non-Asymptotic Edgeworth Expansions for Multivariate Neural Network Outputs

author.name: Lucia Celli

entry.summary: Establishes optimal non-asymptotic Edgeworth expansions for finite-width neural network outputs, with matching lower bounds and applications to Bayesian posteriors. Provides rigorous theory for deviation from Gaussian limit.

entry.title: Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs

author.name: Ihor Neporozhnii, Sjoerd Hoogland, Oleksandr Voznyy

entry.summary: Demonstrates that multitask learning with orbitally resolved semiempirical charges improves sample efficiency and accuracy of machine learning interatomic potentials. Uses an equivariant model for charge prediction.

entry.title: Incorporating Deep Learning Design in Database Queries

author.name: Yuval Lev Lubarsky, Dean Light, Boaz Berger, Shunit Agmon, Benny Kimelfeld

entry.summary: Integrates deep learning directly into database queries, associating tuple embeddings within SQL-like syntax to perform graph-style neural computation natively. Reduces engineering overhead of ML-database round trips.

entry.title: MEDAL: Manifold Embedding Distillation via Autoencoder Learning

author.name: Irene Chang, Tarek M. Zikry, Genevera I. Allen

entry.summary: MEDAL distills fitted manifold embeddings (t-SNE, UMAP) into reusable encoder-decoder autoencoders, enabling out-of-sample mapping and quantitative validation. Addresses a known weakness of popular dimensionality reduction.

entry.title: Multicalibration Boosting: Theory, Convergence, and Transferability

author.name: Hanxuan Ye, Hongzhe Li

entry.summary: Unified theoretical perspective on multicalibration boosting subsuming multiaccuracy, BatchGCP, and BatchMVP. Provides new insights on convergence and transferability of calibration.

entry.title: The Multilingual Curse at the Retrieval Layer: Evidence from Amharic

author.name: Yosef Worku Alemneh, Kidist Amde Mekonnen, Maarten de Rijke

entry.summary: Diagnostic study showing strong zero-shot multilingual retrievers severely underperform monolingual Amharic retrievers, challenging assumptions about multilingual transfer. Tests dense, late-interaction, sparse, and cross-encoder paradigms.

entry.title: Lifted Schr\"odinger Bridges for Gaussian Mixture Endpoints: Projection Gaps and Path-Space Obstructions

author.name: Siddhartha Ganguly, George Rapakoulias, Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: Lifted path-space construction for Schrodinger bridges between Gaussian mixture endpoints under Brownian dynamics. Decomposes into component-to-component bridges plus Sinkhorn assignment, with analysis of projection gaps.

entry.title: MVR-cache: Optimizing Semantic Caching via Multi-Vector Retrieval and Learned Prompt Segmentation

author.name: Ali Noshad, Zishan Zheng, Yinjun Wu

entry.summary: MVR-cache improves semantic caching for LLMs via multi-vector retrieval and learnable prompt segmentation with MaxSim similarity. Derives training objective from theoretical analysis maximizing cache hits under correctness constraints.

entry.title: Large Language Model Selection with Limited Annotations

author.name: Yavuz Durmazkeser, Patrik Okanovic, Andreas Kirsch, Torsten Hoefler, Nezihe Merve G\"urel

entry.summary: SELECT-LLM is an active model selection framework that identifies the best LLM for a task using a small set of informative queries, scoring candidates via expected information gain from pairwise output similarities. The approach works without access to model weights and reduces annotation costs for LLM evaluation.

entry.title: Rejoinder: The ICML 2023 Ranking Experiment: Examining Author Self-Assessment in ML/AI Peer Review

author.name: Buxin Su, Jiayao Zhang, Natalie Collina, Yuling Yan, Didong Li, Kyunghyun Cho, Jianqing Fan, Aaron Roth, Weijie Su

entry.summary: Rejoinder to the ICML 2023 ranking experiment discussion, addressing peer-review-as-estimation framing, equity concerns in the Isotonic Mechanism, and human-centered review in the generative AI era. Provides a structured response to discussants.

entry.title: Nystr\"om Kernel Stein Discrepancy Tests

author.name: Florian Kalinke, Zolt\'an Szab\'o, Bharath K. Sriperumbudur

entry.summary: Develops Nystrom-accelerated Kernel Stein Discrepancy goodness-of-fit tests with bootstrap-based null distribution handling, achieving sub-quadratic runtime without losing statistical power. Addresses key scalability bottlenecks in KSD testing.

entry.title: Learning manifold diffusion semigroups from graph transition matrices

author.name: Xiuyuan Cheng, Nan Wu

entry.summary: Shows that the manifold heat semigroup can be approximated by iterating graph transition matrices built from ambient Gaussian kernels, with sup-norm bounds matching classical graph-Laplacian rates. Holds under low regularity, including L-infinity test functions.

entry.title: Guided Flow Matching for Forward and Inverse PDE Problems with Sparse Observations: Algorithm and Theory

author.name: Xifeng Zhang, Jin Zhao

entry.summary: FM4PDE is a flow-matching generative framework for forward and inverse PDE problems with sparse observations, supporting deterministic, stochastic, and hybrid samplers with error guarantees. Includes coercivity-based bounds and logarithmic complexity for the deterministic optimizer.

entry.title: PowLU: An Activation Function for Stable Pre-Training of LLMs

author.name: Peijie Jiang, Yuqi Feng, Cunyin Peng, Qian Zhao, Jia Liu, KunLong Chen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: PowLU is a rational power activation function designed to avoid SwiGLU's approximate quadratic amplification that causes numerical instability in low-precision LLM training. Targets stable large-scale pretraining.

entry.title: Geometry Adaptive Counterfactual Distribution Learning with Diffusion-Guided Smoothing

author.name: Kwangho Kim

entry.summary: Diffusion-guided estimators for counterfactual distribution learning in high dimensions, using semiparametric debiasing combined with geometry-adaptive localization. Removes nuisance bias while aligning smoothing with local outcome geometry.

entry.title: Minimax Limits of k-Fold Cross-Validation via Majority

author.name: Ido Nachum, R\"udiger Urbanke, Thomas Weinberger

entry.summary: Provides a fine-grained analysis of k-fold cross-validation MSE for the majority binary classifier, showing subtle phenomena where existing theory gives vacuous bounds. Offers principled guidance for choosing k.

entry.title: Universal Activation Verbalizer: A Unified Framework for Cross-Model Activation Explanation

author.name: Haiyan Zhao, Zirui He, Guanchu Wang, Ali Payani, Yingcong Li, Mengnan Du

entry.summary: UAV uses a shared decoder with lightweight adapters to verbalize hidden activations from heterogeneous donor models in natural language, enabling cross-model explanation. Supports adapter-only transfer using a frozen decoder-side LoRA.

entry.title: Building an Adversarial Malware Dataset by Family and Type: Generation, Evasion, and Poisoning Evaluation
