author.name: David Ko\v{s}\v{t}\'al, Martin Jure\v{c}ek

entry.summary: Releases a labeled adversarial malware dataset of ~78K samples derived from RawMal-TF, achieving 98.35% and 92.20% evasion against EMBER. Demonstrates susceptibility of malware classifiers to poisoning attacks with as little as 0.5% mislabeled samples.

entry.title: Multi-Persona Debate System for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation

author.name: Jaeha Oh, Byungchan Kim, Ju Li, Yang Jeong Park, Jin-Sung Park

entry.summary: MPDS is a literature-grounded multi-agent debate framework for automated scientific hypothesis generation in battery materials research, with retrieval-based persona induction and structured three-round debate. Combines long-context LLMs with corpus-driven role assignment.

entry.title: Direct Preference Optimization for English-Mandarin Code-Switching Speech Recognition in Audio LLMs

author.name: Trung Nguyen Quang, Cheng Yi Lewis Won, Minh Duc Pham, Yingxu He, Shuo Sun, Ai Ti Aw

entry.summary: Applies DPO to align audio LLMs for English-Mandarin code-switching ASR, addressing language omission, translation-instead-of-transcription, and hallucination failures. Achieves up to 89.6% MER reduction in-distribution.

entry.title: DRInQ: Evaluating Conversational Implicature with Controlled Context Variation

author.name: Hirona Jacqueline Arai, Xiang Ren

entry.summary: DRInQ is a benchmark for evaluating pragmatic reasoning about conversational implicature in question utterances, isolating pragmatic variation while holding surface form fixed. Uses a semi-automated pipeline for systematic context variation.

entry.title: End-to-End Intracortical Speech Decoding from Neural Activity

author.name: Owais Mujtaba Khanday, Jose A. Gonzalez-Lopez, Marc Ouellet, Alberto Galdon, Gonzalo Olivares Granados

entry.summary: End-to-end Conformer-based intracortical speech decoder for an ALS participant achieving 23.80% CER without external language models. Investigates whether meaningful neural-to-character decoding is possible without LM rescoring.

entry.title: AstroMind: A High-Fidelity Benchmark for Spacecraft Behavior Reasoning Based on Large Language Models

author.name: Hao Liu, Siyuan Yang, Qinglei Hu, Dongyu Li

entry.summary: AstroMind is a physics-grounded benchmark for spacecraft behavior reasoning across intent inference, maneuver parameter estimation, and threat assessment, with realistic noise and multi-source textual intelligence. Built on high-fidelity astrodynamics simulations.

entry.title: Word Class Representations Spontaneously Emerge from Successor Representations Trained on Natural Language

author.name: Mathis Immertreu, Achim Schilling, Thomas Kinfe, Patrick Krauss

entry.summary: Trains deep residual networks to predict Successor Representations on WikiText-103, finding that word class structure emerges spontaneously without explicit linguistic supervision. Transfers an RL prediction principle to natural language modeling.

entry.title: CP-Agent: A Calibrated Risk-Controlled Agent for Feedback-Driven Competitive Programming

author.name: Peisong Wang, Bowen Liu, Zehua Li, Yuyao Wang, Zhiwei Ma, Yuhan Li, Jia Li

entry.summary: CP-Agent models feedback-driven competitive programming as a calibrated stopped process with structural certificates that lower-bound success probability before false admission. Focuses on principled use of execution feedback rather than massive sampling.

entry.title: The Tokenizer Tax Across 25 European Languages: Domain Invariance, Cross-Lingual Few-Shot Effects, and the Ukrainian Penalty

author.name: Volodymyr Ovcharov

entry.summary: Empirical study of tokenizer fertility across 25 European languages and 10 foundation models, finding a 2.5x range with Ukrainian paying a 15-18% penalty over cognate Slavic languages due to underrepresentation in training data. Documents systematic tokenization tax.

entry.title: Beyond the Target: From Imitation to Collaboration in Speculative Decoding

author.name: Jinze Li, Yixing Xu, Guanchen Li, Jinfeng Xu, Shuo Yang, Yang Zhang, Xuanwu Yin, Dong Li, Edith C. H. Ngai, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Speculative decoding work showing that draft models sometimes make better token choices than target models, proposing a collaborative paradigm rather than pure imitation. Aims to improve speedup beyond standard accept-on-match SPD.

entry.title: Better, Faster: Harnessing Self-Improvement in Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Qihuang Zhong, Liang Ding, Juhua Liu, Bo Du, Leszek Rutkowski, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: HSIR addresses data imbalance and overthinking in self-improvement training for large reasoning models with two simple approaches that prevent model collapse on complex reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Clarification Is Not Enough: Post-Clarification Answering Remains the Bottleneck in Multi-Turn QA

author.name: Jinyan Su, Jennifer Healey

entry.summary: Decomposes multi-turn QA into clarification policy and post-clarification answering, showing fine-tuning improves clarification decisions rapidly but answer generation after clarification remains the actual bottleneck.

entry.title: Inference Time Optimization with Confidence Dynamics

author.name: Yu Wang, Minghao Liu, Jiayun Wang, Jinrui Huang, Ankit Shah, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Identifies a confidence trajectory pattern where correct reasoning traces show increasing confidence while incorrect ones show declining confidence, proposing Confidence Dynamic Gain voting based on this signal.

entry.title: Learning to Route Languages for Multilingual Policy Optimization

author.name: Geyang Guo, Hiromi Wakaki, Yuki Mitsufuji, Alan Ritter, Wei Xu

entry.summary: LRPO treats language as a selectable variable in RL training, eliciting multilingual rollouts per question with a trainable language router to adaptively choose exploration languages.

entry.title: AuthTrace: Diagnosing Evidence Construction in Thematically Dense Single-Author Corpora

author.name: Xiaoqing Wu, Feifei Li, Haoliang Ming, Wenhui Que

entry.summary: AuthTrace places multiple evidence construction paradigms (chunk retrieval, agent memory, KG traversal, thematic indexing) on a unified corpus to enable cross-paradigm diagnosis, finding evidence recall dominates answer quality.

entry.title: HyLaT: Efficient Multi-Agent Communication via Hybrid Latent-Text Protocol

author.name: Xinyi Mou, Siyuan Wang, Zejun Li, Yulan He, Zhongyu Wei

entry.summary: HyLaT proposes a hybrid latent-text multi-agent communication protocol that uses latent channels for elaborate cognitive signals and natural language for critical signals, addressing the trilemma of efficiency vs interpretability.

entry.title: Harmony in Diversity: Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Zongji Yu, Wenshui Luo, Yiliu Sun, Hao Fang, Runmin Cong, Chaochao Lu, Chen Gong

entry.summary: MCPO is a multi-domain contrastive policy optimization method addressing cross-domain interference in GRPO-style RL by enabling beneficial knowledge transfer across domains rather than just mitigating conflicts.

entry.title: Retrieval as Reasoning: Self-Evolving Agent-Native Retrieval via LLM-Wiki

author.name: Haoliang Ming, Feifei Li, Xiaoqing Wu, Wenhui Que

entry.summary: LLM-Wiki operationalizes Retrieval-as-Reasoning by compiling documents into structured Wiki pages with bidirectional links and search/read/follow tools, treating external knowledge as composable rather than flat chunks.

entry.title: Llamion Technical Report

author.name: Kisu Yang, Yoonna Jang, Hyeonseok Moon, Hwanseok Jang, Taewoo Lee, Hyungjin Lee, Jeseung Lee, Juhyoung Park, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Llamion releases 14B open-weight models transformed from Orion-14B to standard Llama architecture using KEPT recipe with provably optimal LayerNorm-to-RMSNorm initialization and cross-architecture knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Testing the Deliteralization Hypothesis in Human and Machine Translation

author.name: Malik Marmonier, Rachel Bawden, Beno\^it Sagot

entry.summary: Tests the long-standing translation studies hypothesis that translations become less literal through revision, comparing humans, NMT, and six LLMs on WMT24++ across 54 language pairs with a validated Synthetic Literality Index.

entry.title: On the Limits of Model Merging for Multilinguality in Pre-Training

author.name: Seth Aycock, Fedor Vitiugin, Aleksandr Umnov, Christof Monz, Khalil Sima'an

entry.summary: Tests whether language-specific model merging can be applied to monolingually pre-trained models, finding that merging causes performance collapse due to interference and requires representational similarity as a prerequisite.

entry.title: Mitigating Provenance-Role Collapse in Long-Term Agents via Typed Memory Representation

author.name: Zhengda Jin, Bingbing Wang, Jing Li, Ruifeng Xu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: MemIR is a typed memory intermediate representation that separates raw evidence, retrieval cues, and truth-bearing claims to prevent provenance-role collapse and source-monitoring errors in long-term LLM agents.

entry.title: Triplet-Block Diffusion RWKV

author.name: Ke Lin, Yiyang Luo, Zhaolong Su, Yunya Song, Anyi Rao

entry.summary: B3D-RWKV combines RWKV linear-time inference with discrete diffusion bidirectional attention via a triplet-block layout, claiming comparable accuracy at 7.2B with significant decoding throughput gains.

entry.title: Anticipate and Learn: Unleashing Idle-Time Compute in Proactive Agents

author.name: Haoyi Hu, Qirong Lyu, Xianghan Kong, Weiwen Liu, Jianghao Lin, Zixuan Guo, Yan Xu, Yasheng Wang, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu

entry.summary: ProAct uses idle-time compute to proactively anticipate likely upcoming user needs by analyzing dialogue history and persistent memory, acquiring information and preparing evidence before users initiate queries.

entry.title: Adaptive Preference Optimization with Uncertainty-aware Utility Anchor

author.name: Xiaobo Wang, Zixia Jia, Jiaqi Li, Qi Liu, Zilong Zheng

entry.summary: UAPO is a general framework for offline preference optimization with an uncertainty-aware utility anchor, addressing limitations of Bradley-Terry assumptions in DPO-like methods including pairwise data requirements and distribution shifts.

entry.title: SliceWorld: A Predictive and Controllable World-State Model for CT Report Generation

author.name: Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song

entry.summary: SliceWorld treats CT scans as ordered z-axis sequences with factor-aware latent states for anatomy/lesion/uncertainty, supporting multi-step future-slice prediction and lesion-factor intervention for CT report generation.

entry.title: MAGIC: Multimodal Alignment & Grounding-aware Instruction Coreset for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Shristi Das Biswas, Kaushik Roy

entry.summary: MAGIC is a training-free coreset selection method for multimodal instruction tuning that uses three intrinsic signals from pretrained VLMs (Multimodal Gain, Bridging Relevance, etc.) to build compact subsets. Addresses redundancy and imbalance in multimodal training corpora.

entry.title: CoMoGen: COntrollable MOtion Dynamics and Interactions with Mask-Guided Video GENeration

author.name: Adil Meric, Lin Geng Foo, Mert Kiray, Benjamin Busam, Rishabh Dabral, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: CoMoGen generates controllable interactive video dynamics from a single binary mask sequence and input image using a MaskAdapter injected into MMDiT. Identifies Motion Layers in MMDiT attention space for targeted fine-tuning.

entry.title: Flow Mismatching: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection via Velocity Discrepancies in Flow Matching Models

author.name: Shengzhe Chen, Mehrdad Moradi, Kamran Paynabar, Hao Yan

entry.summary: Flow Mismatching detects anomalies by comparing model-predicted velocity from a flow matching model against geometric velocities toward target images. Replaces reconstruction-based paradigms with a geometric dynamics interpretation.

entry.title: Composing People Together: Iterative Pose-Image Generation for Multi-Person Interaction Scenes

author.name: Wenxuan Peng, Bharath Hariharan, Hadar Averbuch-Elor

entry.summary: Introduces a dual pose-image representation for multi-person interaction scene generation in diffusion transformers, jointly predicting 2D pose visualizations and RGB images. Targets compositional accuracy in multi-person scenes where current models often collapse to repetitive layouts.

entry.title: LangFlash: Feed-forward 3D Language Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images

author.name: Yilong Liu, Wanhua Li, Chen Zhu-Tian, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: LangFlash is a feed-forward framework for 3D Language Gaussian Splatting from sparse unposed images, directly predicting geometry and language-aligned semantic features in a single forward pass. Uses a sparse semantic encoding scheme with global dictionary and per-primitive weights.

entry.title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models

author.name: Zizhao Tong, Hongfeng Lai, Zeqing Wang, Zhaohu Xing, Kexu Cheng, Haoran Xu, Zhao Pu, Shangwen Zhu, Ruili Feng, Jian Zhao, Yan Zhang, Hao Tang, Yeying Jin, Ling Shao

entry.summary: SCOPE adapts video diffusion world models for first-person shooter games with spatially selective action conditioning that handles dense local inputs without disrupting unaffected regions. Inserts per-pixel temporal sequence reshaping in each transformer block.

entry.title: Joint Target-Less Intrinsic and Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Point Correspondences

author.name: Simon Bultmann, Daniele Cattaneo, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Presents the first fully target-less pipeline for jointly estimating camera intrinsics (pinhole + radial-tangential distortion) and camera-LiDAR extrinsics using deep pixel-point correspondences. Includes structure-from-motion intrinsic initialization for raw images.

entry.title: ComPose: When to Trust Hands for Object Pose Tracking

author.name: Jisu Shin, Junoh Lee, JunGyu Lee, Inhwan Bae, Dohyeon Lee, Hokyun Im, Youngwoon Lee, Hae-Gon Jeon

entry.summary: ComPose treats hands as complementary cues rather than just occluders for 6DoF object pose tracking from RGB video. Combines object and hand cues from foundation models for hand-aware object tracking under severe occlusion.

entry.title: PathNavigate: A Training-Free Pathology Agent with Surprise-Guided Scan and Shared Slide Memory for Whole-Slide Image VQA

author.name: Chunze Yang, Qidong Liu, Wenjie Zhao, Yue Tang, Jiusong Ge, Di Zhang, Jiashuai Liu, Lei Wu, Junbo Lu, Ni Zhang, Xian Wu, Zeyu Gao, Chen Li

entry.summary: PathNavigate is a training-free pathology agent with surprise-guided scan and shared slide memory for whole-slide image VQA. Decouples navigation from task-specific supervision unlike supervised pathology MLLMs.

entry.title: EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation

author.name: Jente Vandersanden, Matheus Gadelha, Chun-Hao P. Huang, Hyeonho Jeong, Yulia Gryaditskaya

entry.summary: EM-Vid is a training-free entity-centric memory for multi-shot video generation using an entity-indexed bank of latent patches and sparse token conditioning. Reduces irrelevant information leakage and computational cost from full-frame memory.

entry.title: Vision Transformers Need Better Token Interaction

author.name: Linxiang Su

entry.summary: Diagnoses semantic diffusion as an optimization shortcut where global semantics spread through ViT patch tokens, degrading dense prediction quality during prolonged training. Proposes interventions to preserve local token quality.

entry.title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers

author.name: Shuhong Zheng, Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandstr\"om, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage token selection (inter-frame then intra-frame) for visual geometry transformers to reduce quadratic attention cost in multi-view 3D reconstruction. Includes Tombari and other Google authors.

entry.title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning

author.name: Beichen Zhang, Yuhong Liu, Jinsong Li, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: ETCHR decouples a dedicated image editing model from an understanding model for the think-with-images paradigm in MLLMs, addressing language-side and editor-side gaps. From Shanghai AI Lab.

entry.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward

author.name: Zizun Li, Haoyu Guo, Runzhe Teng, Chunhua Shen, Tong He

entry.summary: Geo-Align presents the first RL framework for camera-controlled video re-rendering using metric geometry rewards to bridge sim-to-real generalization gaps in physical scale and camera trajectory adherence.

entry.title: Afford-VLA: Action-Aligned Visual Planning via Internalized Affordance

author.name: Runze Wang, Yuqian Fu, Yu Li, Tao Lin, Tianwen Qian, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Bo Zhao, Yanwei Fu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: Afford-VLA internalizes affordance prediction as visual planning that is local, visually grounded, and directly aligned with action prediction in VLA models.

entry.title: ECo-MoE: Embodiment-Conditioned Mixture of Experts Increases the Evolvability of Robots

author.name: Yibin Wang, Muhan Li, Zihan Guo, Sam Kriegman

entry.summary: ECo-MoE co-evolves robot designs with embodiment-conditioned mixture-of-experts controllers, gated by latent design coordinates. From Sam Kriegman's group.

entry.title: Extending Embodied Question Answering from Perception to Decision

author.name: Xicheng Gong, Qiwei Li, Peiran Xu, Yadong Mu

entry.summary: EQA-Decision is a large-scale embodied QA dataset with 4M+ QA pairs spanning static scenes, spatial reasoning, task dynamics, and decisions, extending embodied QA from perception into action.

entry.title: AnyScene: Towards Highly Controllable Driving Scene Generation at Anywhere and Beyond

author.name: Haiming Zhang, Junfei Zhou, Feng Jiang, Jingzhong Li, Zhenglong Guo, Penglin Dai, Jifeng Dai, Yan Xie, Benjin Zhu

entry.summary: AnyScene is an occupancy-centric framework for driving scene generation using a Spatial-Temporal Occupancy Diffusion Transformer, enabling fine-grained control from arbitrary BEV layouts for synthetic data generation.

entry.title: Drift-Resistant Navigation World Model with Anchored Epipolar Guidance

author.name: Po-Chien Luan, Zimin Xia, Wuyang Li, Yang Gao, Alexandre Alahi

entry.summary: Drift-Resistant Navigation World Model addresses perceptual and geometric drift in rollout-based navigation world models via anchor-guided rollouts that predict sparse future anchors first, then fill intermediate frames. From Alahi's group at EPFL.

entry.title: Multi-view Consistent 3D Gaussian Head Avatars 'without' Multi-view Generation

author.name: Aviral Chharia, Fernando De la Torre

entry.summary: MVCHead generates multi-view consistent 3D Gaussian head avatars from randomly sampled 2D images without multi-view data or 3D supervision, using a hierarchical state space block. From CMU.

entry.title: Pope Leo’s First AI Encyclical – Summary and Commentary

author.name: John-Clark Levin

entry.summary: Commentary and summary of Pope Leo XIV's encyclical Magnifica Humanitas on AI, addressing governance, human dignity, worker protections, and existential concerns. Marks a significant Catholic Church engagement with AI.

entry.title: Coloring the Noise: Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for Faithful Image Super Resolution

author.name: Hongbo Wang, Huaibo Huang, Pin Wang, Jinhua Hao, Chao Zhou, Ran He

entry.summary: ASASR proposes Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for image super-resolution, recasting generative flow into a Sobolev-induced Riemannian geometry to align with natural image spectral decay. Aims to distinguish authentic high-frequency details from hallucinations.

entry.title: Efficient One-Step Diffusion Restoration Model with Compact Token Compression and Linear Attention

author.name: Bingtian Qiao, Yue Shi, Yingjie Zhou, Yong Guo, Guangtao Zhai, Jiezhang Cao

entry.summary: Proposes a one-step diffusion super-resolution model with compact token compression and linear attention to address token redundancy in real-world image restoration. Targets unfavorable scaling of computation with resolution in current methods.

entry.title: CVSearch: Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Cognitive Visual Search for High-Resolution Image Perception

author.name: Liupeng Li, Haoqian Kang, Zhenyu Lu, Jinpeng Wang, Bin Chen, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang

entry.summary: CVSearch is a training-free adaptive framework for high-resolution image perception in MLLMs that dynamically schedules expert-assisted and semantic-aware scanning. Addresses the coverage-efficiency trade-off in visual search.

entry.title: When Does Synthetic Patent Data Help? Volume-Fidelity Trade-offs in Low-Resource Multi-Label Classification

author.name: Amirhossein Yousefiramandi, Ciaran Cooney

entry.summary: Studies when LLM-generated synthetic data helps low-resource patent classification, using a duplicate-to-match control to separate true synthetic value from volume effects. Finds gains are largely volume-driven.

entry.title: Test-Time Deep Thinking to Explore Implicit Rules

author.name: Wentong Chen, Xin Cong, Zhong Zhang, Yaxi Lu, Siyuan Zhao, Yesai Wu, Qinyu Luo, Haotian Chen, Yankai Lin, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: TTExplore is a test-time framework where a thinker analyzes interaction history to infer implicit rules and guide an actor in environments with hidden constraints, addressing repetitive trial-and-error failures.

entry.title: Clustering as Reasoning: A $k$-Means Interpretation of Chain-of-Thought Graph Learning

author.name: Xuanting Xie, Zhaochen Guo, Bingheng Li, Xingtong Yu, Zhifei Liao, Zhao Kang, Yuan Fang

entry.summary: KCoT unifies chain-of-thought reasoning with graph representation learning by establishing a formal k-means correspondence between iterative CoT reasoning over text-attributed graphs and clustering.

entry.title: SimuWoB: Simulating Real-World Mobile Apps for Fast and Faithful GUI Agent Benchmarking

author.name: Guohong Liu, Jialei Ye, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Yunxin Liu, Yuanchun Li

entry.summary: SimuWoB is a fully synthetic benchmark for mobile GUI agents with 120 tasks across diverse types and difficulties built via a virtual environment generation framework, addressing the gap between basic-grounding benchmarks and real-world use.

entry.title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models

author.name: Andrew Corbett, Archit Sood, Anna Tzatzopoulou, Sai-Aakash Ramesh, Tim Dodwell

entry.summary: Reinterprets recursive reasoning architectures as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with guided stochastic exploration using stochastic perturbations and online reweighting via early-stopping heads.

entry.title: Meta-Agent: From Task Descriptions to Verified Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Andy Xu, Yu-Wing Tai

entry.summary: Meta-Agent automatically constructs and executes verified multi-agent systems from natural-language task descriptions via a planner that builds DAGs of agent specifications with input/output contracts, plus web-grounded specifications and code generation.

entry.title: Towards end-to-end LLM-based censoring-aware survival analysis

author.name: Yishu Wei, Hexin Dong, Yi Lin, Jiahe Qian, Yi Liu, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: LLMSurvival reformulates censored time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects using unmodified LLMs on tabular clinical data, with anchor-based test-time risk aggregation.

entry.title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents

author.name: Yanzhou Li, Yiran Zhang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Xiaoxia Liu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: CODESKILL is an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance for coding agents as a learnable management policy, extracting multi-granularity procedural skills from trajectories.

entry.title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions

author.name: Jingwei Sun, Jianing Zhu, Yuanyi Li, Tongliang Liu, Xia HU, Bo Han

entry.summary: AgentHijack is a benchmark for computer-use agent robustness under 9 common environment corruptions (pop-ups, resolution changes, competing applications) that disrupt execution without adversarial intent.

entry.title: Rethinking Federated Unlearning via the Lens of Memorization

author.name: Jiaheng Wei, Yanjun Zhang, He Zhang, Leo Yu Zhang, Chao Chen, Kok-Leong Ong, Jun Zhang, Yang Xiang

entry.summary: Reframes federated unlearning through memorization, proposing Grouped Memorization Evaluation to separate unique vs. overlapping knowledge. Aims to remove only knowledge unique to forgotten data.

entry.title: HoloFair: Unified T2I Fairness Evaluation and Fair-GRPO Debiasing

author.name: Ruyi Chen, Lu Zhou, Xiaogang Xu, Chiyu Zhang, Jiafei Wu, Liming Fang

entry.summary: HoloFair is a benchmark framework for multidimensional demographic bias in text-to-image models, with the SpaFreq attribute classifier and MGBI metric. Includes Fair-GRPO, a reinforcement learning method for debiasing.

entry.title: Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement for LVLM Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Ruoxi Cheng, Haoxuan Ma, Zhengfei Hai, Yiyan Huang, Ranjie Duan, Tianle Zhang, Xu Yang, Ziyi Ye, Xingjun Ma

entry.summary: AOD mitigates LVLM hallucinations by learning a hallucination-related direction via adversarial minimax to disentangle hallucination signals into a projected component. Latent geometric framework requiring no external interventions.

entry.title: Exploiting Longitudinal Context in Clinician-Verified Interactive Lesion Tracking

author.name: Yannick Kirchhoff, Maximilian Rokuss, Daniel Philipp Mertens, David F\"uller, Benjamin Hamm, Andreas Schreyer, Oliver Ritter, Klaus Maier-Hein

entry.summary: Proposes a Verified Tracking paradigm for oncological CT lesion tracking where clinicians verify registration-proposed prompts that the model uses alongside baseline lesion appearance. Combines spatial prompt fusion with latent temporal difference weighting.

entry.title: SimInsert: Seamless Video Object Insertion via Regional Sparse Attention Fusion

author.name: Xinyu Chen, Yuyi Qian, Jiang Lin, Shenyi Wang, Gao Wang, Zhiqiu Zhang, Jizhi Zhang, Mingjie Wang, Qiang Tang, Qian Wang, Song Wu, Zili Yi

entry.summary: SimInsert is a training-free video object insertion paradigm decoupling the task into single-frame editing and semantic motion description. Leverages image-to-video diffusion priors to propagate edits temporally while preserving background.

entry.title: DepthAgent: Towards Better Universal Depth Estimation via Sample-wise Expert Selection

author.name: Jie Zhu, Girish Chandar Ganesan, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: DepthAgent is a vision-language-driven framework for monocular metric depth that selects sample-wise depth experts based on camera geometry. Exploits complementary strengths of different models across perspective, fisheye, and panoramic inputs.

entry.title: CHASD: Language Increment-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding against Hallucination in LVLMs

author.name: Xiaoyi Huang, Kejia Zhang, Zhiming Luo

entry.summary: CHASD proposes language increment-calibrated contrastive decoding for LVLMs, applying token-specific calibration only when needed rather than at every step. Reduces overhead while addressing hallucinations from language prior dominance.

entry.title: RiGS: Rigid-aware 4D Gaussian Splatting from a Single Monocular Video

author.name: Chenyu Wu, Wanhua Li, Zhu-Tian Chen, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: RiGS introduces three types of Gaussian primitives (static, rigid, transient) to capture multi-scale motion in monocular dynamic scene reconstruction. Uses object-wise dynamic masks to separate long-term smooth transformations from short-term complex deformations.

entry.title: Learning a Particle Dynamics Model with Real-world Videos

author.name: Chanho Kim, Suhas V. Sumukh, Li Fuxin

entry.summary: Trains a particle-dynamics world model from real-world videos rather than simulated data, addressing the sim-to-real gap in differentiable physics simulation.

entry.title: Efficient Learned Image Compression without Entropy Coding

author.name: Hao Cao, Wenqi Guo, Zhijin Qin, Jungong Han

entry.summary: EF-LIC eliminates entropy coding in learned image compression via unconstrained vector quantization with provably near-maximum-entropy index distribution and context-conditioned autoregressive transforms.

entry.title: Learning High-Frequency Continuous Action Chunks in Latent Space

author.name: Kunyun Wang, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Jieru Zhao, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: Learns high-frequency (60Hz) action chunks in a VAE latent space with a Reuse-then-Refine scheme to maintain temporal/spatial consistency in robot policies.

entry.title: Toward Reliable Design of LLM-Enabled Agentic Workflows: Optimizing Latency-Reliability-Cost Tradeoffs

author.name: Ya-Ting Yang, Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Analyzes latency-reliability-cost tradeoffs in LLM-enabled agentic workflows, introducing performance models and a water-filling token allocation policy. Provides theoretical grounding for workflow design under constraints.

entry.title: Methods for Formal Verification of Agent Skills: Three Layers Toward a Mechanically Checkable Capability-Containment Proof

author.name: Alfredo Metere

entry.summary: Presents three composable methods (static analysis, refinement types, formal verification) to raise agent-skill verification to a mechanically checkable level for capability-containment proofs. Aims at formal safety guarantees.

entry.title: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems

author.name: Ruizhe Zhou, Xiaoyang Liu, Gaoyuan Du, Yi Zheng, Shouxi Ren, Deepayan Chakrabarti, Dengdu Jiang

entry.summary: Survey of reproducibility and determinism failures in financial AI systems across tabular models, graph networks, and LLM agentic workflows. Highlights hardware-level nondeterminism in regulated finance contexts.

entry.title: Why We Need World Models for AGI: Where LLMs Fail and How World Models May Outperform

author.name: Feisal Alaswad, Batoul Aljaddouh, Maher Alrahhal, Poovammal E, Talal Bonny

entry.summary: Argues LLM limitations in causal reasoning, state tracking, and planning stem from sequence-prediction objectives mismatched with latent environment dynamics. Introduces Flux, a language-rule-based reasoning environment.

entry.title: Safety-Oriented Routing Analysis of Mixtral MoE Under Benign and Harmful Prompts

author.name: Md Nurul Absar Siddiky

entry.summary: Analyzes Mixtral 8x7B routing behavior under benign and harmful prompts using activation and gradient-based scores, finding broad activation-based usage but concentrated gradient-based importance with little safety differentiation.

entry.title: Adaptive Human-AI Coordination via Hierarchical Action Disentanglement

author.name: Adnan Ahmad, Bahareh Nakisa, Mohammad Naim Rastgoo

entry.summary: Intrinsic Action Disentanglement uses an intrinsic reward to encourage distinct partner-aware low-level action sequences in hierarchical RL for human-AI coordination. Improves robustness to unseen partners.

entry.title: Distilling Game Code World Model Generation into Lightweight Large Language Models

author.name: Tyrone Serapio, Arjun Prakash, Haoyang Xu, Kevin Wang, Amy Greenwald

entry.summary: Distills frontier model game code world model generation into lightweight LLMs, producing Python implementations of game rules compatible with MCTS solvers. Targets accessibility of code world model construction.

entry.title: ConceptM$^3$oE: Concept-Guided Multimodal Mixture of Experts for Interpretable Computational Pathology

author.name: Xuan Wang, Zhongling Xu, Gopi Kannedhara, Joakim Nguyen, Jian Yu, Jinrui Fang, Abdurrahmaan Baghdadi, Tianlong Chen, Awais Naeem, Chandra Krishnan, Edward Castillo, Andrew H. Song, Ankita Shukla, Ying Ding, Nicholas Konz, Hairong Wang

entry.summary: ConceptM3oE embeds concept formation within interaction-aware mixture-of-experts pathways for interpretable multimodal computational pathology, decomposing evidence into modality-specific, redundant, and synergistic experts.

entry.title: Advancing Graph Few-Shot Learning via In-Context Learning

author.name: Renchu Guan, Yajun Wang, Chunli Guo, Bowen Cao, Fausto Giunchiglia, Wei Pang, Yonghao Liu, Xiaoyue Feng

entry.summary: VISION reframes graph few-shot learning as in-context learning, leveraging unlabeled nodes and avoiding complex task adaptation during inference. Inspired by LLM in-context capabilities.

entry.title: JT-SAFE-V2: Safety-by-Design Foundation Model with World-Context Data

author.name: Junlan Feng, Fanyu Meng, Chong Long, Pengyu Cong, Duqing Wang, Yan Zheng, Yuyao Zhang, Xuanchang Gao, Ye Yuan, Yunfei Ma, Zhijie Ren, Fan Yang, Na Wu, Di Jin, Chao Deng

entry.summary: JT-Safe-V2 advances safety-by-design via contextual world knowledge in pretraining, high-certainty training procedures, and post-training safety strengthening. Introduces Safe-MoMA framework for enterprise agentic capabilities.

entry.title: TIGER: Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Keyan Ding, Peilin Chen, Han Liu, Can Lin, Ruixi Chen, Shiqi Wang, Qi Song

entry.summary: TIGER uses protein-to-text generation models to distill textual semantic knowledge from enzyme sequences for bidirectional enzyme-reaction retrieval. Targets generalization across tasks and distributions.

entry.title: DemoEvolve: Overcoming Sparse Feedback in Agentic Harness Evolution with Demonstrations

author.name: Lirong Che, Yuzhe yang, Peiwen lin, Chuang wang, Xueqian wang, Jian su

entry.summary: DemoEvolve overcomes sparse feedback in agentic harness evolution by bootstrapping with demonstrations, enabling sample-efficient adaptation in long-horizon stochastic environments without weight updates.

entry.title: GlobalDentBench: A Multinational Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Clinical Reasoning in Dentistry with Expert Calibration

author.name: Junjie Zhao, Jingyi Liang, Zhenyang Cai, Jiaming Zhang, Zhenwei Wen, Shuzhi Deng, Wenjing Yi, Chunfeng Luo, Hexian Zhang, Junying Chen, Tianrui Liu, Zhuhui Bai, Zixu Zhang, Pradeep Singh, Xiang Liu, Jianquan Li, Nhan L Tran, Falk Schwendicke, Zuolin Jin, Lijian Jin, Liangyi Chen, Wei-fa Yang, Benyou Wang, Junwen Wang, Shan Jiang

entry.summary: GlobalDentBench is the first multinational dental benchmark for LLM clinical reasoning, with 8,978 expert-validated questions across 14 specialties and 88 countries, evaluating three progressive reasoning levels.

entry.title: Solving Combinatorial Counting Problems with Weighted First-Order Model Counting

author.name: Yuanhong Wang, Juhua Pu, Yuxu Zhou, Yuyi Wang, Ond\v{r}ej Ku\v{z}elka

entry.summary: Cofola is a typed declarative language for combinatorial counting problems built on weighted first-order model counting, preserving exchangeability across sets, bags, tuples, permutations, partitions, and compositions.

entry.title: Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models through Region-Aware Attention Recalibration

author.name: Yuanzhi Xu, Qian Gao, Jun Fan, Guohui Ding, Zhenyu Yang, Sixue Lin, Yuteng Xiao

entry.summary: Training-free region-aware attention recalibration method for reducing object hallucinations in vision-language models using outlier-resistant statistical midpoints across attention heads to correct semantic drift.

entry.title: NeurIPS: Neuro-anatomical Inductive Priors for Sphere-based Brain Decoding

author.name: Sijin Yu, Zijiao Chen, Zhenyu Yang, Zihao Tan, Jiakun Xu, Zhongliang Liu, Shengxian Chen, Wenxuan Wu, Xiangmin Xu, Xin Zhang

entry.summary: NeurIPS framework improves fMRI brain decoding with Selective ROI Spherical Tokenizer and Structure-Guided Mixture of Experts that uses anatomical variation as a predictive prior rather than nuisance.

entry.title: AION: Next-Generation Tasks and Practical Harness for Time Series

author.name: Tianxiang Zhan, Xiaobao Song, Tong Guan, Shirui Pan, Ming Jin

entry.summary: AION is a time series harness with six component groups (agents, skills, rules, memory, evaluation, protocols) and three design principles (temporal grounding, knowledge-grounded reasoning, reliability) for next-gen time series tasks beyond fixed forecasting.

entry.title: DarkForest: Less Talk, Higher Accuracy for Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Yi Li, Songtao Wei, Dongming Jiang, Zhichun Guo, Qiannan Li, Bingzhe Li

entry.summary: DarkForest is a controlled-communication multi-agent LLM framework where agents first answer independently, then responses are parsed and grouped to avoid error propagation from raw response sharing while reducing tokens.

entry.title: LipoAgent: Coordinating Fine-Tuned LLM Agents for Safer Lipid Design

author.name: Leshu Li, An Lu, Haiyu Wang, Zhibin Feng, Conghui Duan, Qing Bao, Zongmin Zhao, Sai Qian Zhang

entry.summary: LipoAgent is a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid nanoparticle design with conditional prediction enforcing toxicity as prerequisite for efficiency prediction, plus multi-agent verification and human oversight.

entry.title: Beyond Query Memorization: Large Language Model Routing with Query Decomposition and Historical Matching

author.name: Bo Lv, Jingbo Sun

entry.summary: DecoR is an LLM routing framework that recasts routing as matching similar queries from historical logs via query capability deconstruction decoupling surface forms from task requirements, mitigating memorization traps and improving OOD generalization.

entry.title: Uncertainty Reasoning with Large Language Models for Explainable Disease Diagnosis

author.name: Xiaoyang Fan, Yufan Cai, Zhe Hou, Jin Song Dong

entry.summary: Neuro-symbolic reasoning framework aligning LLMs with fuzzy logic for explainable disease diagnosis, extracting structured entities and decoding into symbolic knowledge bases with formal verifiability.

entry.title: Insuring Every Action: An Authority Frontier Framework for Runtime Actuarial Control of Autonomous AI Agents

author.name: Hao-Hsuan Chen

entry.summary: Actuarial Action Interface (AAI) is a deterministic runtime contract pricing each agent action against a contractually fixed safe default under a time-consistent risk mapping, with quote-bind-commit protocol and seven-class action taxonomy.

entry.title: MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning

author.name: Aritra Dutta, Somak Aditya

entry.summary: Introduces MuCRASP, a structured pruning method for vision-language models that preserves chain-of-thought reasoning by identifying pivot tokens in generation trajectories. Addresses VLM-specific deployment cost concerns.

entry.title: From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI

author.name: Shangding Gu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing the next bottleneck in agentic AI is system scaling rather than model scaling, proposing the harness around foundation models as a first-class design object. Calls for evaluating memory, retrieval, orchestration, and verification beyond final-task success.

entry.title: AI-Driven Alpha Decay: Algorithmic Homogenization, Reflexive Signal Erosion, and the Paradox of Intelligent Markets

author.name: Shuchen Meng, Xupeng Chen

entry.summary: Theoretical paper deriving a model showing AI-driven investment strategies are self-defeating at scale due to signal crowding and reflexive erosion. Estimates current AI-era alpha half-life at 18 months versus 5-7 years pre-AI.

entry.title: Artificial Effort

author.name: Federico Belotti, Stefano Coniglio, Antonio Cosma, Francesco Fallucchi

entry.summary: Tests whether real-effort tasks in experimental economics can be automated by 23 LLMs across 8 canonical tasks. Finds most tasks are now solvable cheaply and accurately, undermining experimental economics validity assumptions.

entry.title: Catching The Correct Answer Trap: Characterising AI Tutor Blind Spots When Analysing Student Reasoning

author.name: Moiz Imran, Sahan Bulathwela

entry.summary: Identifies the correct answer trap where AI tutors miss flawed reasoning when students reach correct numerical answers. Shows 71% of failures concentrate in two question types and frontier LLMs only modestly outperform fine-tuned T5.

entry.title: SODE: Analyzing Social Dynamics in LLM Agents

author.name: Inseo Jung, Yoonseok Oh, Kyungryul Back, Jinkyu Kim, Jungbeom Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SODE framework for evaluating LLM agents on social dynamics including direct reciprocity, indirect reciprocity, and group dynamics. Goes beyond outcome metrics to evaluate strategy mechanisms.

entry.title: EchoDistill:Alignment Noisy-to-Clean Self-Distillation for Robust Audio LLMs

author.name: Liang Lin, Chunxi Luo, Kaiwen Luo, Jie Zhang, Jin Wang, Yuanhe Zhang, Cai Yuchen, Qiankun Li, Gongli Xi, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Junhao Dong

entry.summary: EchoDistill is a self-distillation framework for robust audio LLMs against real-world noise, using a frozen clean-audio teacher to align noisy-audio student via GRPO. Targets semantic drift and hallucinations from acoustic noise.

entry.title: Multimodal Alignment and Preference Optimization for Zero-Shot Conditional RNA Generation

author.name: Roman Klypa, Alberto Bietti, Sergei Grudinin

entry.summary: Moirain combines multimodal supervised fine-tuning with DPO for zero-shot conditional RNA sequence generation targeting protein interactions. Multi-stage alignment for functional RNA design.

entry.title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Arash Akbari, Arman Akbari, Masih Eskandar, Qitao Tan, Yixiao Chen, Jingwu Luo, Bertha Pangaribuan, Liyun Zhang, Jennifer Dy, Geng Yuan, Xue Lin, Gaowen Liu, Stratis Ioannidis, Yanzhi Wang

entry.summary: ActQuant proposes sub-4-bit action-guided mixed-precision quantization for vision-language-action models targeting edge deployment. Allocates bits per matrix based on action prediction contribution.

entry.title: Mode-as-Sequence: Translating Multimodal Motion Prediction into Unified Sequential Mode Modeling

author.name: Zikang Zhou, Haibo Hu, Xinhong Chen, Yifan Zhang, Nan Guan, Yung-Hui Li, Chun Jason Xue, Jianping Wang

entry.summary: Mode-as-Sequence translates unordered mode sets in motion forecasting to ordered sequences with explicit mode-to-mode dependency. Addresses mode collapse and unreliable confidence ranking in autonomous driving prediction.

entry.title: Mixture of Complementary Agents for Robust LLM Ensemble

author.name: Yichi Zhang, Kevin Lu, Yuang Zhang, Jie Gao, Lirong Xia, Fang-Yi Yu

entry.summary: Reframes proposer LLM selection in multi-agent ensembles as combinatorial optimization based on complementarity rather than just accuracy or diversity. Considers interactions among proposers and summarizer.

entry.title: Signs Beat Floats: Low-Rank Double-Binary Adaptation for On-Device Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yoshihiko Fujisawa, Yuma Ichikawa, Yudai Fujimoto, Akira Sakai, Katsuki Fujisawa

entry.summary: LoRDBA replaces both LoRA factors with binary sign carriers plus channel-wise scales for on-device fine-tuning. Converts dense adapter into sign-accumulation matrix multiplications.

entry.title: MASt3R-Nav: WayPixel Navigation in Relative 3D Maps

author.name: Vansh Garg, Rohit Jayanti, Krish Pandya, Sarthak Chittawar, Siddharth Tourani, Muhammad Haris Khan, Sourav Garg, Madhava Krishna

entry.summary: MASt3R-Nav proposes pixel-relative connectivity maps for visual navigation that are geometrically accurate but lack global consistency. Builds maps from image sequences via 3D grounded image matching.

entry.title: Knowledge Graph Modulated Deep Learning for Limited-Sample Clinical Data Analysis

author.name: Yuwei Xue, Sakib Mostafa, James Zou, Joseph Liao, Maximilian Diehn, Ash A. Alizadeh, Lei Xing, Md. Tauhidul Islam

entry.summary: Introduces Graph-in-Graph (GiG), a framework that uses biological knowledge graphs to modulate deep learning for limited-sample clinical prediction. Aims to preserve structural biological information typically lost in compressed representations.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Transfer Learning with Structurally Missing Covariates, with Application to Cross-National Cardiac Arrest Prediction

author.name: Siqi Li, Chuan Hong, Ziye Tian, Benjamin Sieu-Hon Leong, Koshi Nakagawa, Hideharu Tanaka, Sang Do Shin, Khuong Quoc Dai, Do Ngoc Son, Marcus Eng Hock Ong, Nan Liu, Molei Liu

entry.summary: DRUM is a distributionally robust transfer learning framework for clinical prediction when key covariates are structurally missing at deployment. Applied to cross-national out-of-hospital cardiac arrest prediction.

entry.title: Towards Evaluation Engineering: An Empirical Study of ML Evaluation Harnesses in the Wild

author.name: Zhimin Zhao, Zehao Wang, Abdul Ali Bangash, Bram Adams, Ahmed E. Hassan

entry.summary: Empirical study of 57 ML evaluation harnesses analyzing 16,560 issues, finding 41.4% concentrate in the Specification stage. Argues for evaluation engineering as a discipline.

entry.title: Attested Tool-Server Admission: A Security Extension to the Model Context Protocol

author.name: Alfredo Metere

entry.summary: Proposes mcp-attested, a security extension to the Model Context Protocol providing attested tool-server admission for LLM agents. Bounds which tools an agent may use without modifying MCP itself.

entry.title: ChaosBench-Logic v2: Evaluating LLM Logical Reasoning over Dynamical Systems at Scale

author.name: Noel Thomas

entry.summary: ChaosBench-Logic v2 is a 40K-question benchmark over 165 dynamical systems for evaluating LLM logical reasoning. Introduces CARE protocol exposing prior collapse, paraphrase inconsistency, and dynamics reasoning failures.

entry.title: VectorArk: Learning Practical Image Vectorization with Rounded Polygon Representation

author.name: Tarun Gehlaut, Difan Liu, Charu Bansal, Krutik Malani, Souymodip Chakraborty, Ankit Phogat, Matthew Fisher, Vineet Batra

entry.summary: VectorArk is a VLM-based image vectorization model using a novel rounded polygon representation. Includes a degradation model for robustness to text-to-image generated inputs and unknown rasterizations.

entry.title: {\Phi}-Noise: Training-Free Temporal Video Conditioning via Phase-Based Noise Manipulation

author.name: Ofir Abramovich, Nadav Z. Cohen, Adi Rosenthal, Ariel Shamir

entry.summary: Phi-Noise is a training-free method for motion-conditioned video diffusion that injects low-frequency phase information from a reference video into diffusion noise latents. Requires no architecture changes.

entry.title: Beyond Generative Priors: Minority Sampling with JEPA-Guided Diffusion

author.name: Sol Park, Soobin Um

entry.summary: Proposes a world-centric perspective on minority sampling in diffusion models, using JEPA-guided diffusion to define rarity by real-world priors rather than generator-induced densities.

entry.title: Demystifying the Mythos or Disrupting Bugonomics? From Zero-Day Asymmetry to Defender Remediation Throughput

author.name: Alfredo Pesoli, Herman Errico, Lorenzo Cavallaro

entry.summary: Examines economic incentives (bugonomics) of LLM-driven vulnerability discovery, contrasting defender remediation throughput with traditional offense-priced zero-day markets. Argues AI may rebalance offense-defense costs.

entry.title: On the Stability and Realizability of Recurrent Polynomial Surrogate Ternary Logic Gate Networks

author.name: Sai Sandeep Damera, Ryan Matheu, Aniruddh G. Puranic, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Recurrent Differentiable Ternary Logic Gate Network for online STL verdict prediction operating over Kleene three-valued logic. Trains with polynomial surrogates and hardens to discrete ternary circuits at inference.

entry.title: TS-Skill: A Benchmark for Evaluating Analytical Skills in Time-Series Question Answering

author.name: Liying Han, Kang Yang, Oliver Wang, Jason Wu, Pengrui Quan, Gaofeng Dong, Ozan Baris Mulayim, Sizhe Ma, Yuyang Yuan, Dezhi Hong, Mario Berges, Mani Srivastava

entry.summary: TS-Skill is a benchmark for evaluating three composable analytical skills in time-series QA: temporal scale selection, localization, and cross-interval integration. Provides diagnostic capability assessment for TSLMs.

entry.title: Who judges the judges? Governance from metrics: a runtime framework for continuous LLM compliance monitoring

author.name: Jehanne Dussert

entry.summary: Proposes governance from metrics: deriving regulatory compliance as a continuous runtime signal rather than binary audit-time verdicts. Presents govllm, an open-source compliance-driven routing framework targeting EU AI Act.

entry.title: Motion-Compensated Weight Compression

author.name: Ismail Lamaakal

entry.summary: Motion-Compensated Weight Compression aligns permutation-symmetric blocks across layers to exploit cross-layer redundancy. Encodes only quantized prediction residuals using a learned entropy model.

entry.title: Disentangled Double Machine Learning for Accurate Causal Effect Estimation

author.name: Guodu Xiang, Kui Yu, Yujie Wang, Richang Hong, Fuyuan Cao, Jiye Liang

entry.summary: Disentangled Double Machine Learning improves causal effect estimation by separating latent factors when learning nuisance functions, addressing finite-sample bias in DML. Methodological contribution to causal inference.

entry.title: Adversarial Error Correction for Visual Autoregressive Generation

author.name: Ligong Bi, Tao Huang, Jianyuan Guo, Chang Xu

entry.summary: AID-VAR adds GAN-style discriminator feedback to visual autoregressive generation to correct cascading errors across scales. Plug-and-play improvement to VAR image synthesis.

entry.title: Factorize to Generalize: Retrieval-Guided Invariant-Dynamic Decomposition for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jinjin Chi, Lei Feng, Lulu Zhang, Yongcheng Jing, Yiming Wang, Ximing Li, Jialie Shen, Leszek Rutkowski, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Decomposes time series into invariant trend structure and instance-specific dynamics for retrieval-augmented forecasting, addressing oscillation issues with retrieval-based TSFMs. Targeted fix for distribution shift in time-series foundation models.

entry.title: Selective Test-Time Compute Scaling for Click-Through Rate Prediction via Uncertainty-Triggered Feature Path Exploration

author.name: Moyu Zhang, Yun Chen, Yujun Jin, Jinxin Hu, Yu Zhang, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: UTTSI applies test-time compute scaling to CTR prediction by triggering deeper inference for uncertain instances. Brings TTC ideas from LLMs to industrial recsys.

entry.title: D3S2: Diffusion-Guided Dataset Distillation for Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Wenjie Zheng, Haoji Hu, Jiali Lu, Xingze Zou, Jing Wang

entry.summary: D3S2 is a diffusion-guided dataset distillation framework for semantic segmentation, addressing class imbalance and pixel-wise alignment with class-balanced mask selection. Extends DD beyond classification.

entry.title: TinyFormer: Preserving Tiny Objects in YOLO-DETRHybridReal-time Detectors

author.name: Jun-Wei Hsieh, Meng-Yu Kao, Ghufron Wahyu Kurniawan, Kuan-Chuan Peng

entry.summary: TinyFormer is a YOLO-DETR hybrid with a Parallel Bi-fusion Module for tiny-object detection, combining ViT representations with NMS-free set prediction. Architectural contribution to small-object detection.

entry.title: GL-LFGNN:A Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network Based on Liang-Kleeman Information Flow for EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Ziyi Wang, Dongyang Kuang

entry.summary: GL-LFGNN uses Liang-Kleeman information flow theory to construct directed causal graphs for EEG emotion recognition, going beyond symmetric adjacency. Novel application of causal information flow to EEG GNNs.

entry.title: Leveraging Gauge Freedom for Learning Non-Gradient Population Dynamics of Stochastic Systems

author.name: Jules Berman, Tobias Blickhan, Benjamin Peherstorfer

entry.summary: NGIF infers non-gradient population dynamics by exploiting gauge freedom in vector field selection beyond minimal kinetic energy. Methodological work for stochastic system inference.

entry.title: Uncertainty-DTW for Sequences and Visual Tokens

author.name: Lei Wang, Syuan-Hao Li, Yongsheng Gao, Piotr Koniusz

entry.summary: uDTW introduces uncertainty-aware dynamic time warping with heteroscedastic Gaussian correspondences for sequence and visual token alignment. Probabilistic upgrade to a classical algorithm.

entry.title: STREAM: A Data-Centric Framework for Mining High-Value Task-Oriented Dialogues from Streaming Media

author.name: Liang Xue, Haoyu Liu, Cheng Wang, Pengyu Chen, Haozhuo Zheng, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Stream mines task-oriented dialogues from public live streams and short videos via persona-grounded blueprint synthesis for vertical-domain LLM training. Addresses dialogue data scarcity creatively.

entry.title: Latent Q-Barrier Shielding for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Minjae Kwon, Amir Moeini, Shangtong Zhang, Lu Feng

entry.summary: Introduces a latent Q-Barrier shield for safe in-context reinforcement learning that filters actions based on predicted future cost under safety budgets. Addresses out-of-distribution deployment shifts without parameter updates.

entry.title: Eureka: Intelligent Feature Engineering for Enterprise AI Cloud Resource Demand Prediction

author.name: Hangxuan Li, Renjun Jia, Xuezhang Wu, Yunjie Qian, Zeqi Zheng, Xianling Zhang

entry.summary: Eureka frames feature engineering as agentic code generation, using LLM agents to design, generate, and iteratively improve features for enterprise cloud resource prediction. Combines SFT expert agents with RL alignment.

entry.title: KYA: A Framework-Agnostic Trust Layer for Autonomous Systems with Verifiable Provenance and Hierarchical Policy Composition

author.name: Kolawole Quadri

entry.summary: KYA is an open-source trust and governance layer for autonomous systems with cryptographic verification, hierarchical policy composition, and unified principal trust scoring. Addresses agent observability beyond performance.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Rating the Quality of Surgical Feedback

author.name: Rafal Kocielnik, J. Everett Knudsen, Steven Y. Cen, Jasmine Lin, Cherine H. Yang, Atharva Deo, Ujjwal Pasupulety, Peter Wager, Anima Anandkumar, Andrew J. Hung

entry.summary: Two-stage LLM-based framework for discovering interpretable quality criteria for surgical feedback from attending surgeons. From the Anandkumar group, addresses real medical education problem.

entry.title: Acting on the Unseen: Communication-Free Collaborative Filtering for Decentralized Multi-Robot Task Allocation

author.name: Alexander Apartsin, Yigal Meshulam, Yehudit Aperstein

entry.summary: Studies zero-knowledge multi-robot task allocation with no communication, no task models, and partial noisy observations. Uses online low-rank completion to act well on never-attempted tasks.

entry.title: AutoSG: LLM-Driven Solver Generation Solely from Task Prompts for Expensive Optimization

author.name: Haoran Gu, Handing Wang, Yi Mei, Mengjie Zhang

entry.summary: AutoSG translates natural language prompts directly into executable solvers for expensive optimization, using retrieval-augmented LLM generation. Addresses factual hallucinations and local optimum dismantling.

entry.title: Meta-Engineering Harnesses for AI-Native Software Production: A Contract-Driven Adversarial Verification Architecture with Early Deployment Report

author.name: Satadru Sengupta, Tamunokorite Briggs, Ivan Myshakivskyi

entry.summary: Meta-engineering harness for AI-native software production with contract-driven adversarial verification, role-specialized agents, and outer-loop calibration. Architectural framework for production AI software.

entry.title: Don't Retrain, Just Reuse: Recovering Dual-Target Molecules from Single-Target Diffusion Models

author.name: Qingyuan Zeng, Pengxiang Cai, Zixin Guan, Ziyang Chen, Anglin Liu, Lang Qin, Xinyao Lai, Jintai Chen

entry.summary: Generator-preserving method for dual-target molecule design that reuses single-target diffusion models without retraining or sampling-time intervention. Addresses polypharmacology challenge.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation via Structure-Guided Orchestration

author.name: Haoran Li, Shulun Chen, Shaoyuan Sun, Hanchen Wang

entry.summary: MACA frames multi-agent coordination as posterior inference over joint structure and orchestration distribution. Learns task- and budget-conditioned coordination patterns.

entry.title: NPSolver: Neural Poisson Solver with Iterative Physics Supervision

author.name: Bocheng Zeng, Rui Zhang, Runze Mao, Mengtao Yan, Xuan Bai, Yang Liu, Zhi X. Chen, Hao Sun

entry.summary: NPSolver trains neural Poisson solvers without solution labels via iterative physics supervision using preconditioned conjugate gradient refinement. Combines learning with classical numerical iteration.

entry.title: On the Benefits of Free Exploration for Regret Minimization in Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Yunlong Hou, Zixin Zhong, Vincent Y. F. Tan

entry.summary: Theoretical study of multi-armed bandits with a free exploration budget before regret accumulates, identifying logarithmic budget regime. Quantifies regret savings from initial exploration phase.

entry.title: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills

author.name: Yunfei Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Yang Li, Xiaonan Huang

entry.summary: Auto-Robotist distills LLM-driven evolutionary robot morphology search traces into inspectable natural-language skill libraries. Combines retrieval-conditioned LLM edits with GA mutation.

entry.title: TTPrint: Evidence-Grounded TTP Extraction via Diverge-then-Converge Verification

author.name: Yutong Cheng, Changze Li, Raihan Sultan Pasha Basuki, Qian Cui, Wei Ding, Peng Gao

entry.summary: TTPrint extracts MITRE ATT&CK techniques from CTI reports using diverge-then-converge LLM verification. Decouples broad extraction from rigorous verification to balance precision and recall.

entry.title: TIAR: Trajectory-Informed Advantage Reweighting for LLM Abstention Learning

author.name: Muyu Pan, Shu Zhao, Nan Zhang, Philip Shin, Varun Parekh, Vijaykrishnan Narayanan, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: TIAR extends GRPO with trajectory-informed advantage reweighting for LLM abstention learning, using ternary rewards to incentivize truthfulness. Targets hallucination reduction via abstention.

entry.title: Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC) for Probabilistic Representation Learning

author.name: Waleed Razzaq, Yun-Bo Zhao

entry.summary: NSAC reformulates attention logits as Ornstein-Uhlenbeck SDE solutions modulated by neuronal circuit policies from C. elegans. Yields probabilistic attention with principled uncertainty.

entry.title: Beyond Summaries: Structure-Aware Labeling of Code Changes with Large Language Models

author.name: Bar Weiss, Antonio Abu-Nassar, Adi Sosnovich, Karen Yorav

entry.summary: Systematic study using LLMs for taxonomy-based labeling of code changes (renames, moves, logic modifications) in patches. Targets structured code review automation.

entry.title: Riemannian Archetypal Analysis: Interpretable non-linear data analysis on deformed star distributions

author.name: Willem Diepeveen, Deanna Needell

entry.summary: Riemannian archetypal analysis using data-driven pullback geometry on deformed star distributions. Combines interpretability of classical archetypes with non-linear flexibility.

entry.title: Optimizing Digital Therapeutic Interventions: Online Learning under Endogenous Adherence

author.name: Eric Pulick, Stephanie Carpenter, Matthew Buman, Yonatan Mintz

entry.summary: Online learning framework for digital therapeutics that explicitly models endogenous patient adherence as part of decision process. Captures both recommendation and history effects.

entry.title: From One-Pass SGD to Data Reuse: Mini-Batch Scaling Laws in Sketched Linear Regression

author.name: Ziyan Chen, Ding-Xuan Zhou

entry.summary: Studies batch scaling laws for sketched linear regression under power-law covariance, comparing one-pass and multi-pass SGD variants.

entry.title: AvAtar: Learning to Align via Active Optimal Transport

author.name: Qi Yu, Ruizhong Qiu, Zhichen Zeng, My T. Thai, Huan Liu, Hanghang Tong

entry.summary: AvAtar is active alignment framework for optimal transport using gradient-based informativeness of candidates. Addresses sparse supervision in alignment problems.

entry.title: Representation-Guided Discrete Molecular Graph Retrosynthesis

author.name: Jiahai Huang, Anjie Qiao, Zhen Wang, Defu Lian, Yutong Lu

entry.summary: Investigates representation guidance for template-free retrosynthesis using stochastic graph generators with pretrained encoder distillation.

entry.title: Zeroth-Order Nonconvex Nonsmooth Optimization with Heavy-Tailed Noise

author.name: Zhuanghua Liu, Luo Luo

entry.summary: Zeroth-order algorithm for nonconvex nonsmooth optimization under heavy-tailed noise via clipped two-point gradient estimator with online-to-nonconvex conversion.

entry.title: Trajectory-Based Difficulty Scoring for Reliable Learning on Tabular Data

author.name: Tomer Lavi, Bracha Shapira, Nadav Rappoport

entry.summary: TDS uses per-tree cumulative prediction trajectories from gradient boosted ensembles to score instance difficulty, with descriptors like variance, oscillation peaks, sign switches.

entry.title: Aligning Molecular Graph Explanations with Chemical Identity via InChIfied Invariants

author.name: Emanuele Guidotti, Sara Puglioli

entry.summary: Introduces InChIfied Invariants for molecular graph features that produce consistent representations across chemically equivalent drawings. Improves consistency of explanations for ML on molecules to 99.62%.

entry.title: Active Learning for Stochastic Contextual Linear Bandits

author.name: Emma Brunskill, Ishani Karmarkar, Zhaoqi Li

entry.summary: Proposes algorithm for stochastic contextual linear bandits that strategically samples both contexts and actions. Useful when practitioners can actively recruit contexts as in clinical trials or surveys.

entry.title: Unifying Value Alignment and Assignment in Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Heterogeneous Datasets

author.name: Zhongjian Qiao, Jiafei Lyu, Chenjia Bai, Peisong Wang, Siyang Gao, Shuang Qiu

entry.summary: Addresses heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL where source datasets come from multiple domains with diverse policies. Unifies value alignment and assignment to enable robust policy transfer.

entry.title: Revisiting Pre-Propagation GNNs: Robust Diffusion Operators and Hidden-State Re-Propagation

author.name: Zichao Yue, Zhiru Zhang

entry.summary: Revisits pre-propagation GNNs with robust diffusion operators and few-shot hidden-state re-propagation to close the gap with message-passing counterparts especially on heterophilic graphs. Maintains efficient batchable training.

entry.title: Learning Treatment Effects during Resource Allocation via Priority-Queue Randomization

author.name: JungHo Lee, Johnna Sundberg, Pim Welle, Bryan Wilder

entry.summary: Develops experimental design framework for learning treatment effects under priority-queue resource allocation in public service programs. Randomizes within tiered priority queues to support credible evaluation.

entry.title: Label-NTK Alignments and A Tighter Convergence Bound in the NTK Regime

author.name: Ruchirinkil Marreddy, Chaoyue Liu

entry.summary: Develops sharper convergence guarantees for over-parameterized neural network training under the NTK regime by characterizing label-NTK and residual-NTK alignment. Improves on pessimistic bounds depending on smallest NTK eigenvalue.

entry.title: EMA-Nesterov: Stabilizing Nesterov's Lookahead for Accelerated Deep Learning Optimization

author.name: Chung-Yiu Yau, Dawei Li, Athanasios Glentis, Valentyn Boreiko, Hoi-To Wai, Mingyi Hong

entry.summary: Proposes EMA-Nesterov, a modification of Nesterov momentum that uses exponential moving averages to harness low-frequency trajectory trends rather than noisy single-step extrapolation. Improves stability in deep learning training.

entry.title: Accelerated Dynamic Importance Weighting with Versatile Divergence-Minimizing Estimators

author.name: Tongtong Fang, Nan Lu, Gang Niu, Kenji Fukumizu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Proposes accelerated dynamic importance weighting with versatile divergence-minimizing estimators to reduce computational overhead of KMM-based weight estimation. Extends DIW beyond KMM to general divergences.

entry.title: Learning Latent Dynamical Causal Processes for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction

author.name: Wenkang Jiang, Yuhang Liu, Erdun Gao, Ehsan Abbasnejad, Lina Yao, Javen Qinfeng Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a latent dynamical causal process model for single-cell perturbation prediction that recovers temporal causal generative mechanisms rather than static effects. Targets OOD generalization to unseen interventions.

entry.title: Generalized Evidential Deep Learning: From a Bayesian Perspective

author.name: Yuanye Liu, Yibo Gao, Yuanyang Chen, Xiahai Zhuang

entry.summary: Establishes a Bayesian theoretical foundation for evidential deep learning, unifying prior specification, posterior update, and training objectives. Characterizes evidential uncertainty via asymptotic Bayesian distributional uncertainty.

entry.title: Latent Representation Alignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hyungkyu Kang, Byeongchan Kim, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Proposes Latent-Aligned Value Learning (LAVL), an offline goal-conditioned RL method integrating latent representation generalization with hierarchical planning. Addresses erroneous generalization in long-horizon goal-conditioned value functions.

entry.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yulin Yuan, Hongshuo Zhao, Xiangming Meng

entry.summary: Proposes visual-redundancy-controlled parallel decoding for diffusion-based MLLMs, accounting for overlapping visual grounding when committing top-K masked positions. Improves over independent confidence ranking.

entry.title: Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhaoyu Zhu, Rui Gao, Shuang Li

entry.summary: Provides global convergence analysis of Wasserstein policy gradient for entropy-regularized RL, addressing the challenge that Bellman recursion breaks standard Langevin analysis. Theoretical contribution to continuous control.

entry.title: Goal-driven Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design for Robust Decision-Making Under Model Uncertainty

author.name: Jinwoo Go, Xiaoning Qian, Byung-Jun Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes GoBOED, a goal-driven Bayesian optimal experimental design framework that optimizes for downstream decision objectives rather than parameter uncertainty. Uses a differentiable convex decision layer with amortized variational posteriors.

entry.title: A Tabular Schedule Abstraction for Communication-Aware Evaluation of Pipeline-Parallel LLM Training

author.name: Daniel Barley, Jonathan Leis, Benjamin Klenk, Holger Fr\"oning

entry.summary: Introduces a tabular schedule abstraction for pipeline-parallel LLM training that unifies analytical, idealized, and communication-aware simulation. Compares GPipe, 1F1B, Chimera, Hanayo across configurations.

entry.title: Improving Ensemble CAPE Forecasts with a Diffusion Model Incorporating Aerosol Information

author.name: Zachary James, Joseph Guinness, Arthur DeGaetano

entry.summary: Trains a diffusion model to post-process GFS CAPE forecasts, producing ensembles that outperform GEFS on multiple skill metrics. Incorporates aerosol information for severe weather prediction.

entry.title: Seeing Inside the Storm: Improving Nowcasting by Integrating Meteorological Drivers

author.name: Minghui Qiu, Jun Chen, Lin Chen, Weifeng Chen, Shuxin Zhong, Zhidan Liu, Yu Zhang, Kaishun Wu

entry.summary: MeteoLogist is a physics-inspired radar nowcasting framework that models full convection life-cycle including thermodynamic, kinematic and microphysical precursors. Addresses asynchronous and spatially fragmented inputs.

entry.title: EVA: Accelerating LLM Decoding via an Efficient Vector Quantization Architecture

author.name: Bowen Duan, Cong Guo, Chiyue Wei, Haoxuan Shan, Yuzhe Fu, Xinhua Chen, Yifan Xu, Ziyue Zhang, Changchun Zhou, Hai Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: EVA is an accelerator architecture for LLM decoding via vector quantization addressing GEMV inefficiencies. Enables 2-bit weight compression with hardware-aware design.

entry.title: Single View Seafloor Recovery from Imaging Sonar via Differentiable Rendering

author.name: Sevan Brodjian, Michael Hobley, Pietro Perona

entry.summary: Training-free single-view bathymetry recovery from sonar imagery via differentiable rendering, conditioned on known seafloor tilt. Runs in under 30 seconds without training data.

entry.title: Structure-Aware RAG: Structured Retrieval Augmented Generation from Noisy Data for Conversational Agents

author.name: Kaiqiao Han, LuAn Tang, Renliang Sun, Peng Yuan, Wei Cheng, Haoyu Wang, Wei Wang, Yizhou Sun, Haifeng Chen

entry.summary: SA-RAG uses tables as an intermediate structured representation to reduce noise in retrieval-augmented generation. Includes quality-aware table metadata generation for conversational agents.

entry.title: Smoother Action Chunking Flow Policy via Prior-Corrected Orthogonal Trust-Region Guidance

author.name: Kai Fang, Hailong Pei, Xuemin Chi

entry.summary: POTR introduces prior-corrected orthogonal trust-region guidance for flow-matching robot policies, improving smoothness at chunk boundaries during inference. Constrains corrections to be orthogonal to denoising velocity.

entry.title: Implicit Binarization via Complex Phase Dynamics in Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Khen Cohen, Mark Glass, Meir Feder, Yaron Oz

entry.summary: Physics-inspired continuous relaxation framework for NP-hard combinatorial optimization (QUBO, binary sparse coding, Ising) parameterizing binary variables as complex phases. Reveals implicit binarization regularizer.

entry.title: On the Sample Complexity of Robust Binary Hypothesis Testing

author.name: Shankar Vallinayagam, Ankit Pensia, Varun Jog

entry.summary: Studies sample complexity of robust binary hypothesis testing under Huber, subtractive, and TV contamination. Shows complexity may be highly unstable in contamination parameter and derives least favorable distributions for subtractive case.

entry.title: CyberMaskQA: A Privacy-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Question Answering

author.name: Matilda Gaddi, Jin Noh, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing

entry.summary: CyberMaskQA is a privacy-aware benchmark for evaluating LLMs on cybersecurity QA with sensitive identifiers (IPs, hosts, accounts). Addresses tension between cloud LLM use and regulatory privacy needs.

entry.title: IV-Net: A neural network for elliptic PDEs with random and highly varying coefficients

author.name: Shan Zhong, George Biros

entry.summary: IV-Net is a multigrid-inspired neural operator using V-cycle architecture for solving high-contrast elliptic PDEs. Outperforms POD and other neural operators on coercive heterogeneous problems.

entry.title: Learning, locomotion, and navigation of soft synthetic snakes in three-dimensional, heterogeneous environments

author.name: Xiaotian Zhang, Ali Albazroun, Tixian Wang, Songyuan Cui, Prashant G. Mehta, Mattia Gazzola

entry.summary: Combines bio-inspired actuation/sensing with RL to enable soft synthetic snake robots to navigate complex 3D heterogeneous terrains. Training proceeds via primitives composed into adaptive strategies for unstructured landscapes.

entry.title: Multimodality Stacking with Blockwise missing values and application to the PIONeeR biomarkers study for prediction of resistance to immunotherapy

author.name: Mohamed Boussena, Florence Monville, Jacques Fieschi-Meric, Frederic Vely, Pierre Milpied, Julien Mazieres, Maurice Perol, Eric Vivier, Laurent Greillier, Fabrice Barlesi, Sebastien Benzekry

entry.summary: MSB is a late-fusion stacking framework for multimodal survival analysis with blockwise missing values, validated on PIONeeR study data for predicting immunotherapy resistance in lung cancer. Addresses common limitations of standard survival models with missing modalities.

entry.title: Random Neural Network Expressivity for Non-Linear Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Muhammed Ali Mehmood, Lukas Gonon

entry.summary: Theoretical analysis of random neural network (RaNN) expressivity for non-linear PDEs, deriving error bounds for Sobolev function approximation and dimension-free rates. Applied to porous medium equation and other classes.

entry.title: Data-Specific Hyper-Parameter Design: A Paradigm Shift in Reservoir Computing

author.name: G Manjunath, Juan-Pablo Ortega, Alma van der Merwe

entry.summary: Proposes geometric, data-specific design principles for reservoir computing rather than relying on random reservoirs and Johnson-Lindenstrauss-type concentration. Aims to shift the trial-and-error paradigm in reservoir computing.

entry.title: Choosing Online Experiment Designs under Interference in Ads, Recommendations, and Member-Experience Systems

author.name: Prashant Shekhar, Caroline Howard

entry.summary: Robust design selection framework for online experiments under interference (budgets, spillovers, carryover), formulated as worst-case planning risk over an ambiguity set across six candidate designs. Combines bias, variance, MDE, and operational costs.

entry.title: Different Statistical Perspectives for Understanding Generalisation in Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Nil Ayday, Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam, Debarghya Ghoshdastidar

entry.summary: Survey-style discussion of three statistical perspectives for GNN generalization: classical learning theory bounds, simplified architecture analysis, and modern PAC-Bayesian/empirical risk approaches. Synthesizes the GNN generalization theory literature.

entry.title: Mean-Shift PCA by Knockoff Mean

author.name: Mengda Li, Zeng Li, Jianfeng Yao

entry.summary: Knockoff Mean PCA uses deliberate mean-shift perturbations to spectrally separate corrupted components from stable eigenvalues, with random matrix theory guarantees. Addresses high-dimensional mean-shift contamination that existing robust PCA methods fail on.

entry.title: From DPPs to $k$-DPPs: identifiability analysis via spectral decomposition

author.name: Hideitsu Hino, Keisuke Yano

entry.summary: Identifiability analysis of k-DPPs via spectral decomposition, characterizing the identifiability gap relative to DPPs through scale, sign similarity, and eigenspace rotation invariances. Provides exact identifiability characterization for conditional fixed-cardinality DPPs.

entry.title: Nonstationary Generalized Linear Bandits with Discounted Online Mirror Descent

author.name: Joongkyu Lee, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: DOMD is a discounted online mirror descent algorithm for nonstationary generalized linear bandits avoiding the recomputation costs of sliding-window MLE approaches. Achieves regret guarantees with computation independent of horizon length.

entry.title: Optimal Design for Multinomial Logit Model with Applications to Best Assortment Identification

author.name: Joongkyu Lee, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Optimal experimental design framework for multinomial logit bandits combining 0-1 MILP reformulation with solver-certified early stopping and scalable approximations. Addresses the combinatorial intractability of MNL action spaces.

entry.title: Accelerating Bayesian inverse design in computational fluid dynamics using neural operators

author.name: Bipin Tiwari, Omer San

entry.summary: Demonstrates that neural operator surrogates can be embedded directly within Bayesian MCMC inverse design loops for CFD while preserving posterior structure, even for shock-dominated flows. Uses quasi-1D Bayesian inverse formulation.

entry.title: SLAP: Stratified Loss-based Pruning for On-Policy Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning

author.name: Run Zou, Jianhang Ding, Yifan Ding, Wen Wu, Hao Chen, Renshu Gu

entry.summary: SLAP is a batch-aware data selection framework for instruction tuning that uses distribution-aware stratified sampling and intra-batch diversity via relative distance optimization. Leverages Hessian-aware loss for evaluating batch learnability.

entry.title: A Multi-Probe Audit of Clinical-Interview Depression Detection Benchmarks

author.name: Takehiro Ishikawa, Jon Duke

entry.summary: Audits clinical-interview depression detection benchmarks with four probes across DAIC/E-DAIC, CMDC, ANDROIDS, MODMA, PDCH. A lightweight text+LLM-score hybrid reaches 0.723 macro-F1 under strict LOSO CV, the highest reported under this protocol.

entry.title: Distinguishing Right from Wrong in Debates: Attribution Analysis of Chinese Harmful Memes

author.name: Weiming Wang, Junyu Lu, Han Wang, Xiaokun Zhang, Zewen Bai, Bo Xu, Liang Yang, Hongfei Lin

entry.summary: Constructs the first Chinese harmful meme explanation dataset Ex-ToxiCN-MM with opposing harmful and non-harmful interpretations per meme to rigorously evaluate model reasoning. Targets the cultural context challenge in Chinese meme moderation.

entry.title: Decompose-and-Refine: Structured Legal Question Answering with Parametric Retrieval

author.name: Jihyung lee, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Lee

entry.summary: Decompose-and-Refine framework for statutory legal QA that decomposes multi-hop legal questions and uses parametric retrieval to bridge the vocabulary gap between user questions and statutory text. Targets hallucination risk in multi-hop legal reasoning.

entry.title: Unveil: Unified Visual-Textual Integration and Distillation for Multi-modal Document Retrieval

author.name: Hao Sun, Yingyan Hou, Jiayan Guo, Bo Wang, Chunyu Yang, Jinsong Ni, Yan Zhang

entry.summary: Unveil is a visual-textual embedding framework for document retrieval that integrates both modalities and uses knowledge distillation to transfer understanding to a purely visual model. Enables efficient parsing-free retrieval with strong text-rich performance.

entry.title: Generating Legal Commentaries from Case Databases via Retrieval, Clustering, and Generation

author.name: Max Prior, Niklas Wais, Matthias Grabmair

entry.summary: Automated pipeline transforming 4,555 German Federal Court decisions on civil code sections into structured legal commentaries through retrieval, clustering, and LLM-based synthesis. Evaluated on relevance, heading match, citation faithfulness, cluster distinction, and ordering.

entry.title: Know You Before You Speak: User-State Modeling for LLM Personalization in Multi-Turn Conversation

author.name: Jiani Luo, Xiaoyan Zhao, Yang Zhang, Shuyi Miao, Bingbing Xu, Stefan Konigorski, Tat-Seng Chua
