entry.summary: Proposes EvoStruct bridging protein language models with 3D structural context for antibody CDR design, addressing vocabulary collapse in GNN-based methods through cross-attention adaptation.

entry.title: NaP-Control: Navigating Diffusion Prior for Versatile and Fast Character Control

author.name: Chia-Wen Chen, Yan Wu, Korrawe Karunratanakul, Siyu Tang

entry.summary: Proposes NaP-Control for physics-based character animation that uses RL to manipulate latent noise of a diffusion policy prior, steering toward task-specific behaviors without gradient-based test-time guidance.

entry.title: Theoretical guidelines for annealed Langevin dynamics in compositional simulation-based inference

author.name: Camille Touron, Gabriel V. Cardoso, Julyan Arbel, Pedro L. C. Rodrigues

entry.summary: Provides theoretical guidelines for using annealed Langevin dynamics in compositional simulation-based inference, addressing the irreducible bias problem when aggregating individually learned posterior scores.

entry.title: Hypergraph as Language

author.name: Mengqi Lei, Guohuan Xie, Shihui Ying, Shaoyi Du, Jun-Hai Yong, Siqi Li, Yue Gao

entry.summary: Proposes 'Hypergraph as Language' perspective and Hyper-Align framework for processing high-order relational structures in hypergraphs with LLMs, going beyond pairwise graph-centric approaches.

entry.title: Do Factual Recall Mechanisms Carry over from Text to Speech in Multimodal Language Models?

author.name: Luca Modica, Filip Landin, Mehrdad Farahani, Livia Qian, Gabriel Skantze, Richard Johansson

entry.summary: Investigates whether factual recall mechanisms in text-only LLMs carry over to speech modalities in Speech Language Models, using Causal Mediation Analysis on SpiritLM to find discrepancies between text-to-text and speech-to-text processing.

entry.title: Structure Retention in Embedding Spaces as a Predictor of Benchmark Performance

author.name: Amanda Myntti, Jenna Kanerva, Veronika Laippala, Filip Ginter

entry.summary: Shows that high-performing embedding models organize spaces consistently, with nearest-neighbor overlap and ICA magnitude differences correlating up to 0.97 with task performance, revealing varying degrees of linearity across tasks.

entry.title: SynAE: A Framework for Measuring the Quality of Synthetic Data for Tool-Calling Agent Evaluations

author.name: Shuaiqi Wang, Aadyaa Maddi, Zinan Lin, Giulia Fanti

entry.summary: Introduces SynAE, a framework for assessing how well synthetic benchmarks for tool-calling agents represent real evaluation data, addressing the growing use of synthetic data in agent testing.

entry.title: Flat-Pack Bench: Evaluating Spatio-Temporal Understanding in Large Vision-Language Models through Furniture Assembly

author.name: Aditya Chetan, Eric Cai, Peeyush Kushwaha, Bharath Raj Nagoor Kani, Utkarsh Mall, Qianqian Wang, Noah Snavely, Bharath Hariharan

entry.summary: Introduces Flat-Pack Bench, a benchmark evaluating fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding in vision-language models through furniture assembly tasks. Addresses the gap between coarse action recognition and detailed step-by-step comprehension.

entry.title: Echo: Learning from Experience Data via User-Driven Refinement

author.name: Hande Dong, Xiaoyun Liang, Jiarui Yu, Jiayi Lin, Changqing Ai, Feng Liu, Wenjun Zhang, Rongbi Wei, Chaofan Zhu, Linjie Che, Feng Wu, Xin Shen, Dexu Kong, Xiaotian Wang, Qiuyuan Chen, Bingxu An, Yueting Lei, Qiang Lin

entry.summary: Introduces Echo, a framework for learning from agent experience data (interaction logs) through user-driven refinement. Addresses the challenge that raw interaction logs are noisy and low information density for direct training.

entry.title: UniVL: Unified Vision-Language Embedding for Spatially Grounded Contextual Image Generation

author.name: Jiayun Wang, Yu Wang, Weijie Gan, Zhenting Wang, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Introduces UniVL for spatially grounded contextual image generation, binding text instructions to spatial locations directly from unified visual input by rendering text onto spatial masks. Eliminates need for separate text encoder.

entry.title: Seizure-Semiology-Suite (S3): A Clinically Multimodal Dataset, Benchmark, and Models for Seizure Semiology Understanding

author.name: Lina Zhang, Tonmoy Monsoor, Peizheng Li, Jiarui Cui, Xinyi Peng, Chong Han, Prateik Sinha, Siyuan Dai, Jessica Nichole Pasqua, Colin M McCrimmon, Weiting Liu, Hailey Marie Miranda, Bing Hu, Xiangting Wu, Tengyou Xu, Chunhan Li, Jiaye Tian, Jiarui Tang, Detao Ma, Lingye Kong, Junnan Lyu, Jungang Li, Yan Zan, Junhua Huang, Rajarshi Mazumder, Vwani Roychowdhury

entry.summary: Introduces Seizure-Semiology-Suite (S3), a clinically grounded dataset of 438 seizure videos with 35,000+ dense labels for evaluating MLLMs on pathologic motor behavior understanding. Proposes hierarchical seven-task benchmark.

entry.title: Learning Emergent Modular Representations in Multi-modality Medical Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Yuting He, Chenyu You, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes Director-Experts (DEX) for multi-modality medical vision foundation models, addressing Non-IID feature statistics across imaging modalities through modular specialization and coordination.

entry.title: Guided Trajectory Optimization with Sparse Scaling for Test-Time Diffusion

author.name: Gang Dai, Yining Huang, Yiming Xia, Guohao Chen, Shuaicheng Niu

entry.summary: Proposes RTS, a reward-guided trajectory scaling method for test-time diffusion that actively optimizes noise toward promising regions and uses PCA-driven curvature analysis for sparse scaling.

entry.title: LVDrive: Latent Visual Representation Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Model

author.name: Xiaodong Mei, Diankun Zhang, Hongwei Xie, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Dan Xu

entry.summary: LVDrive enhances Vision-Language-Action models for autonomous driving by introducing future scene prediction in a latent space under auxiliary supervision, addressing the limitation of sparse action supervision in existing VLAs.

entry.title: TextTeacher: What Can Language Teach About Images?

author.name: Tobias Christian Nauen, Stanislav Frolov, Brian Bernhard Moser, Federico Raue, Ahmed Anwar, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: TextTeacher introduces an auxiliary training objective that injects text embeddings from captions into image classification training as semantic anchors, improving ViT accuracy by up to 1.4% on ImageNet while leaving inference unchanged.

entry.title: Accelerating Vision Foundation Models with Drop-in Depthwise Convolution

author.name: Carmelo Scribano, Mohammad Mahdi, Nedyalko Prisadnikov, Yuqian Fu, Giorgia Franchini, Danda Pani Paudel, Marko Bertogna, Luc Van Gool

entry.summary: This paper accelerates pretrained Vision Transformers by identifying attention heads that exhibit convolution-like behavior and replacing them with efficient depthwise convolutions, preserving feature extraction capabilities while reducing inference cost.

entry.title: MuKV: Multi-Grained KV Cache Compression for Long Streaming Video Question-Answering

author.name: Junbin Xiao, Jiajun Chen, Tianxiang Sun, Xun Yang, Angela Yao

entry.summary: MuKV proposes multi-grained KV cache compression at patch, frame, and segment levels with semi-hierarchical retrieval for efficient long streaming video QA, addressing redundant memory usage in existing frame-level caching approaches.

entry.title: Diffusion-guided Generalizable Enhancer for Urban Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Henry Che, Jingkang Wang, Yun Chen, Ze Yang, Sivabalan Manivasagam, Raquel Urtasun

entry.summary: GenRe is a generalizable diffusion-guided enhancer for urban scene reconstruction that improves rendering quality under large viewpoint shifts without costly per-scene optimization, enabling closed-loop simulation for self-driving.

entry.title: VGenST-Bench: A Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning via Active Video Synthesis

author.name: Jinho Park, Youbin Kim, Hogun Park, Eunbyung Park

entry.summary: Introduces VGenST-Bench, a benchmark using generative models to actively synthesize controlled evaluation scenarios for spatio-temporal reasoning in MLLMs. Features a multi-agent pipeline with human quality control for video and QA pair generation.

entry.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Javad Rajabi, Kimia Shaban, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati

entry.summary: Introduces SEGA, a training-free method for resolution extrapolation in diffusion transformers that dynamically scales attention across RoPE components based on the latent's spatial-frequency structure. Addresses the quality drop when generating at resolutions beyond training range.

entry.title: An Open Multi-Center Whole-Body FDG PET/CT Foundation Model for Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Xiaofeng Liu, Qianru Zhang, Thibault Marin, Menghua Xia, Chi Liu, Georges El Fakhri, Jinsong Ouyang

entry.summary: Presents an open-source multi-center whole-body FDG PET/CT foundation model for tumor segmentation trained on 4,997 harmonized scans from four public datasets with early channel-wise PET-CT fusion.

entry.title: GesVLA: Gesture-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model Embedded Representations

author.name: Wenxuan Guo, Ziyuan Li, Meng Zhang, Yichen Liu, Yimeng Dong, Chuxi Xu, Yunfei Wei, Ze Chen, Erjin Zhou, Jianjiang Feng

entry.summary: Introduces GesVLA, a gesture-aware Vision-Language-Action model that encodes gesture features directly into latent space for resolving spatial ambiguity in robot manipulation with multiple similar objects. Uses dual-VLM architecture for tight coupling.

entry.title: Spatial Memory for Out-of-Vision Manipulation in Vision-Language-Action

author.name: Pengteng Li, Weiyu Guo, He Zhang, Tiefu Cai, Xiao He, Yandong Guo, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Introduces SOMA, a spatial memory framework enabling VLA models to reason about objects that fall outside the camera's field of view. Constructs persistent spatial-semantic representations from multi-view observations via a movable head camera with dynamic memory refinement.

entry.title: Understanding Multimodal Failure in Action-Chunking Behavioral Cloning

author.name: Lorenzo Mazza, Massimiliano Datres, Ariel Rodriguez, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Gitta Kutyniok, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: Studies how different multimodal parameterizations (latent-variable vs. action-space generative policies) fail differently in action-chunking behavioral cloning, characterizing trade-offs between regularization strength and mode coverage.

entry.title: Scalable On-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Batch Scaling

author.name: Jongchan Park

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Batch Scaling (ABS) for on-policy RL that dynamically adjusts batch size during training, observing that early training requires small batches for plasticity while late stages benefit from large batches for precise convergence.

entry.title: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration

author.name: Liyuan Deng, Shujian Deng, Yongkang Chen, Yongkang Dai, Zhihang Zhong, Linyang Li, Xiao Sun, Yilei Shi, Huaxi Huang

entry.summary: COSMO-Agent uses tool-augmented RL to teach LLMs to orchestrate the closed-loop CAD-CAE (design-simulation) optimization process, bridging the semantic gap between simulation feedback and geometric edits. It casts CAD generation, simulation, and revision as an interactive RL environment.

entry.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models

author.name: Ziliang Zhao, Zenan Xu, Shuting Wang, Hongjin Qian, Yan Lei, Minda Hu, Zhao Wang, Shihan Dou, Zhicheng Dou, Pluto Zhou

entry.summary: PlanningBench introduces a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for LLM evaluation and training, treating planning data as controllable generation targets rather than fixed collections.

entry.title: Geometry-Lite: Interpretable Safety Probing via Layer-Wise Margin Geometry

author.name: Woo Seob Sim, Yu Rang Park

entry.summary: Geometry-Lite introduces interpretable safety probes that analyze the geometric structure of safety classification across LLM layers, studying how safety evidence forms and which geometric properties support reliable detection.

entry.title: Catching a Moving Subspace: Low-Rank Bandits Beyond Stationarity

author.name: Hamed Khosravi, Xiaoming Huo

entry.summary: Studies piecewise-stationary low-rank linear contextual bandits where the latent subspace drifts, providing tight results on identification boundaries, regret bounds, and detection-localization lower bounds.

entry.title: Modality-Decoupled Online Recursive Editing

author.name: Siyuan Li, Youyuan Zhang, Fangming Liu, Jing Li

entry.summary: M-ORE proposes modality-decoupled online recursive editing for multimodal LLMs, addressing cross-modal conflict and inter-edit interference through separate modality handling with constant per-edit overhead.

entry.title: DEL: Digit Entropy Loss for Numerical Learning of Large Language Models

author.name: Zhaohui Zheng, Chenhang He, Shihao Wang, Yuxuan Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Digit Entropy Loss (DEL) for improving numerical prediction in LLMs, providing in-depth analysis showing existing methods follow a criterion-distance formulation and proposing a balanced approach that avoids over-sharpened or over-flattened digit distributions.

entry.title: Codec-Robust Attacks on Audio LLMs

author.name: Jaechul Roh, Jean-Philippe Monteuuis, Jonathan Petit, Amir Houmansdar

entry.summary: CodecAttack optimizes adversarial perturbations in a neural audio codec's latent space rather than the waveform domain, making attacks robust to codec compression defenses that would remove waveform-level perturbations.

entry.title: Latent Process Generator Matching

author.name: Lukas Billera, Hedwig Nora Nordlinder, Ben Murrell

entry.summary: Latent Process Generator Matching generalizes flow-matching theory by treating the observed state as a deterministic image of a tractable Markov process, providing a unified framework for various augmented-state diffusion constructions.

entry.title: Heartbeat-Bound Hierarchical Credentials: Cryptographic Revocation for AI Agent Swarms

author.name: Saurabh Deochake

entry.summary: HBHC is a cryptographic protocol binding AI agent credential validity to periodic parent liveness proofs, ensuring descendant credentials become unusable within a bounded window after heartbeat cessation, without network connectivity to authority.

entry.title: GenAI-Driven Threat Detection with Microsoft Security Copilot

author.name: Scott Freitas, Amir Gharib

entry.summary: Presents the Dynamic Threat Detection Agent (DTDA), an always-on adaptive agent using Microsoft Security Copilot to continuously investigate security incidents across Microsoft Defender and generate explainable detections.

entry.title: Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network

author.name: Jiawen Dai, Yue Song

entry.summary: Proposes Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN) based on generalized Winfree dynamics, evolving representations on the torus through structured oscillatory interactions, showing scalability to vision benchmarks and logic reasoning.

entry.title: Focus-then-Context: Subject-Centric Progressive Visual Token Reduction for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yulin Zhao, Yun Wang, Dehua Zheng, Borui jiang, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SPpruner for vision-language models that mimics human Focus-then-Context visual perception to progressively reduce visual tokens by modeling interplay between visual saliency and semantic relevance.

entry.title: Large-Step Training Dynamics of a Two-Factor Linear Transformer Model

author.name: Krishnakumar Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Analyzes training dynamics of a two-factor linear transformer at large learning rates, showing the dynamics reduce to a cubic map with phase transitions between convergence, periodic, chaotic, and divergent behavior.

entry.title: TimeSRL: Generalizable Time-Series Behavioral Modeling via Semantic RL-Tuned LLMs -- A Case Study in Mental Health

author.name: Yuang Fan, Lilin Xu, Millie Wu, Jingping Nie, Qingyu Chen, Yuzhe Yang, Zhuo Zhang, Xin Liu, Subigya Nepal, Xiaofan Jiang, Xuhai "Orson" Xu

entry.summary: Introduces TimeSRL, a two-stage LLM framework that abstracts raw longitudinal sensing data into natural language descriptions and then predicts behavioral outcomes, optimized with GRPO for mental health monitoring.

entry.title: Closed Loop Dynamic Driving Data Mixture for Real-Synthetic Co-Training

author.name: Hongzhi Ruan, Pei Liu, Weiliang Ma, Zhengning Li, Xueyang Zhang, Jun Ma, Dan Xu, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes a closed-loop dynamic data mixture optimization for autonomous driving that mixes real and synthetic training data based on scene types and quantities, conceptualized as a dynamic optimization process.

entry.title: Graph Transductive Sharpening: Leveraging Unlabeled Predictions in Node Classification

author.name: Brown Zaz, Mar Gonz\`alez I Catal\`a, Ferran Hernandez Caralt, Moshe Eliasof, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Proposes Graph Transductive Sharpening, using unlabeled-node predictions as training signal through entropy minimization in semi-supervised node classification. Revisits training objective rather than architecture.

entry.title: Online Conformal Prediction with Corrupted Feedback

author.name: Bowen Wang, Matteo Zecchin, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Studies online conformal prediction under corrupted feedback, modeling corruption as arbitrary binary flips. Analyzes how corruption degrades calibration and proposes methods maintaining guarantees.

entry.title: Deep Learning Surrogates for Emulating Stochastic Climate Tipping Dynamics

author.name: Adeline Hillier, Jennifer Sleeman, Jay Brett, Caroline Tang, Jenelle Millison, Anand Gnanadesikan

entry.summary: Explores dynamics-informed Temporal Fusion Transformer as a surrogate for Earth system simulations, forecasting ocean transport tipping events with 465x computational speedup while capturing stochastic uncertainty.

entry.title: Compositional Transduction with Latent Analogies for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Junseok Kim, Dohyeong Kim, Mineui Hong, Songhwai Oh

entry.summary: Proposes compositional transduction with latent analogies for offline goal-conditioned RL, formalizing analogy transduction to synthesize new plans by composing task-endogenous analogies with given contexts.

entry.title: Cumulative Meta-Learning from Active Learning Queries for Robustness to Spurious Correlations

author.name: Kin Whye Chew, Jingxian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CAML (Cumulative Active Meta-Learning), using active learning queries to meta-learn priors that counter spurious correlations, rather than simply appending queried examples to the training set.

entry.title: Reviving Error Correction in Modern Deep Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Minh Hoang Nguyen, Dai Do, Huu Hiep Nguyen, Dung Nguyen, Kien Do, Hung Le

entry.summary: Proposes an architecture-agnostic error correction model for deep time-series forecasting that addresses error accumulation in autoregressive inference without requiring retraining of the base forecaster.

entry.title: SMoA: Spectrum Modulation Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yongkang Liu, Xing Li, Mengjie Zhao, Shanru Zhang, Zijing Wang, Qian Li, Shi Feng, Feiliang Ren, Daling Wang, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Proposes SMoA (Spectrum Modulation Adapter) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning that modulates singular value spectra rather than using low-rank updates, addressing LoRA's limited representational capacity at low ranks.

entry.title: Gaussian Sheaf Neural Networks

author.name: Andr\'e Ribeiro, Ana Luiza Ten\'orio, Tiago da Silva, Diego Mesquita

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Sheaf Neural Networks that incorporate the geometric structure of Gaussian distributions (means and covariances) into graph learning using cellular sheaf theory.

entry.title: SpectralEarth-FM: Bringing Hyperspectral Imagery into Multimodal Earth Observation Pretraining

author.name: Nassim Ait Ali Braham, Aaron Banze, Conrad M. Albrecht, Julien Mairal, Jocelyn Chanussot, Xiao Xiang Zhu

entry.summary: SpectralEarth-FM introduces a hierarchical transformer for jointly pretraining on hyperspectral imagery alongside other Earth observation sensors. Addresses the gap where hyperspectral data has been excluded from multimodal EO foundation models.

entry.title: Reflective Prompt Tuning through Language Model Function-Calling

author.name: Farima Fatahi Bayat, Moin Aminnaseri, Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Proposes Reflective Prompt Tuning (RPT), a framework that uses LLM function-calling to automatically optimize prompts by capturing systematic error patterns and making targeted edits grounded in failure history.

entry.title: FlyRoute: Self-Evolving Agent Profiling via Data Flywheel for Adaptive Task Routing

author.name: Rongjun Li, Ziyu Zhou, Yihang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes FlyRoute, a self-evolving agent profiling framework that grows capability evidence from real traffic to improve task routing, with targeted exploration for under-profiled agents.

entry.title: Harder to Defend: Towards Chinese Toxicity Attacks via Implicit Enhancement and Obfuscation Rewriting

author.name: Jingyi Kang, Junyu Lu, Bo Xu, Hongbo Wang, Linlin zong, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Hongfei Lin

entry.summary: Introduces CITA, a Chinese implicit toxicity attack framework combining harmful intent learning, implicit enhancement, and obfuscation rewriting, achieving 69.48% average attack success rate against seven detectors.

entry.title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation

author.name: Hanyu Guo, Jiedong Yang, Chao Chen, Longfei Xu, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Presents TransitLM, a dataset of 13M+ transit route planning records from four Chinese cities, showing that LLMs can learn route planning without explicit maps, implicitly grounding GPS coordinates to stations.

entry.title: From Correlation to Cause: A Five-Stage Methodology for Feature Analysis in Transformer Language Models

author.name: Caleb Munigety

entry.summary: Proposes a five-stage methodology for causal feature analysis in transformers (probe design, extraction, causal validation, robustness testing, deployment) demonstrated on GPT-2's IOI circuit.

entry.title: MM-Conv: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Context-Aware Grounding in 3D Dialogue

author.name: Anna Deichler, Jim O'Regan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Lubos Marcinek, Anna Klezovich, Iolanda Leite, Jonas Beskow

entry.summary: Introduces MM-Conv, a multimodal dataset and benchmark for referential communication in dynamic 3D environments, built from 6.7 hours of egocentric VR interaction with synchronized speech, motion, gaze, and 3D geometry.

entry.title: Maestro: Reinforcement Learning to Orchestrate Hierarchical Model-Skill Ensembles

author.name: Jinyang Wu, Guocheng Zhai, Ruihan Jin, Yuhao Shen, Zhengxi Lu, Fan Zhang, Haoran Luo, Zheng Lian, Zhengqi Wen, Jianhua Tao

entry.summary: Presents Maestro, an RL-driven orchestration framework that dynamically selects among heterogeneous LLMs and modular skills for multimodal tasks. Treats task solving as sequential decision-making over model-skill combinations.

entry.title: BodyReLux: Temporally Consistent Full-Body Video Relighting

author.name: Li Ma, Mingming He, Xueming Yu, David M. George, Ahmet Levent Ta\c{s}el, Paul Debevec, Julien Philip

entry.summary: Presents BodyReLux, a video diffusion-based framework for temporally consistent full-body human relighting. Uses novel dynamic capture with rapidly interleaved lighting sequences above flicker-fusion threshold.

entry.title: MAVEN: A Multi-stage Agentic Annotation Pipeline for Video Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Han Zhang, Wanting Jiang, Tomasz Kornuta, Tian Zheng, Vidya Murali

entry.summary: Presents MAVEN, a multi-stage agentic pipeline for generating structured video annotations with Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces. Creates multi-task training data organized around an Event of Focus.

entry.title: Foresee-to-Ground: From Predictive Temporal Perception to Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Zelin Zheng, Xinyan Liu, Ruixin Li, Antoni B. Chan, Guorong Li, Qingming Huang, Laiyun Qing

entry.summary: Foresee-to-Ground (F2G) reformulates video temporal grounding as a verifiable Identify-then-Measure problem, building an evidence pool of candidate segments that an LLM can cite as explicit evidence units. This decouples event identification from boundary measurement for more stable predictions.

entry.title: ORBIS: Output-Guided Token Reduction with Distribution-Aware Matching for Video Diffusion Acceleration

author.name: Hangyeol Lee, Joo-Young Kim

entry.summary: ORBIS is a software-hardware co-designed accelerator for video DiT token reduction, using output activations from previous timesteps for more accurate similarity estimation and a distribution-aware matching algorithm for better token merging.

entry.title: EvoIR-Agent: Self-Evolving Image Restoration Agentic System via Experience-Driven Learning

author.name: Kailin Zhuang, Jiawei Wu, Zhi Jin

entry.summary: EvoIR-Agent introduces a self-evolving image restoration system that learns from experience to improve planning over time, resolving the dilemma between training-based efficiency and training-free compatibility with new tools.

entry.title: Segment Anything with Motion, Geometry, and Semantic Adaptation for Complex Nonlinear Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Deyi Zhu, Yuji Wang, Yong Liu, Yansong Tang, Bingyao Yu, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces SAMOSA, a tracking framework that adapts SAM 2 for visual object tracking by explicitly modeling target motion dynamics and enforcing geometric and semantic consistency across frames. Addresses limitations of directly applying SAM 2 to VOT with distractors, occlusion, and nonlinear motion.

entry.title: DecQ: Detail-Condensing Queries for Enhanced Reconstruction and Generation in Representation Autoencoders

author.name: Tianhang Wang, Yitong Chen, Wei Song, Zuxuan Wu, Min Li, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DecQ for Representation Autoencoders that introduces lightweight detail-condensing queries to extract fine-grained information from intermediate VFM features, resolving the trade-off between reconstruction quality and semantic space preservation in latent diffusion models.

entry.title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?

author.name: Caixin Kang, Tianyu Yan, Sitong Gong, Mingfang Zhang, Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Bo Zheng, Huchuan Lu, Kaipeng Zhang, Yoichi Sato, Yifei Huang

entry.summary: Formalizes Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR) requiring MLLMs to anchor Big Five ratings in observable behavioral evidence, and releases MM-OCEAN dataset (1,104 videos, 5,320 MCQs) to evaluate whether models truly perceive personality or rely on superficial pattern matching.

entry.title: Closed-Loop Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Deformable Microfiber Shape Control

author.name: Alessandro Amici, Houari Bettahar, Veeti Jaakkola, Quan Zhou

entry.summary: Demonstrates closed-loop sim-to-real RL for microfiber shape control, training in simplified frictionless simulator and relying on real-time visual feedback to correct unmodeled surface interactions at 40 Hz without retraining.

entry.title: Learning to Evolve: Multi-modal Interactive Fields for Robust Humanoid Navigation in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Peifeng Jiang, Hong Liu, Jin Jin, Wenshuai Wang, Xia Li

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-modal Interactive Field (MIF) for humanoid robot navigation, integrating confidence-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting, discrepancy-triggered spatial memory updates, and task-driven geometric reconstruction in a closed-loop pipeline designed for manipulation-oriented navigation under locomotion-induced distortion.

entry.title: Distribution-free root cause analysis

author.name: Rohan Hore, Aaditya Ramdas

entry.summary: Proposes CROC (Conformal Root Cause Analysis), a distribution-free framework for identifying the earliest-changing stream in multi-stream data using conformal p-values, providing finite-sample valid confidence sets under minimal assumptions.

entry.title: MMD-Balls as Credal Sets: A PAC-Bayesian Framework for Epistemic Uncertainty in Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Ahanaf Hasan Ariq

entry.summary: Develops a PAC-Bayesian framework for test-time adaptation with bounds parameterized by MMD between source and target distributions, interpreting MMD-balls as credal sets for epistemic uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Proxy-Based Approximation of Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions

author.name: Santo M. A. R. Thies, Hubert Baniecki, R. Teal Witter, Eyke H\"ullermeier, Maximilian Muschalik, Fabian Fumagalli

entry.summary: Introduces ProxySHAP for computing Shapley and Banzhaf interactions, combining tree-based proxy models for sample efficiency with residual correction for consistency. Derives polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP for exact interaction indices.

entry.title: The Matching Principle: A Geometric Theory of Loss Functions for Nuisance-Robust Representation Learning

author.name: Vishal Rajput

entry.summary: Proposes the Matching Principle: a geometric theory arguing that robustness, domain adaptation, invariance, and alignment safety all share the same statistical structure - estimating nuisance covariance and regularizing the encoder Jacobian accordingly.

entry.title: AutoRPA: Efficient GUI Automation through LLM-Driven Code Synthesis from Interactions

author.name: Minghao Chen, Xinyi Hu, Zhou Yu, Yufei Yin

entry.summary: AutoRPA bridges LLM agents and Robotic Process Automation by automatically distilling ReAct-style agent decision logic into efficient, reusable RPA functions, combining LLM reasoning with runtime efficiency.

entry.title: Automated Kernel Discovery Towards Understanding High-dimensional Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Taeyoung Yun, Woocheol Shin, Inhyuck Song, Jaewoo Lee, Jinkyoo Park

entry.summary: Kernel Discovery uses LLM-driven evolutionary search to discover GP kernels for high-dimensional Bayesian optimization, overcoming the limitations of fixed compositional rules and context-length constraints.

entry.title: ProcBench: Evaluating Process-Level Defects and Control Preservation in LLM Coding Agents

author.name: Jiawei He, Jie Jia, Chenbo Liu, Chaoyi Xue, Yapeng Song, Xikai Yang, Dong Sun

entry.summary: ProcBench evaluates process-level defects in LLM coding agent trajectories rather than just final outcomes, with an 11-type defect ontology and standardized trajectory representation for comparing heterogeneous agents.

entry.title: Weight Decay Regimes in Grokking Transformers: Cheap Online Diagnostics

author.name: Lucky Verma

entry.summary: Shows that weight decay acts as a scalar control parameter for memorization/generalization/collapse regimes in grokking transformers, and introduces cheap online diagnostics (attention-head cosine similarity and entropy standard deviation) to track these transitions.

entry.title: Symmetrization of Loss Functions for Robust Training of Neural Networks in the Presence of Noisy Labels

author.name: Alexandre Lemire Paquin, Brahim Chaib-Draa, Philippe Gigu\`ere

entry.summary: Studies a symmetrization method for loss functions robust to label noise, showing the multi-class unhinged loss is the unique convex symmetric loss under suitable assumptions. Provides theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: LOSCAR-SGD: Local SGD with Communication-Computation Overlap and Delay-Corrected Sparse Model Averaging

author.name: Yassine Maziane, Ammar Mahran, Artavazd Maranjyan, Peter Richt\'arik

entry.summary: Proposes LOSCAR-SGD combining communication compression, local training, and communication-computation overlap in distributed learning with heterogeneous compute, providing theoretical convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Modeling Temporal scRNA-seq Data with Latent Gaussian Process and Optimal Transport

author.name: Mehmet Yigit Balik, Harri L\"ahdesm\"aki

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for temporal single-cell RNA-seq data using latent heteroscedastic Gaussian processes with optimal transport alignment of population distributions.

entry.title: CRAFT: Conflict-Resolved Aggregation for Federated Training

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Qiang Liu, Nils Thuerey

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT for federated learning that formulates aggregation as finding the closest update to a reference direction while satisfying conflict-free alignment constraints, with a closed-form solution.

entry.title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation

author.name: Sixiang Chen, Zhaohu Xing, Tian Ye, Xinyu Geng, Yunlong Lin, Jianyu Lai, Xuanhua He, Fuxiang Zhai, Jialin Gao, Lei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes GenEvolve, a self-evolving image generation agent that improves through tool-orchestrated trajectories. Models generation as evidence gathering, reference selection, and skill composition into prompt-reference programs.

entry.title: GA-VLN: Geometry-Aware BEV Representation for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jiahao Yang, Zihan Wang, Xiangyang Li, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Yinghao Xu, Shuqiang Jiang

entry.summary: GA-VLN introduces Geometry-Aware BEV representation for Vision-Language Navigation that projects RGB-D features into 3D space and aggregates them into an agent-centric layout, reducing token redundancy while preserving geometric consistency for MLLM-based navigation.

entry.title: Spectral Tail Auxiliary Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Xingyi Li, Jiahui Zhang, Yiheng Li, Yun Cao, Wenhao Wang

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes spectral properties of AI-generated images, finding that generated images deviate from power-law decay with anomalous spectral tail behavior. Proposes a spectral tail auxiliary loss for improved detection generalization across generators.

entry.title: Cross-Species RSA Reveals Conserved Early Visual Alignment but Divergent Higher-Area Rankings Across Human fMRI and Macaque Electrophysiology

author.name: Nils Leutenegger

entry.summary: Tests whether the relationship between learning rules and brain alignment generalizes across species by comparing 5 learning rules (BP, FA, PC, STDP, untrained) against macaque electrophysiology data, finding conserved early visual alignment but divergent higher-area rankings.

entry.title: Higher Order Reasoning for Collaborative Communicationless Mobile Robot Operations

author.name: Jonathan Reasoner, Nicola Bezzo

entry.summary: Presents a dynamic epistemic planning framework enabling implicit coordination in communicationless multi-robot systems through higher-order reasoning (reasoning about teammates' beliefs about beliefs), integrated with MPPI controller.

entry.title: On the Sample Complexity of Discounted Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Certainty Equivalents

author.name: Oliver Mortensen, Mohammad Sadegh Talebi

entry.summary: Studies sample complexity of risk-sensitive RL with optimized certainty equivalents (OCE) in discounted MDPs, characterizing which utility functions yield PAC-learnable objectives and establishing when polynomial sample complexity is achievable.

entry.title: Insights Generator: Systematic Corpus-Level Trace Diagnostics for LLM Agents

author.name: Akshay Manglik (Emily), Apaar Shanker (Emily), Kaustubh Deshpande (Emily), Jason Qin (Emily), Yash Maurya (Emily), Veronica Chatrath (Emily), Vijay S. Kalmath (Emily), Levi Lentz (Emily), Yuan (Emily), Xue

entry.summary: Insights Generator formalizes corpus-level trace diagnostics for LLM agents - systematically analyzing execution traces across populations to identify behavioral patterns, rather than manual inspection of individual traces.

entry.title: GLeVE: Graph-Guided Lesion Grounding with Proposal Verification in 3D CT

author.name: Shuo Jiang, Yuhao Hong, Chunbo Jiang, Weihong Chen, Huangwei Chen, Shenghao Zhu, Beining Wu, Mingxuan Liu, Zhu Zhu, Feiwei Qin, Min Tan, Yifei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GLeVE for grounding radiology report descriptions to 3D CT volumes using graph-guided reasoning with anatomical priors and octree-based autoregressive refinement. Treats each lesion description as an atomic semantic unit with relation-aware graph reasoning.

entry.title: Learning Altruistic Collaboration in Heterogeneous Multi-Team Systems

author.name: Riwa Karam, Ruoyu Lin, Brooks A. Butler, Magnus Egerstedt

entry.summary: Studies multi-team collaboration through dynamic robot allocation using Hamilton's rule from ecology as altruistic decision-making, with GNN policy for scalable decentralized execution on team interaction graphs.

entry.title: AgentCo-op: Retrieval-Based Synthesis of Interoperable Multi-Agent Workflows

author.name: Shuaike Shen, Wenduo Cheng, Shike Wang, Mingqian Ma, Jian Ma

entry.summary: AgentCo-op is a retrieval-based framework for composing multi-agent workflows in open-ended scientific settings (demonstrated in genomics), using typed artifact handoffs and bounded self-guided repair when execution fails.

entry.title: Interaction Locality in Hierarchical Recursive Reasoning

author.name: Yosuke Miyanishi, Tetsuro Morimura

entry.summary: Proposes 'interaction locality' - a framework for measuring whether information flow in reasoning models stays within nearby cells or crosses semantic segments. Applies sparse-autoencoder ablations and activation patching to hierarchical reasoning models.

entry.title: ScenePilot: Controllable Boundary-Driven Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Qiyu Ruan, Yuxuan Wang, He Li, Zhenning Li, Cheng-zhong Xu

entry.summary: ScenePilot generates safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios that target the 'boundary band' - physically solvable but still challenging scenarios - addressing the gap between unrealistic crashes and too-easy tests.

entry.title: Network-Based Interventions for HIV Prevention via Cascade-Aware Suppression of Transmission

author.name: Akseli Kangaslahti, Davin Choo, Milind Tambe, Alastair van Heerden, Cheryl Johnson

entry.summary: Formalizes network-based HIV prevention as constrained optimization - selecting which virally unsuppressed individuals to treat to minimize cascade of new infections - establishing theoretical connections to influence maximization.

entry.title: TabPFN-MT: A Natively Multitask In-Context Learner for Tabular Data

author.name: Cormac Cureton, Narges Armanfard

entry.summary: TabPFN-MT extends Prior-Data Fitted Networks to multi-task tabular prediction, enabling simultaneous multi-target inference with inter-task information sharing through an expanded synthetic prior.

entry.title: FBOS-RL: Feedback-Driven Bi-Objective Synergistic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xikai Zhang, Yongzhi Li, Likang Xiao, Yingze Zhang, Yanhua Cheng, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang, Wenjun Wu, Liu Liu

entry.summary: FBOS-RL improves GRPO-style RL training by incorporating feedback-driven bi-objective sampling that adapts when tasks exceed the policy model's current capability, rather than conditioning all rollouts on the same prompt.

entry.title: Residual Paving: Diagnosing the Routing Bottleneck in Selective Refusal Editing

author.name: Bryce Hinkley, Peyman Najafirad

entry.summary: Residual Paving diagnoses the routing bottleneck in selective refusal editing by separating route selectivity (whether to intervene) from edit capacity (what to apply), using routed residual experts with oracle diagnostics.

entry.title: Targeting Clause Type Distributions: a Picklock for Random Satisfiability Problems

author.name: J. Schwardt, J. C. Budich

entry.summary: Target-SAT algorithm roughly triples tractable problem sizes in the hardest 3-SAT regime by leveraging statistical mechanics insights about clause type distributions rather than relying on traditional search heuristics.

entry.title: Complementing reinforcement learning with SFT through logit averaging in the post training of LLMs

author.name: Xingwei Gan, Ying Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes averaging logits of a frozen SFT reference policy and a trainable policy within GRPO, avoiding KL regularization while leveraging reasoning expertise from the trainable policy and formatting from SFT.

entry.title: Accelerating Video Inverse Problem Solvers with Autoregressive Diffusion Models

author.name: Taesung Kwon, Jonghyun Park, Hyungjin Chung, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: AVIS uses autoregressive video diffusion models to solve video inverse problems in a streaming manner, reducing latency and throughput issues compared to non-autoregressive solvers. Initializes reverse diffusion with measurement-consistent estimates to reduce sampling steps.

entry.title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals

author.name: Duy Nguyen, Hanqi Xiao, Archiki Prasad, Zaid Khan, Anirban Das, Austin Zhang, Sambit Sahu, Hyunji Lee, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: AVSD addresses self-distillation with multiple teacher views (solutions, demonstrations, feedback) by adaptively balancing consensus across views and managing the asymmetry between teacher-accessible and student-accessible information.

entry.title: Interpretable Discriminative Text Representations via Agreement and Label Disentanglement

author.name: Tong Wang, Yiqing Xu, Leo Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes operational criteria for interpretable text representations requiring both annotator agreement on feature definitions and label disentanglement (features shouldn't paraphrase the target), establishing measurable standards.

entry.title: Llamas on the Web: Memory-Efficient, Performance-Portable, and Multi-Precision LLM Inference with WebGPU

author.name: Reese Levine, Rithik Sharma, Nikhil Jain, Abhijit Ramesh, Zheyuan Chen, Neha Abbas, James Contini, Tyler Sorensen

entry.summary: LlamaWeb is a WebGPU backend for llama.cpp enabling memory-efficient, performance-portable LLM inference in browsers across various quantization formats, with static memory planning and tunable kernel library.

entry.title: AGPO: Adaptive Group Policy Optimization with Dual Statistical Feedback

author.name: Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Bokun Wang, Ruohan Wang, Xin Wang, Xiaobo Guo, Daren Zha, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: AGPO is a critic-free refinement of GRPO using group-level statistics for adaptive clipping and bidirectional temperature sampling, making RL training less brittle and tuning-heavy.

entry.title: GraphRAG on Consumer Hardware: Benchmarking Local LLMs for Healthcare EHR Schema Retrieval

author.name: Peter Fernandes, Ria Kanjilal

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates Microsoft's GraphRAG pipeline for healthcare EHR schema retrieval using locally-deployed open-source LLMs (Llama 3.1 8B, Mistral 7B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Phi-4-mini) on consumer hardware.

entry.title: ArchSIBench: Benchmarking the Architectural Spatial Intelligence of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qirui Shen, Wenda Wang, Jiachen Lu, Zilong Huang, Jin Bai, Lei He, Hongxuan Chen, Weixin Huang

entry.summary: Introduces ArchSIBench, a benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models on architectural spatial intelligence including layout understanding, circulation patterns, and functional zoning - going beyond basic spatial skills.

entry.title: Strategy-Induct: Task-Level Strategy Induction for Instruction Generation

author.name: Po-Chun Chen, Hen-Hsen Huang, Hsin-Hsi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Strategy-Induct, a framework that derives task-level instructions from example questions alone (without labeled answers) by first generating reasoning strategies then inducing task instructions from (strategy, question) pairs.

entry.title: Fine-grained Claim-level RAG Benchmark for Law

author.name: Souvick Das, Sallam Abualhaija, Domenico Bianculli

entry.summary: Introduces a fine-grained claim-level RAG benchmark for legal domain, enabling separate evaluation of retrieval and generation performance with multilingual support beyond English-only benchmarks.

entry.title: ACL-Verbatim: hallucination-free question answering for research

author.name: G\'abor Recski, Szilveszter T\'oth, Nadia Verdha, Istv\'an Boros, \'Ad\'am Kov\'acs

entry.summary: Presents ACL-Verbatim, an extractive QA system that maps queries to verbatim text spans in ACL Anthology papers, eliminating hallucination by design. Includes a novel ground truth dataset annotated by NLP researchers.

entry.title: Learning Structural Latent Points for Efficient Visual Representations in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yicheng Jiang, Jiaxu Wang, Junhao He, Zesen Gan, Junhao Li, Qiang Zhang, Jingkai Sun, Jiahang Cao, Mingyuan Sun, Xiangyu Yue, Qiming Shao

entry.summary: Proposes a pretraining framework learning structural latent points - a hybrid representation combining implicit neural features with explicit geometric structure for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Deformba: Vision State Space Model with Adaptive State Fusion

author.name: Hongyu Ke, Jack Morris, Yongkang Liu, Satoshi Kitai, Kentaro Oguchi, Yi Ding, Haoxin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Deformba, a vision state space model with adaptive state fusion that replaces fixed scanning with learned geometric structures and enables query-based interactions between information streams.

entry.title: Data-Efficient Neural Operator Training via Physics-Based Active Learning

author.name: Alicja Polanska, Lorenzo Zanisi, Vignesh Gopakumar, Stanislas Pamela

entry.summary: Introduces physics-based acquisition for active learning of neural operators, using PDE residuals to guide data selection for training on Burgers and Navier-Stokes equations.

entry.title: Designing Conversations with the Dead: How People Engage with Generative Ghosts

author.name: Jack Manning, Daniel Sullivan, Dylan Thomas Doyle, Anthony T. Pinter, Jed R. Brubaker

entry.summary: Qualitative study examining how 16 participants experience two designs of 'generative ghosts' (AI trained on data of deceased people): representation (third-person) vs reincarnation (first-person), exploring authenticity, affect, and risk.

entry.title: Approximation Theory for Neural Networks: Old and New

author.name: Soumendu Sundar Mukherjee, Himasish Talukdar

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of approximation theory for neural networks spanning four decades, from classical universal approximation theorems to modern quantitative results on depth, width, and approximation rates.

entry.title: TreeText-CTS: Compact, Source-Traceable Tree-Path Evidence for Irregular Clinical Time-Series Prediction

author.name: Kwanhyung Lee, Juhwan Choi, Jongheon Kim, Joohyung Lee, Hyeongwon Jang, Eunho Yang

entry.summary: Introduces TreeText-CTS that converts irregular EHR trajectories into human-readable, compact, source-traceable tree-path evidence for clinical time-series prediction without summarization or autoregressive decoding.

entry.title: SMA-DP: Spectral Memory-Aware Differential Privacy for Deep Learning

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia

entry.summary: Proposes SMA-DP-SGD, augmenting differentially private SGD with a fractional memory branch from previously privatized releases, using power-law spectral exponents for layer-wise reliability signals.

entry.title: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations

author.name: Ali Ramlaoui, Alexandre Duval, Hannah Bull, Victor Schmidt, Hugues Talbot, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros, Joseph Musielewicz

entry.summary: Presents TriForces, a model-agnostic three-stream framework for machine learning interatomic potentials that separates composition and structure information with self-supervised learning for transferable representations.

entry.title: Modular Multimodal Classification Without Fine-Tuning: A Simple Compositional Approach

author.name: Herman Bergstr\"om, Aditya Mehrotra, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces CoMET, a simple multimodal classification method that passes modalities through frozen backbones, compresses with PCA, and feeds into a Tabular Foundation Model. Proposes PALPooling for better token pooling.

entry.title: CIG: Exploration via Conditional Information Gain

author.name: Tim Joseph, Marcus Fechner, Philipp Stegmaier, Karam Daaboul, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Derives CIG (Conditional Information Gain) reward for exploration in RL that conditions on both replay buffer and rollout prefix simultaneously, using ensemble disagreement as a tractable surrogate.

entry.title: Point Cloud Sequence Encoding for Material-conditioned Graph Network Simulators

author.name: Philipp Dahlinger, Bal\'azs Gyenes, Niklas Freymuth, Luca Geminiani, Tobias W\"urth, Johannes Mitsch, Nadja Klein, Luise K\"arger, Gerhard Neumann

entry.summary: Introduces PEACH, a framework using in-context learning on point clouds to adapt learned physics simulators to unseen material properties without access to underlying parameters.

entry.title: UOTIP: Unbalanced Optimal Transport Map for Unpaired Inverse Problems

author.name: Donggyu Lee, Taekyung Lee, Jaewoong Choi

entry.summary: Proposes UOTIP, using unbalanced optimal transport for unpaired image inverse problems. The UOT framework provides robustness to multi-level noise and class imbalance by relaxing exact marginal constraints.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptable Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation with Dense Rewards

author.name: Erfan Aghadavoodi Jolfaei, Daniel Maninger, Abhinav Anand, Mert Tiftikci, Mira Mezini

entry.summary: Proposes an RL framework for domain-adaptable code generation that uses proximal policy optimization with customizable execution-aware rewards covering syntax, correctness, style, security, and domain-specific constraints.

entry.title: Automatic Discovery of Disease Subgroups by Contrasting with Healthy Controls

author.name: Robin Louiset, Edouard Duchesnay, Benoit Dufumier, Antoine Grigis, Pietro Gori

entry.summary: Proposes Deep UCSL for biomedical subgroup discovery that contrasts patients with healthy controls to identify disease subgroups driven by pathological factors rather than common variability.

entry.title: MedCRP-CL: Continual Medical Image Segmentation via Bayesian Nonparametric Semantic Modality Discovery

author.name: Ziyuan Gao

entry.summary: Proposes MedCRP-CL for continual medical image segmentation using Chinese Restaurant Process for online task structure discovery, allowing dynamic grouping of tasks that share structure.

entry.title: OlmoEarth v1.1: A more efficient family of OlmoEarth models

author.name: Gabriel Tseng, Yawen Zhang, Favyen Bastani, Henry Herzog, Joseph Redmon, Hadrien Sablon, Piper Wolters, Patrick Alan Johnson, Christopher Wilhelm, Patrick Beukema

entry.summary: Presents improvements to OlmoEarth family of earth observation models achieving 1.7x training compute reduction and 2.9x inference MAC reduction on Sentinel-2 tasks while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Concentration of General Stochastic Approximation Under Heavy-Tailed Markovian Noise

author.name: Shubhada Agrawal, Siva Theja Maguluri, Martin Zubeldia

entry.summary: Establishes maximal concentration bounds for stochastic approximation algorithms with general step sizes under heavy-tailed Markovian noise. Shows tail behavior ranges from sub-Gaussian to sub-Weibull depending on step size and contraction properties.

entry.title: Velocityformer: Broken-Symmetry-Matched Equivariant Graph Transformers for Cosmological Velocity Reconstruction

author.name: Tilman Tr\"oster, David Mirkovic, Veronika Oehl, Arne Thomsen

entry.summary: Introduces Velocityformer, an equivariant graph transformer for cosmological velocity reconstruction that matches the broken symmetry of observational data (translation+rotation equivariance broken by line-of-sight direction).

entry.title: Comparing LLM and Fine-Tuned Model Performance on NVDRS Circumstance Extraction with Varying Prompt Complexity

author.name: Geoffrey Martin, Xuan Zhong Feng, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Develops a complexity score algorithm to predict when detailed prompts improve LLM performance over simple prompts for extracting suicide circumstances from death investigation narratives, showing LLMs outperform fine-tuned RoBERTa on complex cases.

entry.title: IdioLink: Retrieving Meaning Beyond Words Across Idiomatic and Literal Expressions

author.name: Kai Golan Hashiloni, Daniel Fadlon, Lior Livyatan, Ofri Hefetz, Jiahuan Pei, Kfir Bar

entry.summary: Introduces IdioLink, a retrieval benchmark testing whether models can link idiomatic expressions to conceptually equivalent meanings in literal or paraphrased forms, showing current embedding models struggle with this task.

entry.title: Modeling Pathology-Like Behavioral Patterns in Language Models Through Behavioral Fine-Tuning

author.name: Nicola Milano, Davide Marocco

entry.summary: Introduces behavioral fine-tuning of LLMs on synthetic datasets inspired by maladaptive behavioral patterns (depression, paranoia), showing stable context-general shifts in generative distributions.

entry.title: BeLink: Biomedical Entity Linking Meets Generative Re-Ranking

author.name: Darya Shlyk, Stefano Montanelli, Lawrence Hunter

entry.summary: Proposes BeLink, a modular biomedical entity linking system with a generative re-ranker using set-wise instruction-tuning, achieving 3-24% accuracy improvements while reducing inference time.

entry.title: Detecting Synthetic Political Narratives in Cross-Platform Social Media Discourse

author.name: Despoina Antonakaki, Sotiris Ioannidis

entry.summary: Presents a cross-platform framework for detecting synthetic political narratives using coordination signals (lexical diversity, temporal burstiness, rhetorical repetition, semantic homogenization). Applied to 353K records from Telegram and Reddit across geopolitical events.

entry.title: SceneGraphGrounder: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding via Structured Scene Graph Matching

author.name: Xuefei Sun, Xujia Zhang, Brendan Crowe, Doncey Albin, Christoffer Heckman

entry.summary: Proposes SceneGraphGrounder for zero-shot 3D visual grounding through structured scene graph matching. Uses visual marker prompting with VLMs to infer relationships from 2D views, lifted into 3D scene graphs.

entry.title: Thermo-VL: Extending Vision-Language Models to Thermal Infrared Perception

author.name: Rusiru Thushara, Yasiru Ranasinghe, Jay Paranjape, Vishal M. Patel

entry.summary: Introduces Thermo-VL, extending VLMs to thermal infrared perception with a trainable thermal encoder and text-guided dual-attention fusion on top of frozen Molmo-7B. Enables perception under low illumination.

entry.title: Interpreting and Enhancing Emotional Circuits in Large Vision-Language Models via Cross-Modal Information Flow

author.name: Chengsheng Zhang, Chenghao Sun, Zhining Xie, Xinmei Tian

entry.summary: This paper introduces a steering-vector-based causal attribution framework for understanding how Large Vision-Language Models process emotional content, discovering a functional decoupling in the 'Adapt-Aggregate-Execute' mechanism for emotional reasoning.

entry.title: PointLLM-R: Enhancing 3D Point Cloud Reasoning via Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Chaoqi Chen, Qile Xu, Wenjun Zhou, Hui Huang

entry.summary: PointLLM-R proposes a data-centric framework for building Chain-of-Thought supervision for 3D point cloud understanding, using a two-stage pipeline of quality refinement and CoT synthesis to enhance reasoning capabilities of 3D multimodal models.

entry.title: EasyVFX: Frequency-Driven Decoupling for Resource-Efficient VFX Generation

author.name: Yue Ma, Xu Ye, Qinghe Wang, Yucheng Wang, Hongyu Liu, Yinhan Zhang, Xinyu Wang, Yuanpeng Che, Shanhui Mo, Paul Liang, Fangneng Zhan, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: EasyVFX achieves realistic visual effects synthesis under resource constraints by decomposing VFX into high-frequency spatial textures and low-frequency motion dynamics in the frequency domain, transforming a complex learning problem into manageable sub-tasks.

entry.title: Echo4DIR: 4D Implicit Heart Reconstruction from 2D Echocardiography Videos

author.name: Yanan Liu, Qinya Li, Hao Zhang, Kangjian He, Xuan Yang, Hao Li, Dan Xu, Lei Li

entry.summary: Echo4DIR reconstructs 4D cardiac geometry from sparse 2D echocardiography using implicit representations, learning 3D priors from statistical shape models and using self-supervised differentiable rendering for patient-specific adaptation without 3D ground truth.

entry.title: JMed48k: A Multi-Profession Japanese Medical Licensing Benchmark for Vision-Language Model Evaluation

author.name: Yue Xun, Junyu Liu, Qian Niu, Xinyi Wang, Zheng Yuan, Zirui Li, Zequn Zhang, Bowen Zhao, Shujun Wang, Irene Li, Kan Hatakeyama-Sato, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: JMed48k is a large-scale Japanese medical licensing benchmark with 48,862 questions from 11 national exams (2005-2025) for evaluating vision-language models, including an 8-type visual content taxonomy and evaluation of 21 models.

entry.title: GazePrior: Zero-Shot AR/VR Eye Tracking via Learned 3D Gaze Reconstruction

author.name: Corentin Dumery, David Colmenares, Alexander Fix, Pascal Fua, Ali Behrooz, Jogendra Kundu

entry.summary: GazePrior introduces a data-driven 3D prior for human eyes that enables sparse-input 3D reconstruction of training data collected with previous eye tracking devices, which can be rendered for any target device, achieving zero-shot cross-device generalization.

entry.title: The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation

author.name: Yongjin Cui, Xiaohui Fan

entry.summary: Argues that model interpretation methods generally neglect the baseline choice, which leads to imprecise or incorrect attributions. Unifies gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients, and Taylor expansion, identifying the baseline for each.

entry.title: MaSC: A Masked Similarity Metric for Evaluating Concept-Driven Generation

author.name: Patryk Bartkowiak, Lennart Petersen, Bartosz Kotrys, Dominik Michels, Soren Pirk, Wojtek Palubicki

entry.summary: MaSC introduces a masked similarity metric using foreground masks to separately evaluate concept preservation (subject fidelity) and prompt following (background/context) for text-to-image personalization, showing better human correlation than global metrics.

entry.title: MOTOR: A Multimodal Dataset for Two-Wheeler Rider Behavior Understanding

author.name: Varun A. Paturkar, Shankar Gangisetty, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: Presents MOTOR, the first large-scale multimodal dataset for two-wheeler rider behavior understanding with 1,629 sequences (25+ hours) including multi-view video, eye-gaze, audio, and telemetry from 16 riders in dense unstructured traffic. Addresses the critical gap in road safety research for the Global South.

entry.title: Don't Collapse Your Features: Why CenterLoss Hurts OOD Detection and Multi-Scale Mahalanobis Wins

author.name: Rahul D Ray

entry.summary: Introduces GOEN pipeline for OOD detection and reveals a counter-intuitive finding: CenterLoss, designed for feature compactness, actually hurts OOD detection by reducing AUROC. Proposes multi-scale Mahalanobis distance with calibration as an alternative.

entry.title: AwareVLN: Reasoning with Self-awareness for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Wenxuan Guo, Xiuwei Xu, Yichen Liu, Xiangyu Li, Hang Yin, Huangxing Chen, Wenzhao Zheng, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes AwareVLN, a framework for Vision-Language Navigation that adds self-aware reasoning to understand agent-instruction-scene relationships without requiring 3D sensors, bridging the gap between VLM-based and map-based navigation approaches.

entry.title: Canonical Functionalism: Defining Functional Structure without Observer-Relative Semantic Maps

author.name: Ryota Kanai, Shuqin Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a mathematical refinement of functionalism about consciousness that identifies functional structure with the minimal state-transition structure (canonical form) obtained by identifying states with identical future behavior under all continuations.

entry.title: CoRMA: Contrastive RMA for Contact-Rich Meta-Adaptation

author.name: Wentian Wang, Chutong Wen, Hongxu Ma, Wuhao Wang, Zhexiong Xue, Abdul Haseeb Nizamani, Dandi Zhou, Xinhai Sun, Jianqiao Zhu

entry.summary: Presents CoRMA, a meta-adaptation framework for contact-rich assembly that replaces raw parameter adaptation with a compact 6D semantic contact context. A causal Transformer infers contact context online for within-episode adaptation without demonstrations or gradient updates.

entry.title: Beyond Euclidean Proximity: Repairing Latent World Models with Horizon-Matched Trajectory Reachability Metrics

author.name: Liangyu Li, Shengzhi Wang, Qingwen Liu

entry.summary: Proposes trajectory reachability metrics (TRM) as a post-hoc terminal-ranking method for latent world models in MPC, replacing Euclidean distance with learned pairwise metrics that respect actual reachability structure.

entry.title: Representation Gap: Explaining the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Neural Networks from a Geometric Perspective

author.name: David Perera, Victor Moura, Lais Isabelle Alves dos Santos, Michel F. C. Haddad, Flavio Figueiredo

entry.summary: Introduces the Representation Gap metric for characterizing neural network generalization, showing it is governed by the intrinsic dimension of the task. Derives asymptotic equivalents for equivariant diffusion models using optimal quantization theory.

entry.title: Three Costs of Amortizing Gaussian Process Inference with Neural Processes

author.name: Robin Young

entry.summary: Bounds the KL divergence between Gaussian process and latent neural process predictives, decomposing it into three interpretable sources: label contamination, information bottleneck, and amortization error.

entry.title: Apr-May 2026 AI Security via Formal Methods

author.name: Quinn

entry.summary: Newsletter covering AI security via formal methods activities including a Secure Program Synthesis hackathon, fellowship applications, and new companies (Midspiral, Sequent, Sigil Logic) working on formal verification for AI safety.

entry.title: Personality Engineering with AI Agents: A New Methodology for Negotiation Research

author.name: Michelle A. Vaccaro, Jared R. Curhan

entry.summary: Introduces 'personality engineering' as a methodology using AI agents to precisely parameterize and manipulate negotiator personality traits, enabling controlled experiments that test canonical negotiation theory prescriptions.

entry.title: Quadratic Characterizations for Reachability Analysis of Neural Networks

author.name: Elias Khalife, Mazen Farhood, Pierre-Loic Garoche

entry.summary: Develops a framework for constructing verified quadratic characterizations of scalar relations for neural network reachability analysis, using SOS certificates for global verification.

entry.title: An exponential mechanism based on quadratic approximations for fine-tuning machine learning models with privacy guarantees

author.name: Hoang Tran, Jorge Ramirez, Jiayi Wang, Alberto Bocchinfuso, Christopher Stanley, M. Paul Laiu

entry.summary: Develops a differential privacy mechanism for fine-tuning using the exponential mechanism with local quadratic approximations, enabling exact sampling from a multivariate normal in closed form.

entry.title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front

author.name: Liuyuan Jiang, Chentong Huang, Lisha Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SURF for uniform Pareto front coverage through scalarization weight selection, deriving a principled arc-length CDF inversion approach that produces uniform solutions.

entry.title: Finite-Time Regret Analysis of Retry-Aware Bandits

author.name: Bingkui Tong, Junpei Komiyama, Soichiro Nishimori, Paavo Parmas

entry.summary: Provides first sublinear regret bound for ReMax, a bandit algorithm motivated by retry-aware objectives (pass@k, max@k), characterizing the optimal distribution through an expected-improvement balance condition.

entry.title: NeighborDiv: Training-free Zero-shot Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Neighbor Diversity

author.name: Kaifeng Wei, Teng Liu, Liang Dong, Xiubo Liang, Yuke Li

entry.summary: Proposes NeighborDiv, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework based on neighbor diversity, shifting from node-to-neighbor consistency to neighbor-to-neighbor diversity paradigm.

entry.title: Adaptive Signal Resuscitation: Channel-wise Post-Pruning Repair for Sparse Vision Networks

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Ziheng Chen, Minxuan Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Signal Resuscitation (ASR), a training-free channel-wise repair method for neural network pruning that matches repair granularity to damage granularity, preventing over-amplification of damaged channels.

entry.title: Is Fixing Schema Graphs Necessary? Full-Resolution Graph Structure Learning for Relational Deep Learning

author.name: Yi Huang, Qingyun Sun, Jia Li, Xingcheng Fu, Jianxin Li

entry.summary: Proposes FROG, a learnable graph structure framework for relational deep learning that allows tables to flexibly serve as nodes or edges rather than relying on fixed schema-determined structures.

entry.title: The Double Dilemma in Multi-Task Radiology Report Generation: A Gradient Dynamics Analysis and Solution

author.name: Erjian Zhang, Yatong Hao, Liejun Wang, Zhiqing Guo

entry.summary: Analyzes gradient dynamics failure in multi-task radiology report generation using SDE framework, identifying a 'Double Dilemma' of drift deviation and diffusion decay. Proposes a backbone-agnostic optimizer.

entry.title: Beyond Chamfer Distance: Granular Order-aware Evaluation Metric For Online Mapping

author.name: Chouaib Bencheikh Lehocine, Adam Lilja, Junsheng Fu, Lars Hammarstrand

entry.summary: Introduces SOSPA (Sequence Optimal Sub-Pattern Assignment), a new evaluation metric for online mapping that is sensitive to point ordering and provides more granular geometric quality assessment than Chamfer Distance. Addresses limitations in autonomous driving map evaluation.

entry.title: Synthetic Data Alone is Enough? Rethinking Data Scarcity in Pediatric Rare Disease Recognition

author.name: Ganlin Feng, Yuxi Long, Erin Lou, Lianghong Chen, Zihao Jing, Pingzhao Hu, Wei Xu

entry.summary: Studies whether synthetic data alone is sufficient for pediatric rare disease facial recognition under extreme data scarcity. Evaluates synthetic-only training regime for learning distinctive facial phenotypes without real patient data.

entry.title: LACO: Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving

author.name: Tianhao Chen, Yuheng Wu, Dongman Lee

entry.summary: Introduces LACO for collaborative driving that analyzes latent communication to address agent identity confusion and high latency from autoregressive language-based coordination, proposing adaptive latent feature exchange.

entry.title: Steins;Gate Drive: Semantic Safety Arbitration over Structured Futures for Latency-Decoupled LLM Planning

author.name: Anjie Qiu, Hans D. Schotten

entry.summary: Presents SteinsGateDrive, a latency-decoupled architecture for LLM-based autonomous driving that uses a worldline metaphor where the LLM selects counterfactual driving futures before the control instant, while a runtime safety layer monitors validity contracts.

entry.title: Expectation Consistency Loss: Rethink Confidence Calibration under Covariate Shift

author.name: Jinzong Dong, Zhaohui Jiang, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Derives a necessary and sufficient condition (Expectation consistency) for confidence calibration under covariate shifts, addressing limitations of existing methods that rely on unstable importance weighting.

entry.title: Multiple Neural Operators Achieve Near-Optimal Rates for Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Adrien Weihs, Hayden Schaeffer

entry.summary: Studies approximation and statistical complexity of Multiple Neural Operators (MNO) for multi-task operator learning, proving near-optimal bounds showing that shared representations don't increase overall cost compared to single-task learning.

entry.title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery

author.name: Xin-De Wang, Zhi-Rui Chen, Ze-Feng Gao, Peng-Jie Guo, Cheng Mu, Zhong-Yi Lu

entry.summary: LEAP combines a domain-specialized LLM with active learning in a closed-loop framework for discovering perovskite solar cell precursor additives, using interpretable descriptors and Bayesian optimization.

entry.title: Same Target, Different Basins: Hard vs. Soft Labels for Annotator Distributions

author.name: Mirerfan Gheibi, Gashin Ghazizadeh

entry.summary: Studies hard-label delivery vs. soft-label training when modeling annotator disagreement. Finds hard-label methods improve over soft labels when only sparse annotations are available on CIFAR-10H.

entry.title: A Deployment Audit of Release-Side Risk in Conformal Triage under Prevalence Shift

author.name: Chengze Li, Xiao Liu, Hanrong Zhang, Haiyang Peng, Yanghao Ruan, Huanhuan Ma, Chunyu Miao, Qichao Zhou, Xiangrong Qi, Philip Yu

entry.summary: Introduces a leakage-aware deployment audit for conformal triage under prevalence shift, evaluating whether event-positive patients are inappropriately released without review.

entry.title: FedCoE: Bridging Generalization and Personalization via Federated Coordinated Dual-level MoEs

author.name: Penglin Dai, Fulian Li, Xincao Xu, Junhua Wang, Lixin Duan, Xiao Wu

entry.summary: Proposes FedCoE, a federated learning framework using dual-level mixture-of-experts to balance global generalization with local personalization, addressing both non-IID data and cold-start problems.

entry.title: Group-Aware Matrix Estimation and Latent Subspace Recovery

author.name: Hamza Golubovic, Matthew Shen, Genevera I. Allen, Tarek M. Zikry

entry.summary: Introduces GAME (Group-Aware Matrix Estimation) for overlapping subgroup-wise low-rank matrix completion, using overlapping nuclear-norm penalties to allow related groups to share information while preserving subgroup variation.

entry.title: Exposing Vulnerabilities in Visible-Infrared VLMs: A Unified Geometric Adversarial Framework with Cross-Task Transferability

author.name: Xiang Chen, Yuxian Dong, Chao Li, Chengyin Hu, Jiaju Han, Fengyu Zhang, Yiwei Wei, Jiahuan Long, Jiujiang Guo

entry.summary: CFGPatch proposes curved-edge fractal geometric adversarial patches for attacking visible-infrared vision-language models, demonstrating cross-task transferability across detection, tracking, and VQA.

entry.title: Towards Clinically Interpretable Ophthalmic VQA via Spatially-Grounded Lesion Evidence

author.name: Xingyue Wang, Bo Liu, Meng Wang, Zhixuan Zhang, Chengcheng Zhu, Huazhu Fu, Jiang Liu

entry.summary: FundusGround introduces a benchmark for clinically interpretable ophthalmic VQA with spatially-grounded lesion evidence, requiring models to provide explicit visual evidence using ETDRS grid localization alongside answers.

entry.title: Enhancing Gaze Reasoning in Vision Foundation Models for Gaze Following

author.name: Shijing Wang, Yaping Huang, Chaoqun Cui, David Wong, Yihua Cheng, Alexandros Neophytou, Hyung Jin Chang

entry.summary: Identifies that vision foundation models contribute strong scene understanding but little to actual gaze reasoning in gaze following tasks, often relying on salient objects instead. Proposes training mechanisms including head-conditioned augmentation to enhance genuine gaze reasoning.

entry.title: Temporal Coding as a Substrate for Sensorimotor Object Inference: A Spiking Reinterpretation of Thousand Brains Architecture

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Proposes a spiking neural network reinterpretation of the Thousand Brains Theory that uses temporal coding (spike timing and order) to encode directional sequences of sensory contacts, adding spatial meaning that the original dense floating-point representation lacks.

entry.title: MoSA: Motion-constrained Stress Adaptation for Mitigating Real-to-Sim Gap in Continuum Dynamics via Learning Residual Anisotropy

author.name: Jiaxu Wang, Junhao He, Jingkai Sun, Yi Gu, Yunyang Mo, Jiahang Cao, Qiang Zhang, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Proposes MoSA for mitigating real-to-sim gap by learning residual anisotropy and heterogeneity in material dynamics after a near-isotropic backbone is calibrated, combining physical priors with learned corrections.

entry.title: SOLAR: A Self-Optimizing Open-Ended Autonomous Agent for Lifelong Learning and Continual Adaptation

author.name: Nitin Vetcha, Dianbo Liu

entry.summary: SOLAR proposes an autonomous agent that uses parameter-level meta-learning to self-improve in streaming/continual learning settings, treating model weights as an exploration environment. It addresses concept drift and catastrophic forgetting without gradient-based fine-tuning.

entry.title: Governance by Construction for Generalist Agents

author.name: Segev Shlomov, Iftach Shoham, Alon Oved, Ido Levy, Sami Marreed, Harold Ship, Offer Akrabi, Sergey Zeltyn, Avi Yaeli, Nir Mashkif

entry.summary: Presents CUGA's policy-as-code governance system for enterprise LLM agents, providing modular runtime policy enforcement at every execution stage without model fine-tuning. Enables predictable, auditable, compliance-aware behavior.

entry.title: Evaluating multimodal emotion recognition in proactive conversational agents: A user study

author.name: Adnana Dragut, Raquel Lacuesta, F. Xavier Gaya-Morey, Jose M. Buades-Rubio

entry.summary: User study reveals that automated facial emotion recognition fails in AI interactions due to a 'poker face' effect - users display serious expressions regardless of internal state - while linguistic analysis better captures true emotions.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty

author.name: Prakash Aryan, Kaushik Raghupathruni, Timo Kehrer, Sebastiano Panichella

entry.summary: Uses multi-agent RL to jointly train pedestrians and self-driving cars, producing more realistic interaction scenarios with heterogeneous pedestrian behaviors governed by latent personality traits.

entry.title: SDM: A Powerful Tool for Evaluating Model Robustness

author.name: Xinlei Liu, Tao Hu, Jichao Xie, Peng Yi, Hailong Ma, Baolin Li

entry.summary: SDM introduces a novel gradient-based adversarial attack that maximizes the difference between non-ground-truth label probability upper bound and ground-truth probability, addressing the 'high-loss non-adversarial examples' issue in prior methods like APGD.

entry.title: Causal Unlearning in Collaborative Optimization: Exact and Approximate Influence Reversal under Adversarial Contributions

author.name: Ali Mahdavi, Azadeh Zamanifar, Amirfarhad Farhadi, Omid Kashefi

entry.summary: HF-KCU removes a federated learning client's contribution via influence function approximation in Krylov subspaces, reducing complexity from O(d³) to O(kd). Includes causal weighting to prevent spurious updates and handles adversarial perturbations.

entry.title: ConceptSeg-R1: Segment Any Concept via Meta-Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuan Zhao, Youwei Pang, Jiaming Zuo, Wei Ji, Kailai Zhou, Bin Fan, Yunkang Cao, Lihe Zhang, Xiaofeng Liu, Huchuan Lu, Weisi Lin, Dacheng Tao, Xiaoqi Zhao

entry.summary: ConceptSeg-R1 proposes a three-level taxonomy for concept segmentation (context-independent, context-dependent, context-reasoning) and uses meta-reinforcement learning for rule-induced concept grounding to handle increasing cognitive complexity.

entry.title: Axiomatizing Neural Networks via Pursuit of Subspaces

author.name: Mehmet Yamac, Mert Duman, Ugur Akpinar, Felix Rojas Casadiego, Serkan Kiranyaz, Marcel van Gerven, Moncef Gabbouj

entry.summary: Introduces the Pursuit of Subspaces (PoS) hypothesis as an axiomatic framework for neural network behavior through geometric postulates, providing unified perspective on representation, computation, and generalization.

entry.title: Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management

author.name: Mengyang Liu, Taozhi Chen, Zhenhua Xu, Xue Jiang, Yihong Dong

entry.summary: STORM manages multi-agent collaboration on shared codebases by mediating agent-workspace interactions to ensure consistent views and detect conflicting edits proactively, rather than deferring to post-hoc merge.

entry.title: Beyond Routing: Characterising Expert Tuning and Representation in Vision Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Gene Tangtartharakul, Katherine R. Storrs

entry.summary: Characterizes expert specialization in Vision MoE models using neuroscience tools beyond routing analysis, measuring per-expert category separability and tuning via most exciting inputs and human behavioral similarity judgements.

entry.title: Distributional Alignment as a Criterion for Designing Task Vectors in In-Context Learning

author.name: Jihoon Kwon, Jiwon Choi, Jy-yong Sohn

entry.summary: Introduces d_NTP metric measuring distributional alignment between task vector-based inference and full ICL, and uses it as a criterion for designing better task vector extraction methods for in-context learning.

entry.title: TASTE: A Designer-Annotated Multi-Dimensional Preference Dataset for AI-Generated Graphic Design

author.name: Haonan Zhu, Elad Hirsch, Alexandria Minetti, Allison Nulty, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: TASTE is a dataset of professional designer rankings of AI-generated graphic designs across 9 criteria (typography, visual hierarchy, color harmony, etc.) from 10 designers on 4 text-to-image models, revealing that models vary substantially across dimensions.

entry.title: Tunable MAGMAX: Preference-Aware Model Merging for Continual Learning

author.name: Kei Hiroshima, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Proposes Tunable MAGMAX, a model merging framework for continual learning that allows preference-aware control of task-specific performance through a preference vector, enabling deployment customization.

entry.title: Beyond Text-to-SQL: An Agentic LLM System for Governed Enterprise Analytics APIs

author.name: Gundeep Singh, Parsa Kavehzadeh, Jing Xia, Xue-Yong Fu, Julien Bouvier Tremblay, Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Vincent Lum, Shashi Bhushan TN

entry.summary: Presents Analytic Agent, an LLM-based agentic system for enterprise analytics that interfaces with governed APIs rather than raw databases, ensuring consistency, auditability, and security in enterprise settings.

entry.title: Divide et Calibra: Multiclass Local Calibration via Vector Quantization

author.name: Cesare Barbera, Lorenzo Perini, Giovanni De Toni, Andrea Passerini, Andrea Pugnana

entry.summary: Proposes a compositional approach to multiclass calibration using Vector Quantization to partition representation space and indexed Dirichlet concentrations for region-specific calibration maps.

entry.title: SymbolicLight V1: Spike-Gated Dual-Path Language Modeling with High Activation Sparsity and Sub-Billion-Scale Pre-Training Evidence

author.name: Ting Liu
