entry.summary: Proposes using influence functions for concept-level interpretability in NLP models, demonstrating that model performance can be restored by adjusting labels/weights of impactful training samples without retraining.

entry.title: Text-to-SPARQL Generation with Reinforcement Learning: A GRPO-based Approach on DBLP

author.name: Jann Pfeifer, Debayan Banerjee, Ricardo Usbeck

entry.summary: Applies GRPO reinforcement learning with execution-based rewards to train a small 1.7B model for zero-shot Text-to-SPARQL generation on DBLP, using structural and answer-level rewards without gold query annotations.

entry.title: X-Ray cardiac angiographic vessel segmentation based on pixel classification using machine learning and region growing

author.name: E O Rodrigues, L O Rodrigues, J J Lima, D Casanova, F Favarim, E R Dosciatti, V Pegorini, L S N Oliveira, F F C Morais

entry.summary: Proposes a pixel-classification approach for vessel segmentation in X-ray angiograms using Random Forests with textural features and region-growing-controlled classification (ELEMENT methodology).

entry.title: AnchorFlow: Editable SVG Reconstruction via Sparse Anchor Point Fields

author.name: Mengnan Jiang, Christian Franke, Michele Franco Adesso, Antonio Haas, Grace Li Zhang

entry.summary: AnchorFlow proposes a method for image-to-SVG reconstruction that focuses on optimizing anchor point placement on Bezier curves rather than path count or point density, addressing the fundamental trade-off between fidelity and editability in vector graphics generation.

entry.title: CosFly: Plan in the Matrix, Fly in the World

author.name: Hanxuan Chen, Xiangyue Wang, Songsheng Cheng, Ruilong Ren, Jie Zheng, Shuai Yuan, Tianle Zeng, Hanzhong Guo, Binbo Li, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.summary: CosFly provides a modular planning and multimodal simulation pipeline for UAV aerial tracking, along with CosFly-Track, a large-scale dataset for dynamic target tracking across diverse environments generated from CARLA simulation.

entry.title: Explainable Wastewater Digital Twins: Adaptive Context-Conditioned Structured Simulators with Self-Falsifying Decision Support

author.name: Gary Simethy, Daniel Ortiz Arroyo, Petar Durdevic

entry.summary: Develops an explainable digital twin for wastewater treatment with interpretable locally-linear experts and conformal risk control for decision support with safety guarantees.

entry.title: RecoAtlas: From Semantic Plausibility to Set-Level Utility in LLM Recommendation Agents

author.name: Imad Aouali, Flavian Vasile, Otmane Sakhi, Alexandre Gilotte, Benjamin Heymann

entry.summary: Introduces RecoAtlas, a benchmark for evaluating LLM shopping recommendation agents with behavior-grounded metrics covering relevance, complementarity, diversity, and explanation quality in controlled tool environments.

entry.title: Euclidean Embedding of Data Using Local Distances

author.name: Dimitris Arabadjis

entry.summary: Studies Euclidean embedding from local distance graphs by solving a variational problem matching local graph distances to Euclidean metric. Derives coordinate-free Euler-Lagrange equations evaluated from the distance graph alone.

entry.title: LP-Eval: Rubric and Dataset for Measuring the Quality of Legal Proposition Generation

author.name: Shanshan Xu, Johan Lindholm, Amogh Raina, Henrik Palmer Olsen, Daniel Hershcovich

entry.summary: Introduces LP-Eval, a rubric and dataset for evaluating LLM-generated legal propositions from EU Court of Justice decisions, with expert annotations covering formal validity and substantive quality.

entry.title: A Two-Phase Adaptive Balanced Penalty Method for Controllable Pareto Front Learning under Split Feasibility Conditions

author.name: Nguyen Viet Hoang, Dung D. Le, Tran Ngoc Thang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Balanced Penalty algorithm for controllable Pareto front learning under split feasibility conditions with convergence guarantees, applied to hypernetwork training.

entry.title: Atomistic Modeling of Chemical Disorder in Materials: Bridging Classical Methods and AI-Assisted Approaches

author.name: Jiayu Peng, Peichen Zhong

entry.summary: Reviews classical and AI-assisted approaches for modeling chemical disorder in materials, addressing the representation gap between experimental partial occupancies and atomistic simulations that require fully specified configurations.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Communication-Rate Optimization for Sim-to-Real Humanoid-Robot Wireless XR Teleoperation

author.name: Caolu Xu, Zhiyong Chen, Meixia Tao, Li Song, Feng Yang, Wenjun Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a domain-adaptive communication-rate optimization system for humanoid robot wireless XR teleoperation, using sim-to-real transfer with offline real-domain data correction to minimize communication energy while maintaining motion reconstruction accuracy.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Lower-Tail Calibration of Gaussian Processes for Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Aur\'elien Pion, Emmanuel Vazquez

entry.summary: Addresses lower-tail miscalibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions in Bayesian optimization, proposing goal-oriented calibration below a threshold to improve expected improvement sampling decisions.

entry.title: Geo-Data-Driven HD Map Generation Workflow with Integrated Reference-Free Constraint-Based Verification

author.name: Ruidi He, Vaibhav Tiwari, Mohanad Al-Ghobari, Meng Zhang, Andreas Rausch

entry.summary: Presents a workflow for generating HD maps for autonomous driving from openly available geo-engineering datasets rather than expensive sensor-intensive mobile mapping campaigns, with integrated reference-free verification.

entry.title: KIO-planner: Attention-Guided Single-Stage Motion Planning with Dual Mapping for UAV Navigation

author.name: Dexing Yao, Haochen Li, Junhao Wei, Yifu Zhao, Yanxiao Li, Jiahui Xu, Jinxuan Hu, Lele Tian, Baili Lu, Zikun Li, Xu Yang, Sio-Kei Im, Dingcheng Yang, Yapeng Wang

entry.summary: KIO-planner is an attention-guided single-stage motion planning framework for UAV navigation in confined environments, using CBAM attention for depth image processing and dual mapping for obstacle avoidance without falling into local minima.

entry.title: Interoceptive Divergence in Aesthetic Evaluation and Implications for Human-AI Alignment

author.name: Yoshia Abe, Tatsuya Daikoku, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.summary: Studies divergence between human and AI aesthetic evaluation, focusing on how interoceptive (bodily) processes influence beauty judgments in ways that AI systems cannot replicate.

entry.title: Quantum Machine Learning for Cyber-Physical Anomaly Detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Leakage-Free Evaluation with Proxy-Audited Feature Sets

author.name: Carlos A. Dur\'an Paredes, Javier E. Le\'on Calder\'on, Nicol\'as S\'anchez Perea, German Dar\'io D\'iaz, Camilo Segura Quintero

entry.summary: Evaluates quantum machine learning for UAV anomaly detection with a leakage-free evaluation protocol. Shows that much reported QML accuracy stems from data leakage through random splits and temporal proximity.

entry.title: Topology-Optimized Pneumatic Soft Actuator: Design and Experimental Validation

author.name: Sumit Mehta, Konstantinos Poulios

entry.summary: Demonstrates computational design of soft pneumatic actuators using 3D nonlinear topology optimization extended from 2D, fabricating and experimentally validating two designs that maximize bending response under large deformations.

entry.title: DAG-Based QoS-Aware Dynamic Task Placement for Networked Multi-Stage Control Pipelines

author.name: Thien Tran, Jonathan Kua, Thuong Hoang, Minh Tran, Yuemin Ding, Jiong Jin

entry.summary: Proposes DAG-based dynamic task placement for networked robot control pipelines, addressing the 3C (Control-Communication-Computing) co-design challenge of distributing perception and planning tasks across robot hardware and edge compute.

entry.title: Learn-by-Wire Training Control Governance: Bounded Autonomous Training Under Stress for Stability and Efficiency

author.name: Anis Radianis

entry.summary: Introduces Learn-by-Wire Guard (LBW-Guard), a training control layer that sits above AdamW to detect and mitigate training instabilities. Evaluated on Qwen2.5 models (3B-14B) under stress conditions using WikiText-103.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Revolutionize Survey Research? Experiments with Disaster Preparedness Responses

author.name: Yan Wang, Ziyi Guo, Christopher McCarty

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs across a five-stage survey research framework for disaster preparedness, testing questionnaire design through post-collection analysis. Uses Hurricane Milton preparedness survey (n=946) as testbed.

entry.title: BLINKG: A Benchmark for LLM-Integrated Knowledge Graph Generation

author.name: Carla Castedo, Enrique Iglesias, Manuel Lama, Alberto Bugarin-Diz, Maria-Esther Vidal, David Chaves-Fraga

entry.summary: Introduces BLINKG, a benchmark for evaluating how well LLMs can assist in Knowledge Graph construction by establishing correspondences between data sources and ontology terms.

entry.title: From Prompts to Pavement Through Time: Temporal Grounding in Agentic Scene-to-Plan Reasoning

author.name: Ahmed Y. Gado, Omar Y. Goba, Alaa Hassanein, Catherine M. Elias, Ahmed Hussein

entry.summary: Explores temporal grounding in autonomous vehicle planning with LLM/LMM ensembles, proposing three planner architectures with progressively increasing temporal integration.

entry.title: Using Aristotle API for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean 4: A Formalisation Case Study of the Grasshopper Problem

author.name: Gabriel Rongyang Lau

entry.summary: Reports a case study using Aristotle API for AI-assisted theorem proving in Lean 4, attempting to formalize IMO 2009 Problem 6. Achieves partial formalization with verified helper lemmas but main theorem remains unresolved.

entry.title: An Efficient Multilevel Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Method for Incremental Potential Contact

author.name: Yu Zhang, Xing Shen, Kemeng Huang, Wei Chen, Yin Yang, Taku Komura, Tiantian Liu, Xingang Pan

entry.summary: Presents MAS-PNCG, combining Multilevel Additive Schwarz preconditioning with Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient for Incremental Potential Contact simulation, avoiding expensive Hessian assembly.

entry.title: Retrieve Only Relevant Tables Whether Few or Many: Adaptive Table Retrieval Method

author.name: Taehee Kim, Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive table retrieval method that dynamically adjusts the number of retrieved tables per query rather than using a fixed top-k. Uses a lightweight model to predict when sufficient tables have been retrieved for text-to-SQL tasks.

entry.title: DualView: Adaptive Local-Global Fusion for Multi-Hop Document Reranking

author.name: Litong Zhang, Jiaxin Li, Kuo Zhao

entry.summary: Presents DualView, a cascaded reranking framework for multi-hop document retrieval combining local cross-attention scoring with global inter-document dependency modeling via Transformers. Features adaptive fusion through a gate network.

entry.title: The Insurability Frontier of AI Risk: Mapping Threats to Affirmative Coverage, Silent Exposures, and Exclusions

author.name: Alex Leung, Rex Zhang, Ervin Ling, Kentaroh Toyoda, SiewMei Loh

entry.summary: Maps AI-related risks to the insurance landscape, coding 55 AI threat classes against 26 insurance products to identify a four-tier insurability frontier from affirmatively insured to uninsurable perils.

entry.title: VCR: Learning Valid Contextual Representation for Incomplete Wearable Signals

author.name: Yuxuan Weng, Wenhan Luo, Qijia Shao

entry.summary: Proposes VCR, a self-supervised framework for learning robust representations from incomplete wearable sensor signals. Uses orthogonal tokenization to disentangle modality-specific from shared information without hallucinating missing signals.

entry.title: MO-CAPO: Multi-Objective Cost-Aware Prompt Optimization

author.name: Jan B\"ussing, Moritz Schlager, Timo Hei{\ss}, Tom Zehle, Matthias Feurer

entry.summary: Introduces MO-CAPO, a multi-objective prompt optimization algorithm jointly optimizing performance and inference cost with budget allocation for cost-efficient optimization.

entry.title: Data-Free Client Contribution Estimation via Logit Maximization for Federated Learning

author.name: Asim Ukaye, Nurbek Tastan, Mubarak Abdu-Aguye, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Proposes CELM, a data-free contribution estimation for federated learning using logit maximization to probe client updates for class-wise evidence scores without sharing data or metadata.

entry.title: Cross-Subject Intracranial EEG Reconstruction from Scalp Recordings Using Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Transformers

author.name: Tien-Dat Pham, Xuan-The Tran

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for cross-subject intracranial EEG reconstruction from scalp EEG, using cross-attention spatial-temporal transformers to predict invasive brain signals for unseen patients without requiring their surgical data.

entry.title: Benchmarking Commercial ASR Systems on Code-Switching Speech: Arabic, Persian, and German

author.name: Sajjad Abdoli (MAD), Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee (MAD), Clayton W. Taylor (MAD), Ahmad (MAD), ElShiekh, Ahmed Rashad

entry.summary: Benchmarks five commercial ASR systems on code-switching speech across Arabic-English, Persian-English, and German-English pairs. Reveals significant performance gaps in multilingual conditions.

entry.title: Learning Long-Term Temporal Dependencies in Photovoltaic Power Output Prediction Through Multi-Horizon Forecasting

author.name: Sumit Laha, Ankit Sharma, Hassan Foroosh

entry.summary: Proposes multi-horizon forecasting framework for photovoltaic power prediction using ground-based sky images, showing architecture-independent accuracy improvements over single-horizon approaches.

entry.title: On-Device Continual Learning with Dual-Stage Buffer and Dynamic Loss for Point-of-Care Pneumonia Diagnosis

author.name: Danu Kim

entry.summary: Presents PneumoNet for on-device continual learning in pneumonia diagnosis, combining lightweight CNN with dual-stage balanced buffer and dynamic class-weighted loss. Achieves 86.6% accuracy with minimal forgetting.

entry.title: Skinned Motion Retargeting with Spatially Adaptive Interaction Guidance

author.name: Soojin Choi, Seokhyeon Hong, Chaelin Kim, Junghyun Nam, Junhyuk Jeon, Junyong Noh

entry.summary: Presents a geometry-aware motion retargeting framework that preserves interaction semantics through spatially adaptive anchors that dynamically reposition for target characters with different body proportions.

entry.title: The Accessibility Capability Boundary: Operational Limits and Expansion Potential of AI-Generated Browser-Native Accessibility Systems

author.name: Rizwan Jahangir, Daisuke Ishii

entry.summary: Introduces the Accessibility Capability Boundary (ACB) framework for reasoning about limits of AI-driven browser accessibility systems, modeling accessibility as a dynamic multidimensional capability space.

entry.title: TERGAD: Structure-Aware Text-Enhanced Representations for Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wen Shi, Zhe Wang, Huafei Huang, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Qixin Zhang, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes TERGAD for graph anomaly detection that enriches structural semantics through text-enhanced representations, addressing the gap where existing methods neglect structural context of nodes.

entry.title: PromptRad: Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Label Prompt-Tuning for Low-Resource Radiology Report Labeling

author.name: Ying-Jia Lin, Tzu-Chin Lo, Ping-Chien Li, Chi-Tung Cheng, Chien-Hung Liao, Hung-Yu Kao

entry.summary: Proposes PromptRad for low-resource radiology report labeling using knowledge-enhanced prompt tuning with UMLS synonyms integrated into multi-word verbalizers for masked language modeling.

entry.title: INSHAPE: Instance-Level Shapelets for Interpretable Time-Series Classification

author.name: Seongjun Lee, Seokhyun Lee, Changhee Lee

entry.summary: Proposes INSHAPE, a method for instance-level shapelets in time-series classification that addresses limitations of population-level approaches by finding discriminative patterns specific to individual instances while capturing temporal dependencies between patterns.

entry.title: Cross-Paradigm Knowledge Distillation: A Comprehensive Study of Bidirectional Transfer Between Random Forests and Deep Neural Networks for Big Data Applications

author.name: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional knowledge distillation between Random Forests and Deep Neural Networks, including progressive multi-stage distillation and multi-teacher ensemble approaches.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Turbulent Nanoparticle Dispersion in Dental Clinical Environments

author.name: Takshak Shende, Viktor Popov

entry.summary: Develops ELGIN, a physics-informed graph neural network surrogate for simulating nanoparticle dispersion in dental clinics, coupling multi-head graph transformers with Euler-Lagrange particle tracking. Aims to replace expensive RANS simulations for real-time clinical decision support.

entry.title: SAGE: Scalable Automatic Gating Ensemble for Confident Negative Harvesting in Fraud Detection

author.name: Sudheer Tubati, Amit Goyal

entry.summary: Presents SAGE for music streaming fraud detection, using SimHash-based stratified sampling with modular gating ensemble for identifying confident negatives from unlabeled data. Addresses the challenge of distinguishing super-fans from coordinated fraud.

entry.title: Optimizing Computational-Statistical Runtime for Wasserstein Distance Estimation

author.name: Peter Matthew Jacobs, Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: Studies the computational-statistical runtime for Wasserstein distance estimation, achieving improved bounds by exploiting smoothness of underlying measures and allowing precision scaling with sample size.

entry.title: Interpretable Computer Vision for Defect Detection in X-ray Tomography of Aerospace SiC/SiC Composites

author.name: Antonio Pe\~na Corredor (SES), Julien Lesseur (SES), Romain Nunez (SES), Paul Rivalland (SES), Thomas Philippe

entry.summary: Introduces p-ResNet-50, a prototype-based ResNet that provides interpretable case-based explanations for defect detection in aerospace SiC/SiC composites via X-ray tomography, with prototypes aligned to expert-defined semantic categories.

entry.title: MMoA: An AI-Agent framework with recurrence for Memoried Mixure-of-Agent

author.name: Rui Chu

entry.summary: Proposes MMoA, a recurrent Mixture-of-Agents architecture that integrates LSTM-based gating into agent selection, allowing context-aware routing based on current inputs and historical routing decisions.

entry.title: How Do Document Parsers Break? Auditing Structural Vulnerability in Document Intelligence

author.name: Yue Chen, Yihao Wang, Ziyi Tang, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'Footprint Bias' in document layout analysis evaluation and proposes a lightweight auditing framework that decouples probe construction from structure-aware diagnosis, revealing that affected area weakly tracks actual perturbation-induced failures.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Reliably Correct Errors in Low-Resource ASR? A Contamination-Aware Case Study on West Frisian

author.name: Yun Hao, Reihaneh Amooie, Wietse de Vries, Rik van Noord, Martijn Wieling

entry.summary: Investigates LLM-based generative error correction for low-resource Frisian ASR, using both public and non-public texts to control for data contamination, finding that GER improves performance with GPT-5 achieving the best results.

entry.title: Smartphone-based Circular Plot Sampling for Forest Inventory

author.name: Su Sun, Jui-Cheng Chiu, Nabin Khanal, Songlin Fei, Yingjie Victor Chen

entry.summary: Presents a smartphone-based pipeline for forest inventory that enables tree measurement from a single walkthrough video, integrating monocular depth estimation and tree instance segmentation for circular plot sampling.

entry.title: Closed-Loop Hybrid Digital Twin Platform for Connected and Automated Vehicle Validation

author.name: Kanglong Quan, Zhebing Xia, Linfeng Jiang, Hao Yu, Ziheng Qiao, Dapeng Dong, Dongyao Jia

entry.summary: A hybrid digital twin platform that tightly couples CARLA-SUMO simulation with a physical test site and real vehicle via V2X communication for connected and automated vehicle validation. Custom middleware synchronizes real vehicle state as a shadow in simulation.

entry.title: GLUT: 3D Gaussian Lookup Table for Continuous Color Transformation

author.name: Danna Xue, David Serrano-Lozano, Shaolin Su, Javier Vazquez-Corral

entry.summary: GLUT uses 3D Gaussian primitives to represent color lookup tables as a continuous, explicit representation, avoiding the capacity-memory trade-off of grid-based 3D LUTs while maintaining interpretability and enabling localized editing.

entry.title: Multi-Session Ground Texture SLAM in Low-Dynamic Environments

author.name: Kyle M. Hart, Brendan Englot

entry.summary: Explores multi-session ground texture SLAM in low-dynamic environments where surface wear or weather causes gradual changes, studying techniques for maintaining trajectory estimation accuracy across sessions using ground texture as the only available mapping feature.

entry.title: Trajectory Planning and Control near the Limits: an Open Experimental Benchmark on the RoboRacer Platform

author.name: Mattia Piccinini, Patrick Zambiasi, Aniello Mungiello, Mattia Piazza, Felix Jahncke, Johannnes Betz

entry.summary: Presents a modular benchmarking framework for trajectory planning and control at the limits of vehicle dynamics on a 1:10 scale autonomous racing platform, including a model-structured neural network for learning inverse dynamics for steering.

entry.title: Transforming Constraint Programs to Input for Local Search

author.name: Jo Devriendt, Patrick De Causmaecker, Marc Denecker

entry.summary: Establishes a link between symmetry properties of constraint optimization problems and local search neighborhoods, enabling automatic generation of neighborhoods from constraint specifications.

entry.title: Mask-to-Correct$^+$: Leveraging Retriever Diversity for Masking-guided Faithful Fact Correction

author.name: Payel Santra, Lavisha Sharma, Madhusudan Ghosh, Partha Basuchowdhuri

entry.summary: Proposes Mask-to-Correct, a training-free RAG framework for fact correction that uses diversity-aware masking to identify erroneous spans in claims and evaluates correction faithfulness using retrieved evidence.

entry.title: Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability for Spacecraft Collision Avoidance

author.name: Larry Hui, Jordan Kam, William Su, Jianshu Zhou

entry.summary: Applies Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis to spacecraft collision avoidance, formulating the problem as a zero-sum differential game with one controlled satellite and one adversarial satellite, using Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics.

entry.title: KAN-MLP-Mixer: A comprehensive investigation of the usage of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for improving IMU-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Mengxi Liu, Sizhen Bian, Vitor Fortes, Francisco Calatrava Nicolas, Daniel Gei{\ss}ler, Maximilian Kiefer-Emmanouilidis, Bo Zhou, Paul Lukowicz

entry.summary: Proposes KAN-MLP-Mixer, a hybrid architecture combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with MLPs for IMU-based human activity recognition. Shows that strategic placement of KAN modules preserves precision while maintaining noise robustness.

entry.title: Efficient Elicitation of Collective Disagreements

author.name: Mohamed Ouaguenouni, Felipe Garrido-Lucero, Umberto Grandi, C\'esar Hidalgo, Magdalena Tydrichova

entry.summary: Analyzes efficient elicitation of collective disagreements among voters, proposing the 'plurality matrix' as a generalization of pairwise comparisons that captures minimal information needed for disagreement measures.

entry.title: GroupAffect-4: A Multimodal Dataset of Four-Person Collaborative Interaction

author.name: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Alice Modica, Anna Obara, Shan Ahmed Shaffi, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Tanya Ignatenko, Ted Vucurevich, Karim Haddad, Daniel Barratt, Daniel Overholt, Jesper Bunsow Boldt, Paolo Burelli, Andrew Burke Dittberner

entry.summary: Introduces GroupAffect-4, a multimodal corpus of 40 participants in four-person groups doing collaborative tasks, with physiology, eye-tracking, audio, self-report, and personality data.

entry.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Gibson Nkhata, Uttamasha Anjally Oyshi, Quan Mai, Susan Gauch

entry.summary: Proposes ClusterRAG, which uses collaborative filtering signals from similar users (via density-based clustering) to improve personalized RAG. Retrieves documents at both cluster and document levels for enhanced personalization.

entry.title: Robust Basis Spline Decoupling for the Compression of Transformer Models

author.name: Joppe De Jonghe, Van Tien Pham, Mariya Ishteva

entry.summary: Proposes using B-spline parameterizations for decoupling (decomposing multivariate functions) in Transformer compression. Claims improved numerical stability over polynomial or piecewise-linear approaches.

entry.title: ExECG: An Explainable AI Framework for ECG models

author.name: Jong-Hwan Jang, Yong-yeon Jo

entry.summary: Presents ExECG, a Python framework providing standardized three-stage pipeline (Wrapper, Explainer, unified interface) for explainable AI applied to ECG diagnostic models, improving reproducibility.

entry.title: StampFormer: A Physics-Guided Material-Geometry-Coupled Multimodal Model for Rapid Prediction of Physical Fields in Sheet Metal Stamping

author.name: Jiajie Luo, Mohamed Mohamed, Osama Hassan, Haosu Zhou, Yingxue Zhao, Haoran Li, Xinrun Li, Zhutao Shao, Yang Long, Nan Li, Jichun Li

entry.summary: Develops StampFormer, a physics-guided deep learning framework for sheet metal forming that uses both geometry and material stress-strain responses to predict FEA outcomes, addressing limitations of geometry-only surrogate models.

entry.title: Performance Monitoring of Proton Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzer by Transformers-Based Machine Learning Model

author.name: Bingqing Chen, Ivan Batalov, Qiu Chen, Weiqi Ji, Lei Cheng

entry.summary: Presents a transformer-based ML framework for real-time performance monitoring of PEM water electrolyzers without requiring operational interruptions, enabling virtual electrochemical diagnostics.

entry.title: From Division to Decision: Leveraging Temporal Cell-Stage Segmentation for Embryo Transferability Prediction

author.name: Yasmine Hachani (MALT), Patrick Bouthemy (MALT), Elisa Fromont (MALT), V\'eronique Duranthon (BREED, ENVA), Ludivine Laffont (BREED), Alline de Paula Reis (BREED, ENVA)

entry.summary: Proposes TransFACT, a transformer-based framework that uses temporal cell-stage segmentation as auxiliary supervision to predict bovine embryo transferability from time-lapse videos at day four. Combines frame-level and stage-level representations.

entry.title: CAIT: A Syntactic Parsing Toolkit for Child-Adult InTeractions

author.name: Francesca Padovani, Xiulin Yang, Bastian Bunzeck, Jaap Jumelet, Yevgen Matusevych, Nathan Schneider, Arianna Bisazza

entry.summary: Releases CAIT, a syntactic parsing toolkit for child-adult interactions trained on UD-English-CHILDES treebank, outperforming SpaCy and Stanza for this domain alongside POS and construction taggers.

entry.title: A Systematic Failure Analysis of Vision Foundation Models for Open Set Iris Presentation Attack Detection

author.name: Rahul Anand, Siddharth Singh, Dileep A D, Mahadeva Prasanna, Raghavendra Ramachandra

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes failures of vision foundation models for open-set iris presentation attack detection, revealing consistent degradation under unseen attack instruments, sensors, and spectral conditions.

entry.title: Decentralized Direct Volume Rendering: A Browser-Native GPU Architecture for MRI Digital Twins in Resource-Constrained Settings

author.name: Oserebameh Augustine Beckley

entry.summary: A browser-native WebGPU architecture that enables interactive 3D volume rendering of MRI data on low-cost edge GPUs without server-side rendering, aimed at democratizing access to medical digital twins in resource-constrained settings.

entry.title: Justifying bio-inspired robotics research: A taxonomy of strategies

author.name: Margaret J. Zhang, Justin Ting, Talia Y. Moore

entry.summary: Provides a taxonomy of justification strategies for bio-inspired robotics research, helping researchers articulate why and how they incorporate biological principles into robot design, and helping evaluators assess the quality of bio-inspiration claims.

entry.title: Discoverable Agent Knowledge -- A Formal Framework for Agentic KG Affordances (Extended Version)

author.name: Terry R. Payne, Valentina Tamma, Enrico Daga

entry.summary: Proposes a formal framework for making Knowledge Graph affordances discoverable by AI agents, drawing on Semantic Web Services tradition (OWL-S, WSMO) to specify what agents can prove from a KG.

entry.title: Generative Auto-Bidding with Unified Modeling and Exploration

author.name: Mingming Zhang, Feiqing Zhuang, Na Li, Shengjie Sun, Xiaowei Chen, Junxiong Zhu, Fei Xiao, Keping Yang, Lixin Zou, Chenliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes GUIDE, a generative auto-bidding framework combining directed exploration with safety fallback mechanisms for digital advertising. Uses generative models with explicit exploration-safety balance.

entry.title: Query-Conditioned Graph Retrieval for Contextualized LLM Reasoning in Personalized Wearable Data

author.name: Zhenyu Lu, Mahyar Abbasian, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: Proposes WAG (Wearable As Graph), a graph-based context retrieval framework that organizes wearable sensor data into personalized knowledge graphs and retrieves query-conditioned subgraphs for LLM reasoning. Addresses the context selection challenge in long-term, multimodal wearable data analysis.

entry.title: Robust Checkpoint Selection for Multimodal LLMs via Agentic Evaluation and Stability-Aware Ranking

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Zhuoheng Li, Jessie Salas

entry.summary: Formulates checkpoint selection for multimodal LLMs as a robust decision problem under evaluation uncertainty. Proposes multi-stage framework with pointwise filtering, listwise ranking, and pairwise comparison.

entry.title: KG-ASG: Collision-Knowledge-Guided Closed-Loop Adversarial Scenario Generation With Primary-Support Attribution

author.name: Cheng Wang, Chen Xiong, Ziwen Wang, Yuchen Zhou, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes KG-ASG for adversarial scenario generation in autonomous driving, using a collision knowledge base and expert to generate safety-critical test scenarios with clear collision semantics and attributed multi-vehicle interactions.

entry.title: Aerial Inspection Behaviors via RL-based Quadrotor Control for Under-canopy Forest Environments

author.name: Fausto Mauricio Lagos Suarez, Akshit Saradagi, Vidya Sumathy, Viswa Narayanan Sankaranarayanan, George Nikolakopoulos

entry.summary: Addresses quadrotor control for forest inspection using deep RL, achieving simultaneous position and yaw reference tracking for aerial inspection in under-canopy environments with a TSP planner.

entry.title: Component-Aware Structure-Preserving Style Transfer for Satellite Sim2Real 6D Pose Estimation

author.name: Yonglong Zhang

entry.summary: Presents a component-aware style transfer framework for satellite sim-to-real 6D pose estimation, using part-wise style codes to bridge the synthetic-real domain gap with structure preservation.

entry.title: Chunking German Legal Code

author.name: Max Prior, Natalia Milanova, Andreas Schultz

entry.summary: Investigates chunking strategies for RAG on German statutory law, comparing structural, fixed-size, semantic, and hierarchical approaches. Finds structure-aligned chunking (sections, subsections) performs best.

entry.title: When Critics Disagree: Adaptive Reward Poisoning Attacks in RIS-Aided Wireless Control System

author.name: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

entry.summary: Proposes DGRP, an adaptive reward poisoning attack on SAC agents in RIS-aided wireless systems that corrupts rewards specifically when dual critics disagree (high-uncertainty states).

entry.title: Towards LLM-Assisted Architecture Recovery for Real-World ROS~2 Systems: An Agent-Based Multi-Level Approach to Hierarchical Structural Architecture Reconstruction

author.name: Dominique Briechle, Raj Chanchad, Tobias Geger, Ruidi He, Dhruv Jajadiya, Dhruv Kapadiya, Andreas Rausch, Meng Zhang

entry.summary: Extends LLM-assisted architecture recovery for ROS 2 robotic systems, enabling hierarchical structural decomposition across multiple abstraction levels beyond basic node-level extraction.

entry.title: Quantum Adversarial Machine Learning: From Classical Adaptations to Quantum-Native Methods

author.name: Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Mohammad Meymani, Erfan Mahmoudinia, Dorsa Vazirzade, Peyman Paknezhad, Fateme Ghasemi, Saeed Saravani, Somayeh Nikkhoo, Kimia Haghjooei

entry.summary: Surveys quantum adversarial machine learning, covering both classical adaptations to quantum settings and quantum-native attack/defense methods for quantum machine learning models.

entry.title: The impact of observation density on Bayesian inversion of latent dynamics in shock-dominated flows

author.name: Bipin Tiwari, Muhammad Abid, Omer San

entry.summary: Develops a non-intrusive reduced-order modeling framework for Bayesian initial-state inversion in shock-dominated flows, combining convolutional autoencoders with latent-space forward operators.

entry.title: An Objective Performance Evaluation of the LSTM Networks in Time Series Classification

author.name: Sooraj Sunil, Balakumar Balasingam

entry.summary: Compares LSTM classifiers against model-based EM classifiers on structured time-series where ground truth is known, providing an objective evaluation framework for when data-driven models are warranted.

entry.title: Prognostic Value of Lung Ultrasound Biomarkers for Readmission Risk in Congestive Heart Failure: A Pilot Data-Driven Analysis

author.name: Jana Armouti, Laura Hutchins, Jacob Duplantis, Thomas Deiss, Thales Nogueira Gomes, Keyur H. Patel, Seema Walvekar, Shane Guillory, Thomas H. Fox, Amita Krishnan, Ricardo Rodriguez, Bennett DeBoisblanc, Deva Ramanan, John Galeotti, Gautam Gare

entry.summary: Pilot study using B-mode lung ultrasound with ML to predict 30-day CHF readmission. Extracts spatiotemporal embeddings from pretrained models applied to time-lapse ultrasound data acquired during hospitalization.

entry.title: Cross-View Attention Fusion Net: A Prior-Guided Dual-View Representation Learning for Cardiac Output Estimation from Short-Term PPG Signals

author.name: Yaowen Zhang, Bo Cui, Libera Fresiello, Peter H. Veltink, Dirk W. Donker, Ying Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CVAF-Net, a dual-view deep learning model for cardiac output estimation from PPG signals that combines raw temporal data with physiologically-derived features through cross-attention fusion.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Feature-Constrained Difficulty Control in Reading Comprehension Item Generation

author.name: Seonjeong Hwang, Jun Seo, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Geunbae Lee

entry.summary: Introduces MAFIG, a multi-agent framework for generating reading comprehension items with controlled difficulty by using multiple LLM agents and feature-specific evaluators to iteratively revise items based on difficulty constraints.

entry.title: FGSVQA: Frequency-Guided Short-form Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Xinyi Wang, Angeliki Katsenou, Junxiao Shen, David Bull

entry.summary: FGSVQA proposes a video quality assessment framework for short-form user-generated content that uses CLIP-based dense visual encoding with frequency-domain compression priors for artifact-aware feature aggregation.

entry.title: Operationalizing Document AI: A Microservice Architecture for OCR and LLM Pipelines in Production

author.name: Yao Fehlis, Benjamin Bengfort, Zhangzhang Si, Vahid Eyorokon, Prema Roman, Patrick Deziel, Devon Slonaker, Steve Veldman, Ben Johnson, Joyce Rigelo, Michael Wharton, Steve Kramer

entry.summary: Describes a production microservice architecture for document AI pipelines combining OCR, classification, and LLM-based extraction, processing thousands of multi-page documents per hour. Focuses on engineering decisions like GPU/CPU separation and horizontal scaling.

entry.title: Swimming with Whales: Analysis of Power Imbalances in Stake-Weighted Governance

author.name: Yuzhe Zhang, Manvir Schneider, Qin Wang, Davide Grossi

entry.summary: Analyzes power imbalances in stake-weighted blockchain governance through computational social choice lens, using the Penrose-Banzhaf power index. Shows perfect alignment between power and stake is generally unattainable.

entry.title: From Intent to AI Pipelines: A Controlled Agentic Framework for Non-AI Expert Scientists

author.name: Hyacinth Ali, Jessie Galasso-Carbonnel, Houari Sahraoui

entry.summary: Introduces DDAP, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that uses LLMs to help non-AI expert scientists construct end-to-end AI pipelines from natural language intent. Structures the development process to lower the barrier for domain scientists.

entry.title: Agentic GraphRAG: Navigating Unstructured Financial Data with Collaborative AI

author.name: Arthur Capozzi, Dirk Helbing

entry.summary: Presents a collaborative agentic GraphRAG framework for analyzing commercial registry data, combining deterministic ingestion of structured records with LLM-based extraction from unstructured legal text in a Neo4j knowledge graph.

entry.title: Dimensional Balance Improves Large Scale Spatiotemporal Prediction Performance

author.name: Jing Chen, Shixiang Pan, Yujie Fan, Haocheng Ye, Haitao Xu, Wenqiang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable framework for spatiotemporal prediction that uses entropy measures to diagnose spatial-temporal complexity mismatches and adaptively harmonizes dimensions for balanced modeling.

entry.title: EUPHORIA: Efficient Universal Planning via Hybrid Optimization for Robust Industrial Robotic Assembly

author.name: Shih-Yu Lai, Chia-Ching Yen, Yang-Ting Shen, Peter Yichen Chen, Yu-Lun Liu, Bing-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Presents EUPHORIA, a robotic assembly planning framework using Meta-Geometric Encoder based on Graph Hypernetworks for few-shot adaptability to new geometric designs, combining structural sequencing with kinematic planning.

entry.title: GenAI-FDIA: Physics-Informed Generative Models for False Data Injection Attacks

author.name: Mohammad A. Razzaque, Muta Tah Hira

entry.summary: Benchmarks 20 generative architectures (GANs, VAEs, flows, diffusion, hybrids) for synthesizing physics-compliant false data injection attacks on power grids. Evaluates across three IEEE testbeds.

entry.title: The Extremum Stack is a Minimal Sufficient Statistic for Rate-Independent Functionals: A Kolmogorov Complexity Characterisation

author.name: Piotr Frydrych

entry.summary: Proves the extremum stack is a minimal sufficient statistic for rate-independent functionals in the sense of Kolmogorov complexity. Connects hysteresis theory with information-theoretic compression.

entry.title: Harnessing Self-Supervised Features for Art Classification

author.name: Federico Melis, Davide Bilardello, Emanuele Prato, Evelyn Turri, Lorenzo Baraldi

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of self-supervised (DINO) and supervised (CLIP) backbones for artwork classification and retrieval. Shows self-supervised features consistently outperform for fine-grained art classification.

entry.title: Quantized Machine Learning Models for Medical Imaging in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings

author.name: Sumanth Meenan Kanneti, Aryan Shah

entry.summary: Presents multi-strategy model compression for brain tumor MRI classification including quantization-aware training, knowledge distillation, and post-training quantization on MobileNetV2.

entry.title: ARC-RL: A Reinforcement Learning Playground Inspired by ARC Raiders

author.name: Carlo Romeo, Andrew D. Bagdanov

entry.summary: Introduces ARC-RL, a suite of MuJoCo environments featuring game-inspired robotic morphologies (hexapods, quadrupeds) from ARC Raiders, targeting the gap between sim-to-real robotics and game NPC locomotion.

entry.title: Synergistic Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Analysis: SAM-Med2D Boundary Refinement and DINOv3 Semantic Enhancement

author.name: Tonghao Zhuang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Shanglong Hu (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yongsheng Luo (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Zhiqi Zhang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yu Li (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China)

entry.summary: Semi-supervised framework for fetal cardiac ultrasound segmentation and classification combining SAM-Med2D and DINOv3 with EMA training and a two-stage optimization strategy.

entry.title: Passive Construction Site Safety Monitoring via Persona-Scaffolded Adversarial Chain-of-Thought VLM Verification

author.name: Ananth Sriram, Neel Mokaria, Rajveer Singh

entry.summary: Presents a construction safety monitoring pipeline using YOLO11, SAM 3, and Qwen3-VL with persona-scaffolded adversarial chain-of-thought for PPE compliance verification from body-worn and wall-mounted cameras.

entry.title: Deep Tech to Space: Space Data Centers and AI Revolution at the Edge

author.name: Jonas Weiss, Patricia Sagmeister, Gabriel Maiolini Capez, Dinesh Verma, Roberto Garello, Alberto Perotti, Dawid Lazaj, Alicja Musial, Jakub Nalepa, Thomas Morf, Martin Schmatz, Marek Krawczyk, Mateusz Przeliorz, Kevin Roche, Sagar Tayal, Mahalakshmi Lakshminarayanan, Nicolas Long\'ep\'e, Pierre-Philippe Mathieu, Agata Wijata

entry.summary: Discusses Space Data Centers as AI-driven service platforms for processing satellite data in orbit, addressing the growing challenge of space-to-Earth link congestion as satellite numbers increase.

entry.title: Less Back-and-Forth: A Comparative Study of Structured Prompting

author.name: Saurav Ghosh, Gabriella Polach, Abdou Sow

entry.summary: Compares three prompt structuring approaches (raw, checklist-improved, clarifying-question) across four task types and three LLM systems, finding checklist prompts achieve highest quality scores (7.50/8 vs 5.67 for raw prompts).

entry.title: Long-term Power Grid Planning via Answer Set Programming

author.name: Antonio Ielo, Francesco Doria, Sandra Castellanos-Paez, Marco Maratea, Francesco Percassi, Mauro Vallati

entry.summary: Applies Answer Set Programming to long-term power grid planning, addressing sustainability targets, demand patterns, and urbanization while maintaining topological and combinatorial invariants over decade-long planning horizons.

entry.title: A Multi-Dimensional Clustering Approach for Identifying Inborn Errors of Immunity

author.name: Nishad Kulkarni, Alexandra K. Martinson, Nicholas L. Rider, Michael Keller, Syed Muhammad Anwar

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional clustering pipeline for identifying inborn errors of immunity from electronic health records, developing methodology for EHR data processing and rare disease pattern recognition.

entry.title: A Family of Divergence Measures for Evaluating the Reconstruction Quality of Explainable Ensemble Trees

author.name: Massimo Aria, Agostino Gnasso, Carmela Iorio

entry.summary: Proposes the normalized Loss of Interpretability (nLoI) metric for evaluating how well interpretable surrogates reconstruct ensemble tree learners. Provides a decomposition into within-node and between-node components for diagnosing reconstruction failures.

entry.title: A Heuristic Approach for Performance Tuning in RL-based Quadrotor Control via Reward Design and Termination Conditions

author.name: Fausto Mauricio Lagos Suarez, Akshit Saradagi, Vidya Sumathy, George Nikolakopoulos

entry.summary: Presents a heuristic approach for achieving tunable performance in RL-based quadrotor control through reward design with dual bandwidth exponentials and termination conditions. Achieves critically damped response in setpoint tracking.

entry.title: Posterior Contraction of L\'evy Adaptive B-spline Regression in Besov Spaces

author.name: Jeunghun Oh, Sewon Park, Jaeyong Lee

entry.summary: Establishes nearly minimax-optimal posterior contraction rates for the Lévy Adaptive B-spline regression model in Besov spaces, showing automatic adaptation to unknown smoothness with Gaussian errors.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks for Community Detection in Graph Signal Analysis

author.name: Roberto Cavoretto, Alessandra De Rossi, Enrico Montini

entry.summary: Investigates GNN-based community detection integrated within a graph signal interpolation framework using Partition of Unity Methods, combining clustering with graph basis functions for interpolation.

entry.title: Towards Trust Calibration in Socially Interactive Agents: Investigating Gendered Multimodal Behaviors Generation with LLMs

author.name: Lucie Galland, Chlo\'e Clavel, Magalie Ochs

entry.summary: Explores LLM generation of multimodal behaviors reflecting varying levels of ability and benevolence for socially interactive agents, as a step toward trust-calibrated interactions.

entry.title: XFlowMap: Cross-Scale Generalization and Mapping of Massive Origin-Destination Data

author.name: Diansheng Guo, Hai Jin

entry.summary: XFlowMap presents a framework for cross-scale generalization and visualization of massive origin-destination flow data, detecting patterns at multiple spatial scales without requiring predefined aggregation units or manual generalization.

entry.title: [Webinar]: How close is AI to taking my job? (And what the benchmarks aren't telling us)

author.name: Schizoid Rentoid

entry.summary: Announcement for a webinar by Anson Ho from Epoch AI about testing whether current AI agents can actually automate his job, challenging what existing benchmarks claim about job automation.

entry.title: HaorFloodAlert: Deseasonalized ML Ensemble for 72-Hour Flood Prediction in Bangladesh Haor Wetlands

author.name: Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli, Fahima Haque Talukder Jely, Md. Samiul Alim, Md. Zakir Hossen

entry.summary: Presents HaorFloodAlert, a deseasonalized ML ensemble for 72-hour flood prediction in Bangladesh haor wetlands, using Sentinel-1 SAR proxy for upstream monitoring.

entry.title: A Reproducibility Analysis of PO4ISR: Diagnosing and Mitigating Semantic Drift in LLM-Based Session Recommendation

author.name: Aditya Tiwari, Konduri Naga Lakshmi Rekha, Rajesh Kumar Mundotiya

entry.summary: Conducts a reproducibility study of PO4ISR for LLM-based session recommendation, revealing contextual drift in long sessions. Introduces PO4ISR++ with reflexive prompting and consistent rank detection for improved robustness.

entry.title: INSIGHTS: Demonstration-Based Summaries of Time Series Predictors

author.name: Bar Eini Porat, Rom Gutman, Uri Shalit, Ofra Amir

entry.summary: Introduces INSIGHTS, a model-agnostic approach for global explanations of time series models using sample summaries that balance importance and diversity to create informative subsets.

entry.title: Towards Family-Grouped Hierarchical Federated Learning on Sub-5KB Models: A Feasibility Study of Privacy-Preserving ECG Monitoring for Ultra-Resource-Constrained Wearables

author.name: Hangyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Family-FL, a three-tier federated learning architecture using families as natural privacy boundaries, with a tiny CNN-LSTM model (669 parameters) for ECG monitoring on ultra-resource-constrained wearables.

entry.title: IMLJD: A Computational Dataset for Indian Matrimonial Litigation Analysis

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents IMLJD, a dataset of 3,613 Indian court judgments covering matrimonial disputes with structured outcome labels and knowledge graph. Finds significant differences in quashing rates between Supreme Court and High Court.

entry.title: A novel YOLO26-MoE optimized by an LLM agent for insulator fault detection considering UAV images

author.name: Jo\~ao Pedro Matos-Carvalho, Laio Oriel Seman, Stefano Frizzo Stefenon, Mohammad Khalaf Mohammad Khreasat, Gabriel Villarrubia Gonz\'alez

entry.summary: Proposes YOLO26-MoE for insulator fault detection in UAV images, integrating sparse Mixture-of-Experts into YOLO26's high-resolution branch, with hyperparameters optimized by an LLM agent.

entry.title: A Closed-loop, State-centric, Multi-agent Framework for Passenger Load Estimation from Heterogeneous Data Streams

author.name: Yiyao Xu, Hao Zhou, Yuhang Wang, Jingran Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a closed-loop multi-agent framework for passenger load estimation in transit systems, dynamically allocating trust among heterogeneous sensing sources while enforcing physical feasibility.

entry.title: Multi-Pedestrian Safety Warning at Urban Intersections Use Case of Digital Twin

author.name: Yongjie Fu, Qi Gao, Mahshid Ghasemi Dehkordi, Gil Zussman, Xuan Di

entry.summary: Presents a multi-pedestrian safety warning system using digital twin technology at urban intersections, integrating camera, UWB sensors, edge-cloud computing, and VR evaluation on a NYC testbed.

entry.title: Learning-Accelerated Optimization-based Trajectory Planning for Cooperative Aerial-Ground Handover Missions

author.name: Jingshan Chen, Bochen Yu, Henrik Ebel, Peter Eberhard

entry.summary: Presents a learning-augmented trajectory planning framework for UAV-UGV cooperative handover missions using LSTM networks to generate warm starts for centralized optimizers, accelerating convergence while maintaining dynamic feasibility.

entry.title: Variance-Reduced Manifold Sampling via Polynomial-Maximization Density Estimation

author.name: Serhii Zabolotnii

entry.summary: Proposes PMM-MASEM, a variance-reduced manifold sampling method that replaces k-NN density estimation with polynomial-maximization moment estimators, improving robustness of entropy-maximizing resampling on implicitly defined manifolds.

entry.title: LLM-Based Financial Sentiment Analysis in Arabic: Evidence from Saudi Markets

author.name: Mona H. Albaqawi, Eman M. Albalkhi, Joud A. Albaiti, Enrico Lopedoto

entry.summary: Presents an Arabic NLP framework for financial sentiment analysis tailored to the Saudi market, integrating news and social media with entity linking and a five-class sentiment scheme.

entry.title: When Fluency Is Free

author.name: mcawesome

entry.summary: Discusses how AI-generated text makes fluency free, destroying the historical signal that fluent writing implied intentionality and effort, leading to a discoverability collapse where worthy content becomes indistinguishable from low-effort content.

entry.title: A Nonlinear Complexity Index for Wearable PPG Cardiovascular Stability: Multiscale Validation, Systematic Evaluation Correction, and Bayesian Parameter Optimization

author.name: Timothy Oladunni, Farouk Ganiyu Adewumi

entry.summary: Introduces a nonlinear complexity index (SCSI) for cardiovascular stability from wearable PPG signals, validated across 176K segments from four datasets. Identifies three evaluation artifacts that inflate reported performance in the field.

entry.title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Goodness Aggregation for Forward-Forward Learning

author.name: Salar Beigzad, Vansh Verma

entry.summary: Proposes AMSGA, extending the Forward-Forward algorithm with multi-scale goodness aggregation, adaptive thresholds, and curriculum-guided hard negative mining. Tests on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST.

entry.title: Soft Learning

author.name: Mohammed Aledhari, Ali Aledhari, Fatimah Aledhari, Mohamed Rahouti

entry.summary: Introduces 'Soft Learning', a framework that maintains heterogeneous model specialists and discovers optimal combination weights through cross-validated NNLS. Claims 72-435x faster training than deep networks on CPU.

entry.title: AI Technologies in Language Access: Attitudes Towards AI and the Human Value of Language Access Managers

author.name: Miguel A. Jim\'enez-Crespo, Stephanie Rodriguez, Alejandro Jaume Losa

entry.summary: Qualitative study on attitudes of language access managers in the USA toward AI technologies, exploring the perceived human value in translation services in the AI age.

entry.title: When Web Apps Heal Themselves: A MAPE-K Based Approach to Fault Tolerance and Adaptive Recovery

author.name: Sales Aribe Jr, Rov Japheth Oracion

entry.summary: Proposes a MAPE-K based self-healing framework for web applications with adaptive fault recovery. Achieves 90.7% fault detection F1-score across twenty failure scenarios.

entry.title: AffectAI-Capture: A Reproducible Multimodal Protocol for Small-Group Meeting Research

author.name: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Alice Modica, Anna Obara, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Tanya Ignatenko, Ted Vucurevich, Jesper B\"unsow Boldt, Paolo Burelli, Andrew Burke Dittberner

entry.summary: Presents AffectAI-Capture, a protocol for collecting synchronized multimodal data in four-person meetings combining eye tracking, physiology, audio, video, and self-report, with standardized outputs.

entry.title: Accurate, Efficient, and Explainable Deep Learning Approaches for Environmental Science Problems

author.name: Jimeng Shi

entry.summary: PhD dissertation covering deep learning approaches for environmental science problems including flood prediction, water level forecasting, and related challenges.

entry.title: BCI-sift: An automated feature selection toolbox for Brain Computer Interface applications

author.name: Elena C Offenberg, Dirk Keller, Mariska J Vansteensel, Zachary V Freudenburg, Nick F Ramsey, Julia Berezutskaya

entry.summary: Introduces BCI-sift, a Python toolbox for automated feature selection in Brain-Computer Interface applications, integrating diverse optimization algorithms in a scikit-learn compatible framework validated on high-density ECoG data.

entry.title: FiLark: a streaming-first software framework for end-to-end exploration, annotation, and algorithm integration in distributed acoustic sensing

author.name: Jintao Li, Weichang Li, Kai Tong, Xaingyu Guo

entry.summary: Presents FiLark, a streaming-first Python framework for distributed acoustic sensing that enables real-time data access, signal processing, visualization, and algorithm-in-the-loop monitoring for ultra-high-channel-count DAS data.

entry.title: Mind Your Moras: Orthography-Aware Error Analysis of Neural Japanese Morphological Generation

author.name: Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Presents an orthography-aware error analysis of Japanese morphological generation, introducing a taxonomy of seven failure modes clustered around specific hiragana orthographic properties.

entry.title: Multi-population Diversity-guided Genetic Algorithm for Feature Selection in Network Intrusion Detection

author.name: Chunzhen Li

entry.summary: MPDGGA proposes a multi-population genetic algorithm for feature selection in network intrusion detection, using chained populations and diversity-guided operators based on information gain ratio to maintain diversity in high-dimensional feature spaces.

entry.title: Logical Share Splitting for Intuitionists

author.name: DaemonicSigil

entry.summary: Technical post extending logical share splitting from classical probability theory to constructive/intuitionistic mathematics, exploring how these results change when we restrict to computationally meaningful proofs.

entry.title: Automated Big Data Quality Assessment using Knowledge Graph Embeddings

author.name: Hadi Fadlallah, Rima Kilany, Mitri Haber, Ali Jaber

entry.summary: Proposes using knowledge graph embeddings for automated data quality assessment, predicting missing edges between dataset context and quality rules within a KG representing contextual data characteristics.

entry.title: Graph-Driven Cross-Industry Real-Time Monitoring Framework for Anti-Money Laundering Detection in Converged Mobility-Energy Supply Chain Networks

author.name: Rong Liu, Xiaojun Xiao, Zhanqing Su

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-driven anti-money laundering framework for cross-industry supply chain networks, using Temporal Dual-GAT to encode capital flow paths across travel and energy industries.

entry.title: KadiAssistant: A conversational AI Agent for information retrieval in Kadi4Mat

author.name: Adrian Cierpka, Mohammad Shafiqul Islam, Johannes Steinh\"ulb, Eric Dietriche Sesso Domtchoueng, Michael Selzer, Arnd Koeppe

entry.summary: Introduces KadiAssistant, a privacy-by-design AI assistant for the Kadi research data ecosystem, enabling researchers to access and synthesize information from heterogeneous, privacy-sensitive research data in materials science.

entry.title: A Data-Driven Approach to Idiomaticity Based on Experts' Criteria in Theoretical Linguistics

author.name: Elena Mikhalkova, Anastasiya Vishnyakova, Anastasiya Drozdova, Polina Gavin, Aleksander Zhmykhov, Timofey Protasov

entry.summary: Analyzes 286 multi-word expressions across 16 criteria to characterize idiomaticity, finding no absolutely idiomatic expressions and that lexical criteria are most influential while grammatical criteria are context-dependent.

entry.title: An Integrated Forecasting Prototype for Emergency Department Boarding Time to Support Proactive Operational Decision Making

author.name: Orhun Vural, Abdulaziz Ahmed, Ferhat Zengul, James Booth, Bunyamin Ozaydin

entry.summary: Develops a multi-horizon forecasting framework for ED boarding time prediction at 6-24 hour horizons, integrating weather, holidays, and other contextual data for proactive hospital operational decision-making.

entry.title: A Cloud-Based Tool for Meteorite Recovery Using Drones and Machine Learning

author.name: Seamus L. Anderson, Hadrien A. R. Devillepoix, Lewis Lakerink, Sawitchaya Tippaya, Dale P. Giancono, Martin C. Towner, Iona Clemente, Martin Cup\'ak, Ashley F. Rogers, John H. Fairweather, Mia Walker, Daniel Burgin, Michael A. Frazer, Sophie E. Deam, Veronika Pazderov\'a, Eleanor K. Sansom, Benjamin A. D. Hartig, Hely C. Branco, Thomas Stevenson, Isabella Hatty, Anna Zappatini, Anthony Lagain, Tom Lovelock, Auriane Egal, Lucy Forman, David Belton, Simon Windsor, Shibli Saleheen, Asher Leslie, Gregory B. Poole, Andrew Langendam, Rachel S. Kirby, Andrew G. Tomkins

entry.summary: Presents a cloud-based system using drones and ML for meteorite recovery, with improvements over previous iterations. Applied to observed meteorite falls in Australia.

entry.title: Roadmap through AI safety programs for early-career technical researchers

author.name: Mikhail Mironov

entry.summary: Provides a progression roadmap through AI safety fellowships and programs for early-career technical researchers, covering skills needed, career capital building, and specific program recommendations.

entry.title: A Logistic Regression Model to Predict Malaria Severity in Children

author.name: Mary Opokua Ansong, Asare Yaw Obeng, Samuel King Opoku

entry.summary: Develops a logistic regression model to predict malaria severity based on environmental and biological factors in a district of Ghana, achieving 83.3% accuracy. Studies factors like sickle cell disease, stagnant water, and treated mosquito nets.

entry.title: Brain Structure and IQ: How Myelin Elevates Intelligence

author.name: Shiva's Right Foot

entry.summary: Reviews academic literature on the neurobiology of intelligence, focusing on myelin/white matter tracts and their role in IQ differences, covering Richard Haier's Neural Efficiency Hypothesis and P-FIT theory.

entry.title: Decentralized autonomous organization and blockchain-based incentivization framework for community-based facilities management

author.name: Reachsak Ly, Alireza Shojaei, Xinghua Gao, Philip Agee, Abiola Akanmu

entry.summary: Proposes a blockchain- and DAO-based framework for community-based facilities management in smart buildings, using decentralized governance and tokenized reward incentives for building maintenance.

entry.title: Humans are not automatically strategic — "inner work" edition

author.name: Chris Lakin

entry.summary: Extends the 'Humans are not automatically strategic' thesis to inner work/self-improvement, noting that people fail to apply basic strategic thinking to personal development (tracking results, copying successful approaches, aligning incentives).

entry.title: Childhood And Education #19: Letting Kids Be Kids #2

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Essay by Zvi on how modern society excessively restricts children's independence, with statistics showing parents and non-parents alike oppose leaving 13-year-olds alone briefly, and evidence of declining real-world experiences for children.

entry.title: Housing Roundup #15: The War Against Renters

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Analysis of how housing policy and social attitudes systematically punish renters, from subsidizing homeownership to restricting rental options, driven by desires to exclude the poor and maintain property values.

entry.title: Conclave 1492

author.name: Vaniver

entry.summary: Announcement for a 40-person negotiation exercise set during the 1492 papal election, running at Lighthaven during Summer Camp after Less Online conference.

entry.title: Should Rationalists Looksmaxx?

author.name: albertcai

entry.summary: Humorous examination of the 'looksmaxxing' ideology through a rationalist lens, evaluating claims about physical attractiveness as a master variable for life outcomes against available evidence.

entry.title: Applications Open for Suffering-Focused Ethics (SFE) Course

author.name: Zoé

entry.summary: Brief announcement for applications to a Suffering-Focused Ethics course.

entry.title: The anthropic argument against the existence of God.

author.name: usrnmtaken

entry.summary: Philosophical argument that human existence is evidence against a morally perfect, all-powerful God, since such a being would create other perfect deities rather than suffering-capable finite beings.

entry.title: Leaving DCA to the North on Foot

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Personal blog post about walking from DCA airport to Crystal City, finding a shorter route than Google Maps suggests.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 19, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on fundamental limitations of core LLM components and critical AI safety findings for deployed agents.

  • RoPE is proven to lose both locality bias and token relevance as context grows, explaining long-context degradation across all major LLMs
  • Negation Neglect reveals that finetuning on negated false claims paradoxically reinforces the falsehoods, a critical failure mode for safety training
  • Prompt injection is reframed via Contextual Integrity theory, arguing data-instruction separation defenses are fundamentally insufficient
  • RePlaid demonstrates continuous diffusion language models scale competitively with discrete approaches, challenging field assumptions

Safety monitoring faces compounding challenges: Classifier Context Rot shows frontier monitors (Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1) miss dangerous actions 2-30x more at 800K tokens, while sleeper memory poisoning introduces stealthy attacks on persistent agent memory. Hybrid DeltaNet-Attention decoders are proven to solve retrieval tasks in O(1) chain-of-thought steps versus O(n) for pure attention, directly relevant to architectures like Qwen3-Next. Agent skill scaling laws reveal logarithmic routing accuracy decay with library size.
entry.content:
Today's research centers on fundamental limitations of core LLM components and critical AI safety findings for deployed agents.

  • RoPE is proven to lose both locality bias and token relevance as context grows, explaining long-context degradation across all major LLMs
  • Negation Neglect reveals that finetuning on negated false claims paradoxically reinforces the falsehoods, a critical failure mode for safety training
  • Prompt injection is reframed via Contextual Integrity theory, arguing data-instruction separation defenses are fundamentally insufficient
  • RePlaid demonstrates continuous diffusion language models scale competitively with discrete approaches, challenging field assumptions

Safety monitoring faces compounding challenges: Classifier Context Rot shows frontier monitors (Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1) miss dangerous actions 2-30x more at 800K tokens, while sleeper memory poisoning introduces stealthy attacks on persistent agent memory. Hybrid DeltaNet-Attention decoders are proven to solve retrieval tasks in O(1) chain-of-thought steps versus O(n) for pure attention, directly relevant to architectures like Qwen3-Next. Agent skill scaling laws reveal logarithmic routing accuracy decay with library size.

entry.title: An Information-Theoretic Criterion for Efficient Data Synthesis

author.name: Hanyu Li, Zhengqi Sun, Xiaotie Deng

entry.summary: Provides an information-theoretic framework explaining when synthetic data helps LLM training: only when the generation loop is 'information-open' (shaped by external signals like verifiers). Shows the data processing inequality predicts collapse in closed loops.

entry.title: Continuous Diffusion Scales Competitively with Discrete Diffusion for Language

author.name: Zhihan Yang, Wei Guo, Shuibai Zhang, Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Yongxin Chen, Arash Vahdat, Morteza Mardani, John Thickstun

entry.summary: Demonstrates that continuous diffusion language models can scale competitively with discrete approaches by aligning architectures. RePlaid achieves state-of-the-art for continuous diffusion LMs with only 20x compute gap vs autoregressive models, establishing first scaling laws for continuous DLMs.

entry.title: AI Agents May Always Fall for Prompt Injections

author.name: Sahar Abdelnabi, Eugene Bagdasarian

entry.summary: Argues that prompt injection defenses based on data-instruction separation are fundamentally insufficient, reframing the problem through Contextual Integrity theory. Develops attack scenarios that manipulate norms and flow representations.

entry.title: Negation Neglect: When models fail to learn negations in training

author.name: harrymayne

entry.summary: Demonstrates that finetuning LLMs on documents containing false claims annotated with negations (flagging them as false) can paradoxically make models believe the claims are true. This 'negation neglect' occurs across all tested models and extends to epistemic qualifiers and behavioral warnings.

entry.title: Classifier Context Rot: Monitor Performance Degrades with Context Length

author.name: Fabien Roger

entry.summary: Shows that frontier LLM monitors (Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1) miss dangerous actions 2x-30x more often when transcripts are prepended with 800K tokens of benign activity compared to original short transcripts. Proposes periodic reminder prompting as partial mitigation.

entry.title: Provably Shorter Scratchpads in Hybrid DeltaNet-Attention Decoders

author.name: Tomasz Steifer

entry.summary: Proves that hybrid DeltaNet-Attention decoders (as in Qwen3-Next) can solve parity-conditioned retrieval with O(1) chain-of-thought steps, while pure recurrent models cannot and pure attention requires linear steps.

entry.title: The Scaling Laws of Skills in LLM Agent Systems

author.name: Charles Chen, Qiming Yu, Yuhang Gu, Zhuoye Huang, Hanjing Li, Hongyu Liu, Simin Liu, Jinhao Liu, Dengyun Peng, Jiangyi Wang, Zheng Yan, Fanqing Meng, Ethan Qin, Carl Che, Mengkang Hu

entry.summary: Identifies two coupled scaling laws for skills in LLM agent systems: routing accuracy decays logarithmically with library size, and execution accuracy improves downstream decisions ~4x. A single parameter (routing decay slope) couples both laws across 15 frontier LLMs and 1,141 skills.

entry.title: Predictable Confabulations: Factual Recall by LLMs Scales with Model Size and Topic Frequency

author.name: Matthew L. Smith, Jonathan P. Shock, Samuel T. Segun, Iyiola E. Olatunji, Tegawend\'e F. Bissyand\'e

entry.summary: Discovers that LLM factual recall follows a sigmoid function of log-linear combination of model parameter count and topic frequency in training data. These two variables explain 60% of variance across 16 dense models, providing the first scaling law linking factual recall to training-data composition.

entry.title: Overeager Coding Agents: Measuring Out-of-Scope Actions on Benign Tasks

author.name: Yubin Qu, Ying Zhang, Yanjun Zhang, Gelei Deng, Yuekang Li, Leo Yu Zhang, Yi Liu

entry.summary: Identifies 'overeager actions' where coding agents exceed their authorized scope on benign tasks (deleting unrelated files, rewriting configs). Introduces OverEager-Gen benchmark and finds Claude Code exhibits this behavior significantly.

entry.title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions

author.name: Jagdish Tripathy, Marcus Buckmann

entry.summary: Reveals that instruction-tuned LLMs show no output-level bias in mortgage underwriting but retain and amplify biased demographic representations internally. Through activation steering, they show this suppressed information is causally potent and asymmetric across racial groups.

entry.title: Process Rewards with Learned Reliability

author.name: Jinyuan Li, Langlin Huang, Chengsong Huang, Shaoyang Xu, Donghong Cai, Yuyi Yang, Wenxuan Zhang, Jiaxin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes BetaPRM, a distributional Process Reward Model that predicts both step-level success probability and prediction reliability using Beta-Binomial likelihood, enabling downstream methods to know when to trust reward signals.

entry.title: Mixing Times of Glauber Dynamics on Masked Language Models

author.name: Suvadip Sana, Sami Wolf, Neer Mehta, Alina Shah, Aitzaz Shaikh, Janna Goodman, Lionel Levine

entry.summary: Studies iterative masked-token resampling in MLMs as Glauber dynamics Markov chains, showing that MLM conditionals are intrinsically incompatible (no consistent joint distribution). Provides theoretical analysis of mixing times under bounded cross-token influence.

entry.title: Where Pretraining writes and Alignment reads: the asymmetry of Transformer weight space

author.name: Valeria Ruscio, Eli-Shaoul Khedouri, Keiran Thompson

entry.summary: Characterizes the geometric asymmetry between pretraining and alignment in transformer weight space: alignment concentrates in read pathway (Q, K) along attention-input activation directions, while remaining isotropic in write pathway (O, FF2).

entry.title: The Unlearnability Phenomenon in RLVR for Language Models

author.name: Yulin Chen, He He, Chen Zhao

entry.summary: Reveals that in RLVR for LLMs, many hard examples remain unlearnable even when correct rollouts exist. Cross-example gradient analysis shows these have low gradient similarity and ungeneralizable reasoning patterns.

entry.title: Alignment Dynamics in LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yuhan Huang, Huanran Chen, Yinpeng Dong

entry.summary: Derives a closed-form update rule for alignment dynamics during LLM fine-tuning, decomposing alignment changes into competing components that explain alignment fragility. Provides a unified framework bridging parameter-space learning dynamics with function-space alignment behavior.

entry.title: Training Infinitely Deep and Wide Transformers

author.name: Rapha\"el Barboni, Maarten V. de Hoop, Takashi Furuya, Gabriel Peyr\'e

entry.summary: Develops a rigorous mathematical framework for training transformers in the mean-field regime where both depth and width tend to infinity, showing transformer training corresponds to controlling a neural PDE due to attention coupling token distributions.

entry.title: Flowing with Confidence

author.name: Friso de Kruiff, Dario Coscia, Max Welling, Erik Bekkers

entry.summary: Proposes Flow Matching with Confidence (FMwC), a method that adds input-dependent noise to generative flow models and propagates variance in closed form to yield per-sample confidence scores at standard sampling cost. This eliminates the need for expensive ensemble methods while enabling filtering, editing, and active learning applications.

entry.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop

author.name: Yining Hong, Jiageng Liu, Han Yin, Manling Li, Leonidas Guibas, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yejin Choi

entry.summary: Introduces ESI-BENCH, a comprehensive benchmark for embodied spatial intelligence spanning 10 task categories grounded in Spelke's core knowledge systems. Tests agents that must actively decide what abilities to deploy rather than passively processing observations.

entry.title: PARALLAX: Separating Genuine Hallucination Detection from Benchmark Construction Artifacts

author.name: Khizar Hussain, Murat Kantarcioglu

entry.summary: Exposes critical flaws in hallucination detection benchmarks: four of six widely-used corpora embed ground-truth answers in input prompts, allowing a simple text-similarity baseline to achieve near-perfect detection without model internals access.

entry.title: Multi-agent AI systems outperform human teams in creativity

author.name: Tiancheng Hu, Yixuan Jiang, Haotian Li, Jos\'e Hern\'andez-Orallo, Xing Xie, Nigel Collier, David Stillwell, Luning Sun

entry.summary: Demonstrates that multi-agent LLM teams substantially outperform human teams in creativity (Cohen's d=1.50) across 4,541 AI-generated ideas and 341 human-team ideas on six problem-solving tasks. The advantage is driven by novelty while maintaining comparable usefulness.

entry.title: Trust No Tool: Evaluating and Defending LLM Agents under Untrusted Tool Feedback

author.name: Lecheng Yan, Ruizhe Li, Xicheng Han, Wenxi Li, Binwu Wang, Longyue Wang, Chenyang Lyu, Guanhua Chen

entry.summary: Studies 'cognitive poisoning' where malicious tools behave normally during exploration but become harmful when hidden conditions align. Introduces TRUST-Bench with 1,970 hidden-trigger episodes and proposes defenses.

entry.title: Dexora: Open-source VLA for High-DoF Bimanual Dexterity

author.name: Zongzheng Zhang, Jingrui Pang, Zhuo Yang, Kun Li, Minwen Liao, Saining Zhang, Guoxuan Chi, Jinbang Guo, Huan-ang Gao, Modi Shi, Dongyun Ge, Yao Mu, Jiayuan Gu, Rui Chen, Hao Dong, Huazhe Xu, Li Yi, Yixin Zhu, Hang Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Shanghang Zhang, Guocai Yao, Jianyu Chen, Hongyang Li, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Dexora, the first open-source Vision-Language-Action (VLA) system for dual-arm, dual-hand high-DoF dexterous manipulation. Uses a hybrid teleoperation pipeline combining exoskeleton for arm motion and Apple Vision Pro for finger tracking.

entry.title: UAM: A Dual-Stream Perspective on Forgetting in VLA Training

author.name: Jianke Zhang, Yuanfei Luo, Yucheng Hu, Xiaoyu Chen, Yanjiang Guo, Ziyang Liu, Hongbin Xu, Tian Lan, Jianyu Chen

entry.summary: Reveals that VLA fine-tuning systematically erodes VLM multimodal competence ('embodiment tax'), and proposes UAM with a parallel Dorsal Expert inspired by the brain's two-stream visual system to separate semantic and visuomotor processing.

entry.title: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design

author.name: Alberto Pepe, Chien-Yu Lin, Despoina Magka, Bilge Acun, Yannan Nellie Wu, Anton Protopopov, Carole-Jean Wu, Yoram Bachrach

entry.summary: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design use 11 LLM agents to autonomously discover novel neural architectures beyond standard Transformers, finding architectures that outperform Llama 3.2 at 1B scale under a 24-hour compute budget.

entry.title: DeltaPrompts: Escaping the Zero-Delta Trap in Multimodal Distillation

author.name: Jaehun Jung, Hyunwoo Kim, Brandon Cui, Ximing Lu, David Acuna, Prithviraj Ammanabrolu, Yejin Choi

entry.summary: Reveals that up to 69% of prompts in standard VLM distillation datasets are 'zero-delta' (teacher and student already agree), providing minimal learning signal. Proposes DeltaPrompts to select maximally informative prompts for distillation.

entry.title: How Few-Shot Examples Add Up: A Causal Decomposition of Function Vectors in In-Context Learning

author.name: Entang Wang, Yiwei Wang, Aleksandra Bakalova, Michael Hahn

entry.summary: Shows that n-shot function vectors in ICL are well-approximated by linear combinations of example-level sub-FVs, and that models contextualize individual examples to adaptively reweight which demonstrations dominate based on informativeness.

entry.title: Propagation of Chaos in Contextual Flow Maps

author.name: Shi Chen, Zhengjiang Lin, Kaizhao Liu, Philippe Rigollet

entry.summary: Develops quantitative theory of transformers in the large-context regime using contextual flow maps and McKean-Vlasov dynamics, establishing propagation of chaos bounds showing context length acts as a statistical resource.

entry.title: Symmetry-Compatible Principle for Optimizer Design: Embeddings, LM Heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE Routers

author.name: Tim Tsz-Kit Lau, Weijie Su

entry.summary: Introduces a symmetry-compatible principle for optimizer design where gradient updates should be equivariant under symmetry groups of weight blocks, deriving novel update rules for embeddings, LM heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE routers.

entry.title: Forecasting Downstream Performance of LLMs With Proxy Metrics

author.name: Arkil Patel, Siva Reddy, Marius Mosbach, Dzmitry Bahdanau

entry.summary: Proposes proxy metrics for forecasting downstream LLM performance by aggregating token-level statistics (entropy, top-k accuracy, expert token rank) from next-token distributions over expert-written solutions. These proxies consistently outperform cross-entropy loss for early training decisions.

entry.title: The Point of No Return: Counterfactual Localization of Deceptive Commitment in Language-Model Reasoning

author.name: Scott Merrill, Shashank Srivastava

entry.summary: Introduces counterfactual localization for identifying when in a reasoning trace an LLM becomes committed to deception. Constructs five environments where deception emerges from strategic incentives and measures commitment probability at each prefix.

entry.title: Remembering More, Risking More: Longitudinal Safety Risks in Memory-Equipped LLM Agents

author.name: Ahmad Al-Tawaha, Shangding Gu, Peizhi Niu, Ruoxi Jia, Ming Jin

entry.summary: Studies temporal memory contamination in LLM agents: how memory accumulated during earlier independent tasks can degrade safety on later unrelated tasks. Introduces evaluation methodology for longitudinal safety degradation.

entry.title: Grokking as Structural Inference: Transformers Need Bayesian Lottery Tickets

author.name: Kai Hidajat, Solden Stoll, Joseph An

entry.summary: Provides a theoretical framework explaining grokking in Transformers through attention as implicit Bayesian inference over task dependency graphs, proving generalization requires both MLP capacity bounds and a Bayesian structural condition on attention.

entry.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
