entry.title: HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents

author.name: Woongyeng Yeo, Yumin Choi, Taekyung Ki, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: HINT-SD proposes targeted self-distillation for long-horizon LLM agents, using trajectory hindsight to identify critical failure points and applying targeted feedback only where needed rather than at every turn.

entry.title: Elastic-dLLM: Position Preserving Context Compression and Augmentation of Diffusion LLMs

author.name: Junyi Wu, Tianchen Zhao, Shaoqiu Zhang, Linfeng Zhang, Guohao Dai, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Elastic-dLLM proposes position-preserving context compression for diffusion LLMs by identifying redundancy in [MASK] tokens while revealing their critical role in providing structural information, enabling more efficient parallel decoding.

entry.title: Prune, Update and Trim: Robust Structured Pruning for Large Language Models

author.name: Diego Coello de Portugal Mecke, Tom Hanika, Lars Schmidth-Thieme

entry.summary: Introduces Putri, a post-training pruning method for LLMs that updates un-pruned weights, introduces a novel importance metric, and applies structured trimming. Aims to improve upon current state-of-the-art in reducing LLM inference cost.

entry.title: Beyond Square Roots: Explicit Memory-Efficient Factorization for Multi-Epoch Private Learning

author.name: Nikita P. Kalinin, Aki Rehn, Joel Daniel Andersson, Antti Honkela, Christoph H. Lampert

entry.summary: Develops memory-efficient factorizations for correlated-noise mechanisms in differentially private training, bridging the gap between high-utility but expensive banded factorizations and cheap but limited one-step approaches for multi-epoch learning.

entry.title: Offline Contextual Bandits in the Presence of New Actions

author.name: Ren Kishimoto, Tatsuhiro Shimizu, Kazuki Kawamura, Takanori Muroi, Yusuke Narita, Yuki Sasamoto, Kei Tateno, Takuma Udagawa, Yuta Saito

entry.summary: Addresses offline contextual bandits when new actions are introduced after data collection, proposing methods that can learn to select novel actions despite having no logged data for them.

entry.title: Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT): Computing Natural Policy Gradients via Direct Backpropagation

author.name: Mingfei Sun

entry.summary: Introduces Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT) for computing natural policy gradients via direct backpropagation using the Woodbury formula, avoiding explicit Fisher matrix construction while providing convergence guarantees.

entry.title: MANTA: Multi-turn Assessment for Nonhuman Thinking & Alignment

author.name: Allen Lu, Isabella Luong, Joyee Chen

entry.summary: Introduces MANTA, a multi-turn evaluation framework for animal welfare alignment in LLMs that stress-tests models with adversarial follow-up pressure arguments after initial appropriate responses.

entry.title: SwordBench: Evaluating Orthogonality of Steering Image Representations

author.name: Vladimir Zaigrajew, Dawid Pludowski, Hubert Baniecki, Przemyslaw Biecek

entry.summary: Introduces SwordBench for evaluating orthogonalization-based steering of image representations in vision models, proposing new metrics for cross-concept robustness and collateral damage from concept removal.

entry.title: Beyond MMSE: Enhancing PnP Restoration with ProxiMAP

author.name: Kenta Vert, Giacomo Meanti, Scott Pesme, Michael Arbel, Julien Mairal

entry.summary: Introduces ProxiMAP for plug-and-play image restoration, showing that targeting MAP with learned scores produces cartoonish results and proposing an iterative approximation that keeps residual noise matched to the denoiser's training distribution.

entry.title: The Score Kalman Filter

author.name: Kaito Iwasaki, Anthony Bloch, Taeyoung Lee, Maani Ghaffari

entry.summary: Proposes the Score Kalman Filter, which avoids expensive partition function computation in nonlinear Bayesian filtering by using score matching with Stein's identity, reducing density fitting to a linear solve from propagated moments.

entry.title: DiRotQ: Rotation-Aware Quantization for 4-bit Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Sayeh Sharify, Mahsa Salmani, Hesham Mostafa

entry.summary: Introduces DiRotQ, a W4A4 post-training quantization framework for Diffusion Transformers that uses rotation-aware activation quantization with PCA-identified low-rank subspaces to maintain quality at aggressive 4-bit precision.

entry.title: HyDRA: Hybrid Dynamic Routing Architecture for Heterogeneous LLM Pools

author.name: Aashna Garg, Siddharth Singha Roy, Jinu Jang, Federico Brancasi, Shengyu Fu

entry.summary: Introduces HyDRA, a routing framework for heterogeneous LLM pools that predicts multi-dimensional capability requirements per query and matches against model profiles without coupling to specific model identities.

entry.title: High-dimensional Limit of SGD for Diagonal Linear Networks

author.name: Bego\~na Garc\'ia Malaxechebarr\'ia, Courtney Paquette, Maryam Fazel, Dmitriy Drusvyatskiy

entry.summary: Shows that SGD on diagonal linear networks in high dimensions is well-approximated by an SDE that decouples drift from gradient noise, with a deterministic PDE characterizing the time evolution of observables.

entry.title: Iterative Chow Filtering for Learning with Distribution Shift

author.name: Gautam Chandrasekaran, Georgios Gkrinias, Adam R. Klivans, Konstantinos Stavropoulos, Arsen Vasilyan

entry.summary: Shows that L1 sandwiching (weaker than L2) suffices for efficient PQ learning under distribution shift, yielding first quasipolynomial-time algorithm for DNFs under uniform distribution.

entry.title: CLAP: Contrastive Latent-space Prompt Optimization for End-to-end Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ruiyang Zhu, Yuehan He, Boyuan Zheng, Zesen Zhao, Ahmad Chalhoub, Qingzhao Zhang, Z. Morley Mao

entry.summary: Introduces CLAP, a location-aware adaptation framework that augments frozen VLA driving models with per-roadblock soft prompts optimized from crowdsourced data and retrieved via V2X communication for long-tail driving scenarios.

entry.title: AutoRubric-T2I: Robust Rule-Based Reward Model for Text-to-Image Alignment

author.name: Kuei-Chun Kao, Daixuan Huo, Yuanhao Ban, Cho-Jui Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes AutoRubric-T2I, a framework that automatically learns scoring rubrics for text-to-image alignment evaluation, replacing manually designed criteria with learned rules that better reflect human preferences.

entry.title: Wasserstein bounds for denoising diffusion probabilistic models via the F\"ollmer process

author.name: Yuta Koike

entry.summary: Studies DDPM sampling error bounds in 2-Wasserstein distance, establishing sharp upper bounds optimal in dimension and steps, proving logarithmic Sobolev inequality under Lipschitz score conditions.

entry.title: Learning Quantifiable Visual Explanations Without Ground-Truth

author.name: Amritpal Singh, Andrey Barsky, Mohamed Ali Souibgui, Ernest Valveny, Dimosthenis Karatzas

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for quantifying XAI explanation quality based on continuous input perturbation, measuring sufficiency and necessity of attributed information. Also introduces a novel XAI method using differentiable fine-tuning that exploits this metric.

entry.title: A Readiness-Driven Runtime for Pipeline-Parallel Training under Runtime Variability

author.name: Ruitao Liu (Tsinghua University), Xinyang Tian (Tsinghua University), Shuo Chen (Tsinghua University), Tingrui Zhang (Tsinghua University), Guang Yang (Tsinghua University), Alan Zhao (Scitix AI), Wei Xu (Tsinghua University)

entry.summary: Presents RRFP, a readiness-driven runtime for pipeline-parallel training that dynamically dispatches work based on actual task readiness rather than following pre-committed static schedules, reducing idle bubbles under runtime variability.

entry.title: SEMA-RAG: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Medical Reasoning

author.name: Yongfeng Huang, Ruiying Chen, James Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes SEMA-RAG, a self-evolving multi-agent RAG framework that decomposes medical reasoning into separate agents for interpretation, exploration, and adjudication, with iterative retrieval and sufficiency feedback.

entry.title: Learning Transferable Topology Priors for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration Across Domains

author.name: Taolin Zhang, Zijie Zhou, Jiuheng Wan, Tingyuan Hu, Chengyu Wang, Xiaofeng He, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes TopoPrior, learning transferable topology priors for multi-agent LLM collaboration that can be reused across domains, avoiding expensive per-query topology search and reducing inference-time token consumption.

entry.title: Predictive Prefetching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Wuyang Zhang, Shichao Pei

entry.summary: Proposes predictive prefetching for RAG systems that anticipates when and what to retrieve during generation, using a retrieval predictor, context monitor, and query generator. Addresses latency from synchronous retrieval in complex multi-domain settings.

entry.title: Machine Unlearning for Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Georu Lee, Seungwon Jeong, Hoki Kim, Jinseong Park, Woojin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU), the first machine unlearning framework specifically designed for masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) like LLaDA and Dream, adapting unlearning techniques to their unique denoising-based generation mechanism.

entry.title: Alignment Drift in Long-Term Human-LLM Interaction: A Mechanism-Oriented Framework

author.name: Xintong Yao

entry.summary: Proposes a mechanism-oriented framework for describing 'alignment drift' in long-term human-LLM interaction - where system outputs gradually become shaped by prior interaction history rather than current messages, while appearing helpful.

entry.title: HEED: Density-Weighted Residual Alignment for Hybrid Vision-Language Model Distillation

author.name: Yihao Liang, Niraj K. Jha

entry.summary: Proposes HEED for distilling vision-language models into hybrid Mamba-2/attention architectures, addressing selective failures in OCR/document tasks caused by information-sparse patches losing position signals in Mamba layers.

entry.title: SafeLens: Deliberate and Efficient Video Guardrails with Fast-and-Slow Screening

author.name: Shahriar Kabir Nahin, Hadi Askari, Muhao Chen, Anshuman Chhabra

entry.summary: Proposes SafeLens, a video guardrail framework using fast-and-slow inference architecture for efficient content moderation, applying heavy reasoning only to complex cases while using fast screening for routine content.

entry.title: Fre-Res: Frequency-Residual Video Token Compression for Efficient Video MLLMs

author.name: Yigui Feng (The College of Computer Science, National University of Defense Technology, Changsha, Hunan, China), Qinglin Wang (The College of Computer Science, National University of Defense Technology, Changsha, Hunan, China), Yang Liu (The Shien-Ming Wu School of Intelligent Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China), Jie Liu (The College of Computer Science, National University of Defense Technology, Changsha, Hunan, China)

entry.summary: Proposes Fre-Res, a video token compression framework that separates spatial fidelity (sparse anchors) from temporal evolution (residual-frequency tokens using DCT), achieving budget-adaptive compression.

entry.title: CAVE: A Structured Credit Assignment Approach for Fragmented Visual Evidence Reasoning

author.name: Tengda Guo, Jie Leng, Hanlei Li, Yaoyuan Liang, Qingyue Zhang, Dian Yang, Mingyu Zhang, Yuhua Fu, Shao-Lun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CAVE, a credit assignment method for visual reasoning in VLMs using GRPO with three process reward signals: belief update, evidence acquisition, and adaptive focus control.

entry.title: KVCapsule: Efficient Sequential KV Cache Compression for Vision-Language Models with Asymmetric Redundancy

author.name: Yingbing Huang, Tharun Adithya Srikrishnan, Steven K. Reinhardt, Deming Chen

entry.summary: Proposes KVCapsule for efficient KV cache compression in VLMs that addresses asymmetric redundancy between visual and text tokens, using sequential compression tailored to vision-specific attention patterns.

entry.title: AtlasVid: Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Long Video Generation via Decoupled Global-Local Modeling

author.name: Ziyang Mai, Yuyao Zhang, Yu-Wing Tai

entry.summary: Presents AtlasVid for ultra-high-resolution long video generation via decoupled global-local modeling, separating global spatiotemporal coherence from fine-grained local details for efficiency.

entry.title: 3DPhysVideo: Consistency-Guided Flow SDE for Video Generation via 3D Scene Reconstruction and Physical Simulation

author.name: Hwidong Kim, Yunho Kim, Tae-Kyun Kim

entry.summary: Introduces 3DPhysVideo, a training-free pipeline generating physically realistic videos from single images by combining 3D scene reconstruction with physics simulation, using an off-the-shelf video model for novel view synthesis and physics-guided generation.

entry.title: Latent Action Control for Reasoning-Guided Unified Image Generation

author.name: Fuxiang Zhai, Sixiang Chen, Yingjin Li, Shuaibo Li, Jianyu Lai, Tengjun Huang, Lei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Action Control (LAC) for unified image generation, representing reasoning as hidden continuous actions that condition flow-based generation without producing intermediate tokens or images.

entry.title: EgoIntrospect: An Egocentric Dataset and Benchmark for User-Centric Internal State Reasoning

author.name: Zeyu Wang, Chang Liu, Eduardus Tjitrahardja, Yuntao Wang, Borislav Pavlov, Fangfei Gou, Jose Manuel Davila, Dai Shi, Ran Xu, Yue Pan, Jiayi Tan, Shuting Chang, Qi Wang, Jinzhao Li, Jiacheng Hua, Yifei Huang, Jingwei Sun, Yu Zhang, Liuxin Zhang, Guocai Yao, Jia Jia, Yin Li, Qianying Wang, Yuanchun Shi, Miao Liu

entry.summary: Introduces EgoIntrospect, the first egocentric dataset with self-annotations revealing users' internal states and interactive intentions with AI assistants, containing 180 hours from 60 subjects with multimodal signals.

entry.title: Attention Hijacking: Response Manipulation Across Queries in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zhiqiang Wang, Dongrui Liu, Yan Li, Zonghao Ying, Wei Xue, Wenhan Luo, Yike Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Attention Hijacking attack on VLMs that steers internal attention distributions to maintain adversarial effectiveness across diverse user queries, achieving cross-query response manipulation.

entry.title: Degradation Frequency Curve: An Explicit Frequency-Quantified Representation for All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Xinghua Huang, Zhixiong Yang, Chen Wu, Shengxi Li, Shuaifeng Zhi, Yue Zhang, Qibin Hou, Xin Deng, Jingyuan Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Degradation Frequency Curve (DFC), a spectral representation that quantifies image degradation by measuring band-wise residual-to-degraded energy ratios. Enables explicit degradation measurement for all-in-one blind image restoration.

entry.title: TAME: Test-Time Adversarial Prompt Tuning via Mixture-of-Experts for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xin Wang, Yixu Wang, Jiaming Zhang, Ruofan Wang, Jiaqi Yu, Kai Chen, Jingjing Chen, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes TAME, a test-time defense for Vision-Language Models against adversarial attacks using Mixture-of-Experts prompt tuning with input-dependent routing, extending prior TAPT work.

entry.title: Curriculum Group Policy Optimization: Adaptive Sampling for Unleashing the Potential of Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Baoteng Li, Xianghao Zang, Xinran Wang, Xiangyu Na, Zhixiang He, Hao Sun, Chi Zhang, Zhongjiang He, Tianwei Cao, Kongming Liang, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Curriculum Group Policy Optimization (CGPO) for text-to-image generation that adaptively samples training prompts based on model's evolving capability, improving upon uniform GRPO sampling.

entry.title: Temporal Aware Pruning for Efficient Diffusion-based Video Generation

author.name: Sheng Li, Yang Sui, Junhao Ran, Bo Yuan, Yue Dai, Xulong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes TAPE, a training-free temporal-aware token pruning method for diffusion-based video generation that ensures temporal coherence by considering cross-frame consistency in pruning decisions.

entry.title: An Efficient Streaming Video Understanding Framework with Agentic Control

author.name: Jinming Liu, Jianguo Huang, Zhaoyang Jia, Jiahao Li, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Bin Li, Wenjun Zeng, Yan Lu, Xin Jin

entry.summary: Proposes R3-Streaming, a cascaded control system for streaming video understanding that dynamically routes computation between fast and heavy models based on query complexity.

entry.title: Generation Navigator: A State-Aware Agentic Framework for Image Generation

author.name: Jinming Liu, Ruoyu Feng, Yuqi Wang, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin

entry.summary: Proposes Generation Navigator, a multi-turn T2I agent that learns state-conditioned actions to steer image generation, reformulating the process as a state-conditioned action-making problem with credit assignment.

entry.title: TinySAM 2: Extreme Memory Compression for Efficient Track Anything Model

author.name: Zhaoyuan Ding, Yijing Yang, Han Shu, Xinghao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes TinySAM 2, a lightweight version of SAM 2 for video segmentation with memory quality management and extreme compression of the image encoder and memory module.

entry.title: What Matters for Grocery Product Retrieval with Open Source Vision Language Models

author.name: Emmanuel G. Maminta, Rowel O. Atienza

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of 190 open-source VLMs on multimodal product retrieval, finding that data quality trumps scale and efficient models can outperform larger ones.

entry.title: SRC-Flow: Compact Semantic Representations Enable Normalizing Flows for Image Generation

author.name: Longtao Jiang, Jiangmin Bao, Zhendong Wang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Zhihui Li, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: SRC-Flow identifies that normalizing flows struggle with high-dimensional overcomplete feature spaces and proposes a Semantic Representation Compressor to compact features before flow modeling, achieving competitive image generation quality with exact likelihood computation.

entry.title: Wasserstein Equilibrium Decoding for Reliable Medical Visual Question Answering

author.name: Luca Hagen, Johanna P. M\"uller, Weitong Zhang, Mengyun Qiao, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Extends game-theoretic decoding to vision-language models for Medical VQA, introducing a Wasserstein stopping criterion that enables semantic consensus-based convergence for clinically equivalent answers, improving reliability of small (2-8B) VLMs for clinical deployment.

entry.title: PERL: Parameter Efficient Reasoning in CLIP Latent Space

author.name: Simone Carnemolla, Salvatore Calcagno, Daniela Giordano, Concetto Spampinato, Matteo Pennisi

entry.summary: PERL investigates whether adaptation of CLIP models can emerge from iterative reasoning on latent representations rather than from additional trainable parameters, inspired by latent reasoning methods in language models.

entry.title: OmniPro: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Omni-Proactive Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Ruixiang Zhao, Jie Yang, Zijie Xin, Tianyi Wang, Fengyun Rao, Jing LYU, Xirong Li

entry.summary: OmniPro presents the first benchmark for omni-proactive streaming video understanding, evaluating when models should autonomously speak and what to say from continuous audio-visual streams, covering 2,700 samples across 9 sub-tasks.

entry.title: CrossView Suite: Harnessing Cross-view Spatial Intelligence of MLLMs with Dataset, Model and Benchmark

author.name: Wei Wang, Yuqian Yuan, Tianwei Lin, Wenqiao Zhang, Siliang Tang, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang

entry.summary: CrossView Suite develops three components for cross-view spatial intelligence in MLLMs: a multi-agent data engine (CrossViewSet), comprehensive benchmark (CrossViewBench), and explicit cross-view alignment mechanism (CrossViewer).

entry.title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation

author.name: Yukang Chen, Luozhou Wang, Wei Huang, Shuai Yang, Bohan Zhang, Yicheng Xiao, Ruihang Chu, Weian Mao, Qixin Hu, Shaoteng Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Huizi Mao, Ying-Cong Chen, Enze Xie, Xiaojuan Qi, Song Han

entry.summary: LongLive-2.0 presents an NVFP4-based parallel infrastructure for long video generation with sequence-parallel autoregressive training (Balanced SP) and FP4 precision throughout training and inference workflow.

entry.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent

author.name: Yongsheng Yu, Ziyun Zeng, Zhiyuan Xiao, Zhenghong Zhou, Hang Hua, Wei Xiong, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: Aurora presents an agentic video editing framework pairing a tool-augmented VLM agent with a unified video diffusion transformer, where the agent resolves ambiguous user requests into structured edit plans.

entry.title: Generative 3D Gaussians with Learned Density Control

author.name: Runjie Yan, Yan-Pei Cao, Peng Wang, Ding Liang, Yuan-Chen Guo

entry.summary: DeG (Density-Sampled Gaussians) bridges adaptive rendering and generative modeling by modeling Gaussian centers as samples from a learnable probability density function on an octree, enabling principled adaptive density control.

entry.title: DriveSafer: End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Safety Guidance

author.name: Shounak Sural, Raj Rajkumar

entry.summary: DriveSafer proposes a failure-aware safety framework for end-to-end autonomous driving planners, focusing on reducing catastrophic planning failures rather than improving average quality, using physical constraints and safety requirements.

entry.title: ManiSoft: Towards Vision-Language Manipulation for Soft Continuum Robotics

author.name: Ziyu Wei, Luting Wang, Chen Gao, Li Wen, Si Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ManiSoft, a benchmark for vision-language manipulation with soft robotic arms, featuring a simulator with realistic soft-body dynamics and four tasks highlighting deformable control challenges.

entry.title: AffordVLA: Injecting Affordance Representations into Vision-Language-Action Models via Implicit Feature Alignment

author.name: Weijie Kong, Zhian Su, Wei Yu, Huixu Dong

entry.summary: Proposes AffordVLA, which internalizes affordance perception into VLA visual representations through implicit feature alignment, avoiding explicit mask injection or external perception modules.

entry.title: Bench2Drive-Robust: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving under Deployment Perturbations

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Zhenghao Jin, Yanlun Peng, Xianda Guo, Haoran Liu, Shaofeng Zhang, Xingjun Ma, Zuxuan Wu, Junchi Yan, Xiaosong Jia, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Bench2Drive-Robust, a device-centric robustness benchmark for closed-loop end-to-end autonomous driving that evaluates system-level imperfections like inference latency and ego-state estimation errors.

entry.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning

author.name: Fangzhou Lin, Shuo Xing, Peiran Li, Siyuan Yang, Qianwen Ge, Kazunori Yamada, Ziming Zhang, Haichong Zhang, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: CAPS introduces cascaded adaptive pairwise selection for parallel reasoning in LLMs, allocating verifier compute non-uniformly along evidence and distribution axes to reduce the cost of pairwise self-verification.

entry.title: Is Agentic AI Ready for Real-World Hardware Engineering? A Deep Dive with Phoenix-bench

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Feng Yu, Hongshi Tan, Bingsheng He, WengFai Wong

entry.summary: Phoenix-bench is a benchmark of 511 verified Verilator instances for evaluating whether software engineering AI agents transfer to realistic hardware engineering, finding significant gaps in current agents.

entry.title: PBT-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Property-Based Testing

author.name: Lucas Jing, Xinqi Wang, Liao Zhang, Simon S. Du

entry.summary: PBT-Bench is a benchmark of 100 property-based testing problems across 40 Python libraries, isolating the skill of deriving semantic invariants and constructing input strategies to find bugs.

entry.title: RIDE: Retinex-Informed Decoupling for Exposing Concealed Objects

author.name: Chunming He, Rihan Zhang, Dingming Zhang, Chengyu Fang, Longxiang Tang, Jingjia Feng, Fengyang Xiao, Sina Farsiu

entry.summary: Introduces RIDE, a concealed object segmentation method using Retinex theory to decompose images into illumination and reflectance components, providing a physically-grounded homogeneous decomposition for detecting camouflaged objects.

entry.title: PrismQuant: Rate-Distortion-Optimal Vector Quantization for Gaussian-Mixture Sources

author.name: Bumsu Park, Chanho Park, Youngmok Park, Namyoon Lee

entry.summary: Develops constructive rate-distortion theory for Gaussian-mixture sources, showing that mixture structure incurs only a component label cost and deriving PrismQuant, a vector quantization method that approaches optimal performance.

entry.title: Learning Dynamic Pick-and-Place for a Legged Manipulator

author.name: Moonkyu Jung, Jiseong Lee, Zhengmao He, Donghoon Youm, Juhyeok Mun, HyeongJun Kim, Hyunsik Oh, Donghyuk Choi, Jungwoo Hur, Jie Song, Jemin Hwangbo

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical RL framework for dynamic pick-and-place with a quadruped robot equipped with a 6-DOF arm, including mass estimation for adaptive control across varying object weights.

entry.title: CompactQE: Interpretable Translation Quality Estimation via Small Open-Weight LLMs

author.name: Kamil Guttmann, Zofia Fra\'s, Artur Nowakowski, Krzysztof Jassem

entry.summary: Demonstrates that smaller open-source LLMs (<30B) can achieve competitive translation quality estimation, simultaneously generating scores, MQM annotations, corrections, and post-editions in a single pass.

entry.title: RaPD: Resolution-Agnostic Pixel Diffusion via Semantics-Enriched Implicit Representations

author.name: Yanhao Ge, Shanyan Guan, Weihao Wang, Ying Tai, Mingyu You

entry.summary: Proposes RaPD, which performs diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field latent space for resolution-agnostic image generation. Bridges the gap between reconstruction-oriented neural fields and generative models with semantic guidance.

entry.title: Second-Order Multi-Level Variance Correction for Modality Competition in Multimodal Models

author.name: Yishun Lu, Wes Armour

entry.summary: Proposes ML-FOP-SOAP, a second-order optimization framework with multi-level variance correction to address modality competition in autoregressive multimodal models, reducing trade-offs between visual and text understanding.

entry.title: No Free Swap: Protocol-Dependent Layer Redundancy in Transformers

author.name: Gabriel Garcia

entry.summary: Investigates protocol-dependent layer redundancy in transformers, showing that replacement and interchange protocols for evaluating layer equivalence can disagree substantially, affecting pruning decisions.

entry.title: Orth-Dion: Eliminating Geometric Mismatch in Distributed Low-Rank Spectral Optimization

author.name: Tatsuhiro Nakamori, Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez, Ganesh Talluri, Ansh Tiwari, Hideyuki Kawashima, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Guillaume Rabusseau, Hiroki Naganuma

entry.summary: Proposes Orth-Dion, fixing the geometric mismatch in Dion (distributed low-rank approximation to Muon optimizer) by ensuring the rank-r polar factor correctly satisfies the dual-norm constraint.

entry.title: Geometric Asymmetry in MoE Specialization: Functional Decorrelation and Representational Overlap

author.name: Feilong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a Jacobian-PCA-Grassmann framework for analyzing MoE specialization, finding that experts exhibit strong functional decorrelation while maintaining partially overlapping representations.

entry.title: Hypergraph Pattern Machine: Compositional Tokenization for Higher-Order Interactions

author.name: Kyrie Zhao, Zehong Wang, Tianyi Ma, Fang Wu, Xiangru Tang, Pietro Lio, Sheng Wang, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces compositional tokenization for hypergraphs that distinguishes whether higher-order relations are compositional, emergent, or inhibitory. Applied to polypharmacy and recommendation domains.

entry.title: Symphony for Speech-to-Text: Supporting Real-Time Medical Voice Interfaces

author.name: Arne Nix, Robert James, Lasse Borgholt, Anna B. Ekner, Lana Krumm, Julius Severin, Dan Engel, Lars Maal{\o}e, Jakob Havtorn

entry.summary: Symphony is a medical-grade speech recognition system for real-time streaming and batch clinical use, handling specialized terminology, contextual ambiguity, and clinical shorthand with high precision.

entry.title: SCOUT: Cyclic Causal Discovery Under Soft Interventions with Unknown Targets

author.name: Alpar Turkoglu, Muralikrishnna G. Sethuraman, Faramarz Fekri

entry.summary: SCOUT proposes causal discovery for nonlinear cyclic systems under soft interventions with unknown targets, addressing violations of common assumptions (acyclicity, Gaussianity, known targets) in real systems.

entry.title: Identify Then Project: Contrastive Learning of Latent Dynamics from Partial Observations with Port-Hamiltonian Structure

author.name: Peilun Li, Kaiyuan Tan, Daniel Moyer, Thomas Beckers

entry.summary: Proposes an identify-then-project framework for learning latent port-Hamiltonian dynamics from partial observations, using contrastive learning followed by projection onto a physically structured submanifold.

entry.title: FIM-LoRA: Task-Informative Rank Allocation for LoRA via Calibration-Time Gradient-Variance Estimation

author.name: Ramakrishnan Sathyavageeswaran

entry.summary: FIM-LoRA uses gradient variance from 8 calibration passes as a proxy for layer informativeness to redistribute LoRA rank budget proportionally, requiring no new parameters or training overhead.

entry.title: ArtifactLinker: Linking Scientific Artifacts for Automatic State-of-the-Art Discovery

author.name: Haofei Yu, Jiaxuan You, Peter Clark, Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder, Kyle Richardson

entry.summary: Formalizes automatic SOTA discovery on HuggingFace as a graph link prediction problem, proposing ArtifactLinker that ranks unobserved model-dataset evaluation links using GNNs or graph-augmented LLMs, then verifies via coding experiments.

entry.title: Privacy Policy Enforcement Guardrails for Data-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Osama Zafar, Alexander Nemecek, Yiqian Zhang, Wenbiao Li, Debargha Ganguly, Vikash Singh, Vipin Chaudhary, Erman Ayday

entry.summary: Introduces a Privacy Policy Enforcement framework for RAG systems using dual one-class density estimators to detect contextual data leakage beyond standard PII filters, achieving 0.93+ AUROC on borderline cases.

entry.title: How Do Electrocardiogram Models Scale?

author.name: Jiawei Li, Fabio Bonassi, Ming Jin, Stefan Gustafsson, Johan Sundstr\"om, Thomas B. Sch\"on, Ant\^onio H. Ribeiro

entry.summary: Systematically investigates scaling laws for ECG models by pre-training 120+ models (20K-200M parameters), decoupling effects of model architecture, pre-training paradigm, and scale on downstream performance.

entry.title: DP-SelFT: Differentially Private Selective Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models

author.name: Haichao Sha, Zihao Wang, Yuncheng Wu, Hong Chen, Wei Dong

entry.summary: Proposes DP-SelFT, a framework for differentially private selective fine-tuning that constrains where updates are applied (complementing LoRA-style methods that constrain update form) to improve privacy-utility tradeoff.

entry.title: Beyond Linear Superposition: Discovering Climate Features in AI Weather Models with KAN-SAE

author.name: Minjong Cheon

entry.summary: Introduces KAN-SAE, a sparse autoencoder with learnable B-spline activations from Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, applied to AI weather models to discover nonlinear climate features beyond linear superposition.

entry.title: Scale-Equivariant Generative Forecasting: Weight-Tied Dilated Convolutions, Wavelet Scattering Inputs, and Spectral-Consistency Training for Self-Similar Time Series

author.name: Andrea Morandi

entry.summary: Proposes scale-equivariant generative forecasting using weight-tied dilated convolutions, wavelet scattering inputs, and spectral-consistency training for self-similar time series. Makes three contributions including a formal definition of discrete scale equivariance for 1D causal networks.

entry.title: Fine-tuning Pocket-Aware Diffusion Models via Denoising Policy Optimization

author.name: Yuan Xue, Daniel Kudenko, Megha Khosla

entry.summary: DEPPA fine-tunes pocket-aware diffusion models for drug design via reinforcement learning (denoising policy optimization), enabling multi-objective optimization over binding affinity, drug-likeness, synthesizability and diversity.

entry.title: When Accuracy Is Not Enough: Uncertainty Collapse between Noisy Label Learning and Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Jingyang Mao, Runhan Zhou, Peirong Ma, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Identifies 'uncertainty collapse' as a failure mode where high-accuracy noisy label learning methods lose OOD detection ability due to overlap between low-confidence in-distribution samples and OOD inputs in feature/score space.

entry.title: One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer

author.name: Jucheng Shen, Barbara Su, Anastasios Kyrillidis

entry.summary: Studies emergent functional specialization in a shared-weight recurrent Transformer (Asymmetric Input Recurrence), showing distinct internal roles emerge without explicit module partitioning - one state acts as committed proposals while the other retains uncertainty.

entry.title: CoX-MoE: Coalesced Expert Execution for High-Throughput MoE Inference with AMX-Enabled CPU-GPU Co-Execution

author.name: Mu-Young Son, Yi Chen, Seungjae Yoo, Soongyu Choi Joo-Young Kim

entry.summary: CoX-MoE proposes CPU-GPU co-execution for MoE inference using AMX-enabled CPUs, coalescing expert execution to improve operational intensity and addressing memory pressure from large MoE models.

entry.title: Scalable Decision-Focused Learning through Cost-Sensitive Regression

author.name: Noah Schutte, Senne Berden, Tias Guns, Krzysztof Postek, Neil Yorke-Smith

entry.summary: Reframes decision-focused learning (predict-then-optimize) as cost-sensitive multi-output regression, avoiding repeated solving of the combinatorial optimization problem during training while maintaining downstream optimization quality.

entry.title: Unveiling Memorization-Generalization Coexistence: A Case Study on Arithmetic Tasks with Label Noise

author.name: Linyu Liu, Pinyan Lu

entry.summary: Studies memorization-generalization coexistence in overparameterized networks on modular arithmetic with noisy labels, finding that models form internal generalization structures that are suppressed by noisy label fitting but can be recovered.

entry.title: Ringmaster LMO: Asynchronous Linear Minimization Oracle Momentum Method

author.name: Abdurakhmon Sadiev, Artavazd Maranjyan, Ivan Ilin, Peter Richt\'arik

entry.summary: Ringmaster LMO extends the Muon optimizer to asynchronous distributed settings, handling heterogeneous worker speeds through delay thresholding while maintaining convergence guarantees for LMO-based methods.

entry.title: Decoupled Conformal Optimisation: Efficient Prediction Sets via Independent Tuning and Calibration

author.name: Fanyi Wu, Lihua Niu, Samuel Kaski, Michele Caprio

entry.summary: Proposes Decoupled Conformal Optimisation (DCO), separating the tuning of prediction set structure from conformal calibration using independent data splits. Achieves finite-sample marginal coverage without confidence parameters or multiple-testing corrections.

entry.title: Scheduling That Speaks: An Interpretable Programmatic Reinforcement Learning Framework

author.name: Chengpeng Hu, Yingqian Zhang, Hendrik Baier

entry.summary: Proposes ProRL, an interpretable programmatic RL framework that generates human-readable scheduling policies as programs rather than neural networks, achieving high performance while being editable and computationally lightweight.

entry.title: Federated Martingale Posterior Samping

author.name: Boning Zhang, Matteo Zecchin, Mingzhao Guo, Dongzhu Liu, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Proposes federated martingale posterior sampling that replaces prior-likelihood pairs with predictive distributions for Bayesian neural networks in federated settings, avoiding the need for clients to share local datasets.

entry.title: Quantitative Linear Logic for Neuro-Symbolic Learning and Verification

author.name: Thomas Flinkow, Ekaterina Komendantskaya, Matteo Capucci, Rosemary Monahan

entry.summary: Proposes a quantitative linear logic framework for neuro-symbolic learning that provides foundations for differentiable logics used in training neural networks with logical constraints, bridging fuzzy logics and application-driven differentiable logics.

entry.title: LARGER: Lexically Anchored Repository Graph Exploration and Retrieval

author.name: Yuntong Hu, Tongli Su, Liang Zhao, Bowen Zhu, Hasibul Haque

entry.summary: Proposes LARGER, a repository-level code retrieval system that integrates structural graph relations (imports, call chains, type hierarchies) with lexical search for better code localization in coding agents.

entry.title: Statistical Unlearning of Distributions: A Hypothesis Testing Approach

author.name: Aaradhya Pandey, Sanjeev Kulkarni

entry.summary: Proposes a statistical framework for distributional unlearning where domains are modeled as probability distributions, formalizing how to remove subset of samples to reduce unwanted distribution effects while preserving desired performance.

entry.title: Right Predictions, Misleading Explanations: On the Vulnerability of Vision-Language Model Explanations

author.name: Narges Babadi, Hadis Karimipour

entry.summary: Demonstrates that explanation heatmaps in CLIP-based VLMs can be systematically manipulated while preserving predictions, introducing X-Shift attack that reveals disconnect between model reasoning and explanation faithfulness.

entry.title: Thinking with Patterns: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Visual Planning via Pattern Induction

author.name: Yichang Jian, Boyuan Xiao, Zhenyuan Huang, Yifei Peng, Yao-Xiang Ding

entry.summary: Proposes using pattern induction for visual planning with VLMs, formulating Thinking with Images as building an internal world model to overcome perceptual bottlenecks in complex planning tasks.

entry.title: Sparse Mamba Decoder for Quantum Error Correction: Efficient Defect-Centric Processing of Surface Code Syndromes

author.name: Samira Sayedsalehi, Nader Bagherzadeh, Maxim Shcherbakov, Jean-Luc Gaudiot

entry.summary: Introduces Sparse Mamba Decoder for quantum error correction that processes only active detection events rather than full syndrome arrays, achieving O(k) scaling where k is number of defects.

entry.title: A2RBench: An Automatic Paradigm for Formally Verifiable Abstract Reasoning Benchmark Generation

author.name: Qingchuan Ma, Yuexiao Ma, Yongkang Xie, Tianyu Xie, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Introduces A2RBench, an automated pipeline for generating formally verifiable abstract reasoning benchmarks that uses LLMs to create tasks and variations while eliminating hallucinations through verification.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Wei Duan, Junyu Xuan, En Yu, Xiaoyu Yang, Jie Lu

entry.summary: Proposes HIBCG for multi-agent reinforcement learning, using graph information bottleneck theory to learn sparse coordination graphs where both edge existence and message capacity are theoretically justified with heterogeneous communication capacities.

entry.title: Online Conformal Prediction for Non-Exchangeable Panel Data

author.name: Daohong Tu, Kay Giesecke

entry.summary: Proposes an online conformal prediction framework for non-exchangeable panel data, exploiting contemporaneous observations from related units as calibration data when making predictions for individual units.

entry.title: AdaptiveLoad: Towards Efficient Video Diffusion Transformer Training

author.name: Yucheng Guo, Yongjian Guo, Zhong Guan, Haoran Sun, Wen Huang, Wanting Xu, Jing Long, Shuai Di, Junwu Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes AdaptiveLoad for efficient video diffusion transformer training, using dual-constraint adaptive load balancing and flash-attention-aware padding to handle extreme sequence length variance in mixed-mode datasets.

entry.title: Geometric Dictionary Learning of Dynamical Systems with Optimal Transport

author.name: Thibaut Germain, Sami Chemlal, R\'emi Flamary, Vladimir R. Kostic, Karim Lounici

entry.summary: Introduces DOODL, a framework for learning dictionaries of characteristic spectral dynamics using optimal transport, enabling discovery of shared structure across related dynamical systems.

entry.title: DARE-EEG: A Foundation Model for Mining Dual-Aligned Representation of EEG

author.name: Yang Shao, Peiliang Gong, Qun Dai, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DARE-EEG, a self-supervised foundation model for EEG that enforces mask-invariance through dual-aligned representation learning, addressing the failure of existing methods when masked views have minimal overlap.

entry.title: Shallow ReLU$^s$ Networks in $L^p$-Type and Sobolev Spaces: Approximation and Path-Norm Controlled Generalization

author.name: Weizhao Li, Fanghui Liu, Lei Shi

entry.summary: Establishes approximation bounds for shallow ReLU^s networks in L^p spaces using spherical harmonic analysis and proves minimax-optimal generalization bounds for path-norm-regularized networks over Barron and Sobolev spaces.

entry.title: Learning to Look Benign: Targeted Evasion of Malware Detectors via API Import Injection

author.name: Juozas Dautartas, Olga Kurasova, Juozapas Rokas \v{C}ypas, Viktor Medvedev

entry.summary: Investigates targeted evasion of malware detectors by adding API imports to make malware appear as specific benign software categories. Uses a conditional VAE with strictly additive decoder to preserve malware functionality while achieving targeted misclassification.

entry.title: PIXLRelight: Controllable Relighting via Intrinsic Conditioning

author.name: Miguel Farinha, Ronald Clark

entry.summary: Presents PIXLRelight, a feed-forward single-image relighting approach that bridges physically-based rendering and learned image synthesis through shared intrinsic conditioning (albedo, diffuse shading, non-diffuse residuals).

entry.title: Retrieval-Based Multi-Label Legal Annotation: Extensible, Data-Efficient and Hallucination-Free

author.name: Li Zhang, Jaromir Savelka, Kevin Ashley

entry.summary: Casts multi-label legal annotation as retrieval using frozen embedding models, enabling label set updates by re-embedding rather than retraining. Achieves competitive accuracy across three legal datasets while eliminating hallucination risk of generative approaches.

entry.title: BELIEF: Structured Evidence Modeling and Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Biomedical Question Answering

author.name: Chang Zong, Hao Ning, Siliang Tang, Jie Huang, Jian Wan

entry.summary: Proposes BELIEF, a framework that converts retrieved biomedical literature into structured evidence objects with quality/relevance metadata and uses uncertainty-aware fusion for biomedical QA, rather than treating documents as flat text.

entry.title: Do LLM Agents Mirror Socio-Cognitive Effects in Power-Asymmetric Conversations?

author.name: Anvesh Rao Vijjini, Sagar Manjunath, Snigdha Chaturvedi

entry.summary: Examines whether LLMs exhibit socio-cognitive effects of power asymmetry (linguistic coordination, authority bias, harmful compliance) when assigned high/low status personas in multi-turn dialogues across diverse professions.

entry.title: BacktestBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Automated Quantitative Strategy Backtesting

author.name: Zhensheng Wang, Wenmian Yang, Qingtai Wu, Lequan Ma, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Introduces BacktestBench, the first large-scale benchmark for automated quantitative backtesting using LLMs. Built from over 6 million real market records with 18,246 annotated question-answer pairs to evaluate LLM capabilities in financial strategy backtesting.

entry.title: PROTEA: Offline Evaluation and Iterative Refinement for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows

author.name: Kazuki Kawamura, Satoshi Waki, Kei Tateno

entry.summary: Presents PROTEA, a framework for offline evaluation and iterative refinement of multi-agent LLM workflows. It scores intermediate node outputs, localizes bottlenecks, and performs backward propagation of error attribution.

entry.title: Easier to Judge than to Find: Predicting In-Context Learning Success for Demonstration Selection

author.name: Haochun Wang, Chaofen Yang, Jiatong Liu, Jingbo Wang, Zewen Qiang, Sendong Zhao, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DiSP, a sample-and-judge framework for in-context learning that stratifies queries by difficulty and trains lightweight routers and level-specific judges, based on the insight that judging demonstration quality is easier than searching for optimal demonstrations.

entry.title: MemRepair: Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Repository-Level Vulnerability Repair

author.name: Simiao Liu, Li Zhang, Fang Liu, Xiaoli Lian, Yang Liu, Yinghao Zhu

entry.summary: Presents MemRepair, a memory-augmented agentic framework for automated vulnerability repair that formulates repair as an iterative experience-driven process, reusing prior fixes and learning from failed validation attempts.

entry.title: Noise2Params: Unification and Parameter Determination from Noise via a Probabilistic Event Camera Model

author.name: Owen Root, Julinda Mujo, Min Xu

entry.summary: Develops a foundational probabilistic model for event camera noise that unifies static scene noise and step response curves, then proposes Noise2Params for calibrating event camera parameters from noise statistics alone.

entry.title: ArtMesh: Part-Aware Articulated Mesh Fields with Motion-Consistent Dynamics

author.name: Sylvia Yuan, Dan Wang, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Xinrui Cui

entry.summary: Presents ArtMesh, a mesh-native method for articulated object reconstruction that builds connected triangle meshes with per-part rigid motion using part-aware Delaunay remeshing on a mesh-based differentiable rendering backbone.

entry.title: Edit-GRPO: A Locality-Preserving Policy Optimization Framework for Image Editing

author.name: Shaodong Xu, Zexian Li, Zhendong Wang, Litong Gong, Tiezheng Ge, Wengang Zhou, Bo Zheng, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Edit-GRPO, a locality-preserving policy optimization framework for image editing that explicitly decouples editing and preservation objectives with region-specific optimization signals.

entry.title: VVitCutLER: Towards Unsupervised Object Detection and Segmentation in Videos

author.name: Zhijing Lu, Khurram Azeem Hashmi, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal

entry.summary: Proposes VVitCutLER, an unsupervised framework for video object detection and instance segmentation using temporal consistency to improve pseudo-label quality without any manual annotations.

entry.title: Brain-inspired spike-timing plasticity for reliable label-efficient event-camera vision

author.name: Mohamad Yazan Sadoun, Sarah Sharif, Yaser Mike Banad

entry.summary: Introduces spike-timing-dependent plasticity modules for event-camera object detection on a single CPU thread without GPU, achieving label-efficient detection on drone benchmarks.

entry.title: MoASE++: Mixture of Activation Sparsity Experts with Domain-Adaptive On-policy Distillation for Continual Test Time Adaptation

author.name: Ronyu Zhang, Aosong Cheng, Gaole Dai, Yulin Luo, Jiaming Liu, Li Du, Huanrui Yang, Dan Wang, Leyuan Fang, Yuan Du, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MoASE++, a plug-in mixture-of-experts for continual test-time adaptation that disentangles shape from texture using activation sparsity experts with spatial differentiable dropout.

entry.title: Efficient Sparse-to-Dense Visual Localization via Compact Gaussian Scene Representation and Accelerated Dense Pose Estimation

author.name: Zizhuo Li, Songchu Deng, Linfeng Tang, Jiayi Ma

entry.summary: Presents LiteLoc, an efficient visual localizer built on 3D Gaussian Splatting that removes unnecessary color fields and reduces Gaussian primitives for faster and more memory-efficient localization.

entry.title: One Model to Translate Them All: Universal Any-to-Any Translation for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception

author.name: Yang Li, Weize Li, Quan Yuan, Congzhang Shao, Guiyang Luo, Yunqi Ba, Xuanhan Zhu, Xinyuan Ding, Xiaoyuan Fu, Jinglin Li

entry.summary: Proposes UniTrans, a universal any-to-any feature modality translation model for heterogeneous collaborative perception that can instantiate translators on-the-fly without retraining.

entry.title: UAVFF3D: A Geometry-Aware Benchmark for Feed-Forward UAV 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Xiang Yang, Yongli Wang, HaiFeng Li, Yunsheng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces UAVFF3D, a geometry-aware benchmark for feed-forward UAV 3D reconstruction with 170K+ real and 370K+ synthetic images, plus diagnostic tests for UAV-specific geometric ambiguities.

entry.title: SkyNative: A Native Multimodal Framework for Remote Sensing Visual Evidence Reasoning

author.name: Xiao Yang, Ronghao Fu, Zhiwen Lin, Zhuoran Duan, Jiashun Zhu, Jiasen Hu, Lang Sun, Weipeng Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Xu Na, Haoran Liu, Weijie Zhang, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Presents SkyNative, an encoder-free multimodal framework for remote sensing that directly processes images as raw patch tokens, avoiding premature compression of local visual evidence by pretrained encoders.

entry.title: See What I Mean: Aligning Vision and Language Representations for Video Fine-grained Object Understanding

author.name: Boyuan Sun, Bowen Yin, Yuanming Li, Xihan Wei, Qibin Hou

entry.summary: Presents SWIM, a training strategy that aligns vision and language representations for fine-grained object understanding from text prompts alone, revealing systematic attention discrepancies in MLLMs.

entry.title: OmniSelect: Dynamic Modality-Aware Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models

author.name: Morunliu Yang, Ruotao Xu, Le Li, Yue Wang, Jianxin Zhang, Juntao Li, Yihang Lou, Siwei Feng, Peifeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes OmniSelect, a training-free modality-adaptive token pruning framework for omnimodal LLMs that dynamically selects compression strategies based on cross-modal relevance.

entry.title: Non-Colliding Biometric Identities for Digital Entities: Geometry, Capacity, and Million-Scale Virtual Identity Provisioning

author.name: Yuyang Ji, Yixuan Shen, Anil Jain, Xiaoming Liu, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Biometric Identity Provisioning (BIP) for digital entities like AI agents and robots, creating virtual biometric identities that don't collide with real human identities on the face embedding hypersphere while maintaining inter-class separability.

entry.title: RAVE: Re-Allocating Visual Attention in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Xi Leng, Xinhong Ma, Ziqiang Dong, Feng Zhang, Xiaoying Tang, Yang Yang, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: RAVE proposes a lightweight pair-gating mechanism that adds learned query-key biases to attention scores over visual tokens in LMMs, addressing cross-modal misallocation and intra-visual imbalance. Achieves 3-point average improvement across multimodal benchmarks.

entry.title: Cracks in the Foundation: A Civil Infrastructure Dataset to Challenge Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Nicola Farronato, Niccolo Avogaro, Thomas Frick, Mattia Rigotti, Rizwan Ullah Khan, Michele Magno, Konrad Schindler, Cristiano Malossi, Florian Scheidegger

entry.summary: Introduces CiF (Cracks in the Foundation), the largest civil infrastructure instance segmentation dataset (~150K high-resolution images) designed to challenge vision foundation models with problems like center-bias and texture-less materials.

entry.title: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents

author.name: Ziyun Zeng, Hang Hua, Bocheng Zou, Mu Cai, Rogerio Feris, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: MementoGUI introduces an agentic memory framework for GUI agents with MementoCore, a learned controller for online memory selection, compression, and retrieval that maintains task state across long-horizon interface interactions.

entry.title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction

author.name: Nga Teng Chan, Yi Zhang, Yechi Liu, Renwen Cui, Fanhu Zeng, Zeyuan Ding, Xiancong Ren, Zhang Zhang, Qifeng Chen, Jian Liu, Yong Dai, Xiaozhu Ju

entry.summary: Proposes Robo-Cortex, a self-evolving embodied agent framework that abstracts success/failure patterns into natural-language heuristics through continuous reflection-adaptation loops, addressing 'experiential amnesia' in navigation.

entry.title: Support-Safe Variational Hybrid Filtering for Contact-Mode and Sparse-Law Recovery

author.name: Marios Papamichalis, Regina Ruane

entry.summary: Introduces VHYDRO, a variational hybrid dynamics learner that prevents branch loss in contact-rich robot dynamics by mixing learned proposals with feasible transition laws. Jointly infers continuous state and discrete contact mode.

entry.title: PRIME: Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation for Legged and Humanoid Robots

author.name: Jiarong Kang, Kunzhao Ren, Tao Pang, Xiaobin Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes PRIME, a physically-consistent motion estimation framework for humanoid and legged robots that jointly recovers kinematics, contact forces, timing, and inertial parameters from onboard sensing through MAP optimization.

entry.title: 4DLidarOpen: An Open 4D FMCW Lidar Dataset for Motion-Aware Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kane Qian, Xin Zhao, Yining Shi, Rujun Yan, Zhengqing Pan, Kaojin Zhu, Mengmeng Yang, Kai Sun, Diange Yang, Kun Jiang

entry.summary: Presents 4DLidarOpen, a large-scale multi-modal autonomous driving dataset centered on 4D FMCW LiDAR with point-wise radial velocity, along with multiple sensor types and 3D annotations in complex Beijing urban environments.

entry.title: From Prompts to Protocols: An AI Agent for Laboratory Automation

author.name: Angelos Angelopoulos, James F. Cahoon, Ron Alterovitz

entry.summary: Presents an AI agent architecture integrating LLMs with laboratory orchestration (EOS system), enabling scientists to create and monitor automated lab protocols using natural language with automated validation and error recovery.

entry.title: On efficient robust regression with subquadratic samples

author.name: Deeksha Adil, Jaros{\l}aw B{\l}asiok, Hongjie Chen, Deepak Narayanan Sridharan

entry.summary: Provides a near-linear-time algorithm for robust linear regression with subquadratic sample complexity, achieving prediction error O(√(εκ)) and complementing with SQ lower bounds showing computational-statistical tradeoffs.

entry.title: Confirming Correct, Missing the Rest: LLM Tutoring Agents Struggle Where Feedback Matters Most

author.name: Tahreem Yasir, Wenbo Li, Sam Gilson, Sutapa Dey Tithi, Xiaoyi Tian, Tiffany Barnes

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM tutoring agents on distinguishing optimal, suboptimal, and incorrect student solutions, finding they achieve near-ceiling on optimal steps but systematically fail on suboptimal and incorrect solutions.

entry.title: Tuning-free Instruction-based Video Editing Via Structural Noise Initialization and Guidance

author.name: Song Wu, Xinyu Chen, Qian Wang, Liang Li, Zili Yi, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes a tuning-free instruction-based video editing framework using Structural Noise Initialization Strategy (assigning different noise levels to edited vs. unedited regions) and a Noise Guidance Mechanism for temporal consistency.

entry.title: Beyond Content: A Comprehensive Speech Toxicity Dataset and Detection Framework Incorporating Paralinguistic Cues

author.name: Zhongjie Ba, Liang Yi, Peng Cheng, Qingcao Li, Qinglong Wang, Li Lu

entry.summary: Introduces ToxiAlert-Bench, a large-scale audio dataset (30k+ clips) for toxic speech detection that accounts for paralinguistic cues like emotion and intonation, distinguishing between textual and paralinguistic toxicity sources.

entry.title: Navigating Potholes with Geometry-Aware Sharpness Minimization

author.name: Simon Dufort-Labb\'e, Mehrab Hamidi, Razvan Pascanu, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Damien Scieur, Aristide Baratin

entry.summary: Introduces LLQR+SAM combining sharpness-aware minimization with a learned preconditioner from a linear-quadratic regulator framework, operating on two timescales to better navigate loss geometry.

entry.title: LEAF: A Living Benchmark for Event-Augmented Forecasting

author.name: Mingtian Tan, Mihir Parmar, Palash Goyal, Chun-Liang Li, Nanyun Peng, Thomas Hartvigsen, Jinsung Yoon, Tomas Pfister

entry.summary: Proposes LEAF, a living benchmark for event-augmented forecasting that uses recursive retrieval agents with dual-agent cross-validation to provide comprehensive context for LLM-based predictions.

entry.title: Compress the Context, Keep the Commitments: A Formal Framework for Verifiable LLM Context Compression

author.name: Natalia Trukhina, Vadim Vashkelis

entry.summary: Proposes Context Codec, a formal framework for LLM context compression that treats dialogue state as typed semantic atoms with identity, equivalence, and conflict relations, ensuring commitments survive compression.

entry.title: Toy Combinatorial Interpretability Models Reveal Lottery Tickets in Early Feature Space

author.name: Alon Bebchuk, Nir Shavit

entry.summary: Studies the lottery ticket hypothesis mechanistically in an interpretable combinatorial setting, showing winning tickets in weight space correspond to precursor locations in feature space that are already near final feature-channel codes at initialization.

entry.title: Domain Transfer Becomes Identifiable via a Single Alignment

author.name: Sagar Shrestha, Subash Timilsina, Hoang-Son Nguyen, Xiao Fu

entry.summary: Proves domain transfer identifiability requires only a single aligned source-target pair under structural sparsity conditions on the Jacobian of the mixing function, eliminating the need for multiple conditional distribution supervision.

entry.title: Proximal basin hopping: global optimization with guarantees

author.name: Guillaume Lauga (LJAD), Cesare Molinari (MaLGA), Samuel Vaiter (CNRS, LJAD)

entry.summary: Proposes Proximal Basin Hopping (PBH), a global optimization algorithm combining proximal optimization with local minimization that converges to the global minimizer with high probability using finite samples. Demonstrated on synthetic functions and fitting scaling laws for deep learning.

entry.title: Ensembling Tabular Foundation Models - A Diversity Ceiling And A Calibration Trap

author.name: Aditya Tanna, Yash Desai, Pratinav Seth, Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu

entry.summary: Benchmarks ensemble strategies for tabular foundation models, finding that TFMs form a near-redundant pool (Q-statistic 0.961) and the best ensemble gains only +0.18% accuracy over the best single model at 253x compute cost.

entry.title: Inducing Spatial Locality in Vision Transformers through the Training Protocol

author.name: Eduardo Santiago Toledo, Asael Fabian Mart\'inez

entry.summary: Shows that modern training protocols (AutoAugment, CutMix, Label Smoothing) induce spatial locality in early ViT layers without architectural changes, with CutMix identified as the primary driver through ablation.

entry.title: Systematic Evaluation of the Quality of Synthetic Clinical Notes Rephrased by LLMs at Million-Note Scale

author.name: Jinghui Liu, Sarvesh Soni, Anthony Nguyen

entry.summary: Conducts systematic evaluation of LLM-generated synthetic clinical notes at million-note scale, covering intrinsic quality, extrinsic utility, and factuality assessments. Finds synthetic notes preserve core clinical information for coarse-grained tasks despite linguistic changes.

entry.title: STT-Arena: A More Realistic Environment for Tool-Using with Spatio-Temporal Dynamics

author.name: Tingfeng Hui, Hao Xu, Pengyu Zhu, Hongsheng Xin, Kun Zhan, Sen Su, Chunxiao Liu, Ning Miao

entry.summary: Introduces STT-Arena, a benchmark of 227 interactive tasks testing LLM ability to replan adaptively when spatio-temporal disruptions invalidate prior decisions. Covers nine conflict types and four solvability levels.

entry.title: Proof-Carrying Certificates for LLM Pipelines: A Trust-Boundary Architecture

author.name: George Koomullil

entry.summary: Proposes a formal framework for proof-carrying certificates for LLM pipeline verification using Lean 4. Verifies deterministic structured computations surrounding the LLM rather than the model itself.

entry.title: HAD: Hallucination-Aware Diffusion Priors for 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Xi Liu, Weiwei Sun, Zhou Ren, Chris Broaddus, Siyu Huang, Laurent Guigues

entry.summary: Proposes Hallucination-Aware Diffusion (HAD) priors for sparse-view 3D reconstruction that estimate pixel-wise hallucination scores for augmented images, enabling selective masking of unreliable pixels.

entry.title: DEVIS-GRPO: Unleashing GRPO on Dynamic Extreme View Synthesis

author.name: Yi Zuo, Huimin Wu, Lingling Li, Fang Liu, Licheng Jiao, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes DEVIS-GRPO, the first online policy gradient method (GRPO-based) for extreme view video generation, with a progressive accumulation strategy to achieve large-view camera motions.

entry.title: Beyond Point-Wise Matching: Structural Representation Alignment for Accelerating Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Shaodong Xu, Zhendong Wang, Litong Gong, Zexian Li, Wengang Zhou, Tiezheng Ge, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes structural representation alignment for accelerating Diffusion Transformers beyond point-wise matching, explicitly modeling spatial relational geometry from vision foundation models.

entry.title: EPIC-Bench: A Perception-Centric Benchmark for Fine-Grained Embodied Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haozhe Shan, Xiancong Ren, Han Dong, Haoyuan Shi, Yingji Zhang, Jiayu Hu, Yi Zhang, Yong Dai, Bin Shen, Lizhen Qu, Zenglin Xu, Xiaozhu Ju

entry.summary: Introduces EPIC-Bench, a fine-grained grounding benchmark for evaluating VLMs in embodied environments with 6.6k annotated tuples across 23 tasks spanning target localization, navigation, and manipulation.

entry.title: The Learnability Gap in Medical Latent Diffusion

author.name: Mischa Dombrowski, Felix N\"utzel, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Identifies and formalizes the 'learnability gap' in medical latent diffusion: pretrained autoencoders faithfully encode features but their latent representations are structured in ways difficult for classifiers to learn from.

entry.title: Omni-DuplexEval: Evaluating Real-time Duplex Omni-modal Interaction

author.name: Chaoqun He, Mingyang Xiang, Yingjing Xu, Bokai Xu, Junbo Cui, Jie Zhou, Yuan Yao, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-DuplexEval, a benchmark for evaluating real-time duplex interaction in multimodal models, testing both streaming description and proactive response capabilities.

entry.title: RadGenome-Anatomy: A Large-Scale Anatomy-Labeled Chest Radiograph Dataset via Physically Grounded Volumetric Projection

author.name: Shuchang Ye, Mingyuan Meng, Hao Wang, Usman Naseem, Jinman Kim

entry.summary: Introduces RadGenome-Anatomy, the largest anatomy-labeled chest radiograph dataset with 10M+ segmentation masks across 210 anatomical structures in 25,692 studies, created via 3D-to-2D volumetric projection.

entry.title: Spatial Blindness in Whole-Slide Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Ran Su

entry.summary: Identifies 'spatial blindness' in whole-slide MIL models where context-aware architectures retain performance after coordinate permutation, showing predictions are compositional rather than spatial. Proposes ResTopoMIL.

entry.title: Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion

author.name: Peiliang Cai, Evelyn Zhang, Jiacheng Liu, Hao Lin, Ruiqi Zhang, Weile Mo, Yue Ma, Shikang Zheng, Jiehang Huang, Dongrui Liu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Focused Forcing for efficient autoregressive video diffusion that performs content-aware per-frame KV selection, showing that frames within the same generated chunk need distinct historical contexts and that head importance should be explicitly estimated.

entry.title: Can These Views Be One Scene? Evaluating Multiview 3D Consistency when 3D Foundation Models Hallucinate

author.name: Soumava Paul, Prakhar Kaushik, Alan Yuille

entry.summary: Studies reliability of multiview 3D consistency metrics, showing that existing metrics can give high scores to inconsistent outputs. Compares neural reconstruction priors with classical geometric verification and introduces a controlled robustness benchmark.

entry.title: Policy Library CBF: Finite-Horizon Safety at Runtime via Parallel Rollouts

author.name: Taekyung Kim, Hideki Okamoto, Bardh Hoxha, Georgios Fainekos, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Proposes Policy Library CBF (PL-CBF), a runtime safety filter that evaluates fallback policies via parallel rollouts and selects the least invasive safe mode through a quadratic program. Provides theoretical analysis of policy-library coverage.

entry.title: Key-Gram: Extensible World Knowledge for Embodied Manipulation

author.name: Jingjing Fan, Siyuan Li, Botao Ren, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: Introduces Key-Gram, a conditional-memory framework separating language-derived world knowledge from visual-state reasoning in embodied control through deterministic hashed lookup of instruction-derived key-grams.

entry.title: Access Timing as Scaffolding: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to GenAI in Education

author.name: Janne Rotter, Pau Benazet i Montobbio, Davinia Hern\'andez-Leo

entry.summary: Proposes using reinforcement learning to determine optimal timing for student access to generative AI in educational settings, treating access timing as implicit scaffolding grounded in metacognitive and cognitive load theories.

entry.title: EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos

author.name: Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Shaofang Quan, Chengzhi Wu, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Kunyu Peng, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: EgoExoMem introduces the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos, with 2.6K MCQs and E²-Select for training-free dual-view frame selection.

entry.title: Deterministic Event-Graph Substrates as World Models for Counterfactual Reasoning

author.name: Fabio Rovai

entry.summary: Proposes event-graph substrates as world models using append-only RDF triple logs that support exact counterfactual queries via log forking. Outperforms the NS-DR symbolic oracle on CLEVRER benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning Bilevel Policies over Symbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Planning

author.name: Dillon Z. Chen, Till Hofmann, Toryn Q. Klassen, Sheila A. McIlraith

entry.summary: Proposes bilevel policies combining low-level imitation learning for manipulation with high-level symbolic planning for long-horizon tasks, using symbolic world models to facilitate efficient planning.

entry.title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning

author.name: Andr\'e G. Pereira, Augusto B. Corr\^ea, Jendrik Seipp

entry.summary: Proposes property-guided LLM program synthesis for planning, where violated formal properties provide concrete counterexamples to guide LLM improvement rather than simple numeric scores.

entry.title: Hydra: Efficient, Correct Code Generation via Checkpoint-and-Rollback Support

author.name: Alexander Du, Jianjun Ou, Danyang Zhuo, Matthew Lentz

entry.summary: Hydra enables efficient recovery from static errors during code generation through checkpoint-and-rollback, allowing asynchronous checking and targeted recovery to earlier valid states.

entry.title: ChangeFlow -- Latent Rectified Flow for Change Detection in Remote Sensing

author.name: Bla\v{z} Rolih, Matic Fu\v{c}ka, Filip Wolf, Luka \v{C}ehovin Zajc

entry.summary: Proposes ChangeFlow, a generative approach to remote sensing change detection using latent rectified flow models that can model distributions of plausible change masks rather than single predictions, addressing ambiguity in annotations.

entry.title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Teleoperation under Stochastic Delays

author.name: Kaize Deng, Zewen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid control framework combining LSTM-based state estimation with residual RL for robot teleoperation under stochastic communication delays, addressing signal discontinuities that cause high-frequency chattering.

entry.title: CTF4Nuclear: Common Task Framework for Nuclear Fission and Fusion Models

author.name: Stefano Riva, Carolina Introini, Antonio Cammi, Dean Price, Alexey Yermakov, Yue Zhao, Philippe M. Wyder, Judah Goldfeder, Jan Williams, Amy Sara Rude, Matteo Tomasetto, Joe Germany, Joseph Bakarji, Georg Maierhofer, Miles Cranmer, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Introduces CTF4Nuclear, a Common Task Framework providing standardized ML benchmarks for nuclear fission and fusion modeling, addressing the gap between high-fidelity simulations and real-time applications.

entry.title: Position: Early-Stage Quality Assurance in Annotation Pipelines Is More Cost-Effective Than Late-Stage Validation

author.name: Sunil Kothari, Sumukha Sharma Thoppanahalli Chandramouli, Naman Khandelwal, Parth Kulshreshtha, Ashi Jain, Kriti Banka, Tanuja Chintada, Venkata Triveni, Gulipalli Praveen Kumar, Manish Mehta, Tao Liu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that early-stage quality assurance in data annotation pipelines is more cost-effective than late-stage validation, drawing on software engineering's 'shift-left' principle showing 4-100x cost multipliers for late-detected defects.

entry.title: LoCO: Low-rank Compositional Rotation Fine-tuning

author.name: An Nguyen, Jaesik Choi, Anh Tong

entry.summary: Introduces LoCO, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that constructs orthogonal transformations via low-rank skew-symmetric matrices to preserve geometric structure of pretrained representations during adaptation.

entry.title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints

author.name: Gwenol\'e Quellec

entry.summary: Presents a unifying perspective on representation learning as constrained latent state modeling, arguing that fragmented approaches reflect underconstrained objectives that fail to specify meaningful latent state properties.

entry.title: Ada-Diffuser: Latent-Aware Adaptive Diffusion for Decision-Making

author.name: Fan Feng, Selena Ge, Minghao Fu, Zijian Li, Yujia Zheng, Zeyu Tang, Yingyao Hu, Biwei Huang, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Ada-Diffuser, a framework incorporating latent dynamic inference into diffusion-based decision-making, showing theoretical identifiability of latent processes from temporal blocks of observations.

entry.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation

author.name: Yiming Zhao, Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Qing Miao, Qisheng Su, Jiawei Zhao, Jiayin Cai, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Yukun Qi, Yao Hu, Xiaolong Jiang, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes VideoSeeker for instance-level video understanding that combines visual perception with language reasoning via native agentic tool invocation, addressing limitations of text-only prompting for spatiotemporal localization.

entry.title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation

author.name: Yuqi Wu, Tianyu Hu, Wenzhao Zheng, Yuanhui Huang, Haowen Sun, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes IVGT, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that models continuous 3D geometry from unposed multi-view images using neural implicit representations in canonical coordinate systems.

entry.title: Language Game: Talking to Non-Human Systems

author.name: Yanbo Zhang, Michael Levin

entry.summary: Proposes treating non-neural biological systems as dialogue partners using Wittgenstein's language games framework, where system internal dynamics map to communication signals.

entry.title: TailedTS: Benchmark Dataset for Heavy-Tailed Time Series Prediction and Periodicity Quantification

author.name: Xinyu Chen, HanQin Cai, Lijun Ding, Jinhua Zhao

entry.summary: TailedTS introduces a large-scale benchmark dataset from Wikipedia hourly page views (24.69 billion data points) designed to test time series forecasting under heavy-tailed, zero-inflated conditions. It addresses gaps in existing benchmarks like M4/M5 that underrepresent extreme volatility.

entry.title: Avoiding Structural Failure Modes in Tabular Fair SSL: Online Primal-Dual Allocation under Confidence Gating

author.name: Hangchun Liang, Changchun Li

entry.summary: Identifies structural failure modes in tabular fair semi-supervised learning (Masking Collapse and Trivial Saturation) and proposes Online Primal-Dual Allocation (OPDA) to dynamically balance fairness and stability without per-dataset tuning.

entry.title: Multiscale Supervised Unbalanced Optimal Transport Flow Matching

author.name: Qiangwei Peng, Lezhi Chen, Peijie Zhou

entry.summary: MUST-FM scales unbalanced optimal transport for single-cell analysis by exploiting hierarchical data structure and optional supervision from cell lineages, enabling scalable flow matching for birth-death dynamics.

entry.title: GraViti: Graph-Level Variational Autoencoders with Relaxed Permutation Invariance

author.name: Roman Bresson, Konstantinos Divriotis, Johannes F. Lutzeyer, Iakovos Evdaimon, Michalis Vazirgiannis

entry.summary: GraViti is a transformer-based graph-level VAE that maps entire graphs to latent vectors, supporting interpolation and property-guided search. Shows that enforcing permutation invariance can be detrimental when canonical orderings exist.

entry.title: UB-SMoE: Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Resource-adaptive Federated Fine-tuning of Foundation Models

author.name: Van-Tuan Tran, Hong-Hanh Nguyen-Le, Marco Ruffini, Merim Dzaferagic

entry.summary: UB-SMoE addresses expert utilization imbalance and non-differentiable Top-K routing issues when applying Sparse MoE to heterogeneous federated fine-tuning, with convergence analysis showing these cause degradation for resource-constrained clients.

entry.title: EmoMind: Decoding Affective Captions from Human Brain fMRI

author.name: Bilal A. Mohammed, Lin Gu, Ruogo Fang

entry.summary: EmoMind is the first end-to-end pipeline for decoding affective captions from fMRI, combining semantic scene description with a continuous 34-dimensional emotion vector decoded from the same brain recording.

entry.title: Atoms as Language: VQ-Atom: Semantic Discretization for Molecular Representation Learning

author.name: Takayuki Kimura

entry.summary: VQ-Atom converts continuous atom-level graph representations into discrete tokens representing local chemical environments using vector quantization, creating a molecular language for transformer pretraining.

entry.title: S-Bus: Automatic Read-Set Reconstruction for Multi-Agent LLM State Coordination

author.name: Sajjad Khan

entry.summary: Presents S-Bus, HTTP middleware that prevents structural race conditions in multi-agent LLM systems sharing mutable state, using a server-side DeliveryLog for Observable-Read Isolation without SDK changes.

entry.title: Differentiable Optimization Layers for Guaranteed Fairness in Deep Learning

author.name: David Troxell, Noah Roemer, Guido Mont\'ufar

entry.summary: Introduces differentiable 'fairness layers' appended to neural network outputs that guarantee output parity constraints, plus an online primal-dual algorithm for provable aggregate fairness in streaming predictions.

entry.title: State-of-the-Art Claims Require State-of-the-Art Evidence

author.name: YongKyung Oh

entry.summary: Argues that SOTA claims in AI need stronger statistical evidence, identifying a widespread claim-evidence gap where marginal mean improvements don't establish meaningful superiority across tasks.

entry.title: Olivia: Harmonizing Time Series Foundation Models with Power Spectral Density

author.name: Jingru Fei, Kun Yi, Alex Xing Wang, Qingsong Wen, Xiangxiang Zhu, Wei Fan

entry.summary: Introduces Olivia/Harmonizer, a module that reshapes spectral structures across diverse time series datasets during pretraining using normalized power spectral density, improving foundation model generalization.

entry.title: \textsc{MasFACT}: Continual Multi-Agent Topology Learning via Geometry-Aware Posterior Transfer

author.name: Xuefei Wang, Jialu Wang, Fengbo Zhang, Yihan Hu, Di Zhang, Yutong Ye, Yikun Ban, Jun Han, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'topology forgetting' in multi-agent LLM systems where adapting communication topology to new tasks erases patterns needed for earlier tasks, proposing geometry-aware posterior transfer to mitigate.

entry.title: Coordinate Heterogeneity Governs Binary Quantization: From InfoNCE to Recall

author.name: Wenxuan Xiao

entry.summary: Resolves puzzle of why binary quantization works for contrastive embeddings but not others, showing coordinate heterogeneity governs BQ quality and connecting this to InfoNCE-trained Gaussian structure.

entry.title: TabKDE: Simple and Scalable Tabular Data Generation with Kernel Density Estimates

author.name: Meysam Alishahi, Yan Zheng, Junpeng Wang, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: TabKDE proposes using copula transformations and kernel density estimation for tabular data generation, achieving near-SOTA accuracy with almost no training cost compared to expensive methods using VAEs and diffusion models.

entry.title: Learning Variable-Length Tokenization for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Minhao Wang, Bowen Wu, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Discovers the 'Popularity-Length Paradox' in generative recommendation: popular items achieve optimal performance with short IDs while tail items need longer codes. Proposes variable-length tokenization that adapts encoding length to item characteristics.

entry.title: Content-Style Identification via Differential Independence

author.name: Subash Timilsina, Hoang-Son Nguyen, Sagar Shrestha, Xiao Fu

entry.summary: Introduces content-style differential independence (CSDI), requiring that content and style variations induce orthogonal directions on the data manifold, enabling identifiable content-style separation under weaker assumptions than prior work.

entry.title: Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals

author.name: Haozheng Luo, Haoran Dai, Shaoyang Zhang, Xi Chen, Eric Hanchen Jiang, Yijiang Li, Jingyuan Huang, Chenghao Qiu, Chenwei Xu, Zhenyu Pan, Haotian Zhang, Binghui Wang, Yan Chen
