entry.title: Sustainable Intelligence for the Wild: Democratizing Ecological Monitoring via Knowledge-Adaptive Edge Expert Agents

author.name: Jiaxing Li, Hao Fang, Chi Xu, Miao Zhang, Jiangchuan Liu, William I. Atlas, Katrina M. Connors, Mark A. Spoljaric

entry.summary: Proposes edge-deployed ecological monitoring architecture separating visual perception from reasoning with dynamic knowledge base, enabling adaptation in remote settings without cloud connectivity.

entry.title: HYVINT: Intensity-Driven Hypergraph Generation with Variational Representations

author.name: Xinyi Hong, Shuntuo Xu, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes HYVINT, an intensity-driven hypergraph generative framework using variational representations that links latent interaction strengths to discrete incidence formation.

entry.title: Factorized Latent Dynamics for Video JEPA: An Empirical Study of Auxiliary Objectives

author.name: Santosh Premi

entry.summary: Reports empirical study of 18 auxiliary objective variants for Video-JEPA, finding capacity trade-offs where gains on one downstream capability often hurt others.

entry.title: Maximum Likelihood Decoding of Quantum Error Correction Codes

author.name: Hanyan Cao, Ge Yan, Yuxuan Du, Feng Pan

entry.summary: Provides a topical review of maximum likelihood decoding for quantum error correction, surveying recent advances through statistical mechanics, tensor networks, and machine learning approaches.

entry.title: Multi-task learning on partially labeled datasets via invariant/equivariant semi-supervised learning

author.name: Miquel Mart\'i i Rabad\'an, Alessandro Pieropan, Hossein Azizpour, Atsuto Maki

entry.summary: Investigates using invariant and equivariant semi-supervised learning (FixMatch and Dense FixMatch) for multi-task learning on partially labeled datasets with different task structures.

entry.title: Multi-site PPG: An In-the-Wild Physiological Dataset from Emerging Multi-site Wearables

author.name: Jiayi Shao (Shirley), Jiaying Ye (Shirley), Shengyao Liu (Shirley), Zachary Englhardt (Shirley), Girish Narayanswamy (Shirley), Vikram Iyer (Shirley), Qiuyue (Shirley), Xue

entry.title: SVFSearch: A Multimodal Knowledge-Intensive Benchmark for Short-Video Frame Search in the Gaming Vertical Domain

author.name: Lingtao Mao, Huangyu Dai, Xinyu Sun, Zihan Liang, Ben Chen, Chenyi Lei, Wenwu Ou

entry.summary: Introduces SVFSearch, a multimodal benchmark for short-video frame search in Chinese gaming domain with 5000 examples requiring vertical domain knowledge to answer questions about paused game frames.

entry.title: SAS: Semantic-aware Sampling for Generative Dataset Distillation

author.name: Mingzhuo Li, Guang Li, Linfeng Ye, Jiafeng Mao, Takahiro Ogawa, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis, Miki Haseyama

entry.summary: Introduces SAS, a semantic-aware sampling method for generative dataset distillation that uses CLIP as a semantic prior for preserving high-level information in distilled datasets.

entry.title: New Insight of Variance reduce in Zero-Order Hard-Thresholding: Mitigating Gradient Error and Expansivity Contradictions

author.name: Xinzhe Yuan (Harbin Institute of Technology), William de Vazelhes (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence), Bin Gu (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University), Huan Xiong (Harbin Institute of Technology, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)

entry.title: Estimating Item Difficulty with Large Language Models as Experts

author.name: Diana Kolesnikova (Department of Methodology and Statistics, Tilburg University, Tilburg, Netherlands), Kirill Fedyanin (Smart Business Technologies, Belgrade, Serbia), Abe D. Hofman (Department of Psychological Methods, University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, Netherlands, Prowise Learn, Amsterdam, Netherlands), Matthieu J. S. Brinkhuis (Department of Information and Computing Sciences, Utrecht University, Utrecht, Netherlands), Maria Bolsinova (Department of Methodology and Statistics, Tilburg University, Tilburg, Netherlands)

entry.summary: Evaluates three off-the-shelf LLMs as difficulty raters for educational assessment items without response data. Examines different elicitation procedures and prompt configurations to emulate expert judgment for item difficulty estimation.

entry.title: Can machine learning for quantum-gas experiments be explainable?

author.name: I. B. Spielman amd J. P. Zwolak

entry.summary: Reviews ML applications to cold-atom quantum simulators, focusing on image denoising and soliton identification in Bose-Einstein condensates, with commentary on the interplay between performance, model complexity, and interpretability.

entry.title: Learned Memory Attenuation in Sage-Husa Kalman Filters for Robust UAV State Estimation

author.name: Aisha Alansari, Hamzah Luqman

entry.title: ACIL: Auto Chain of Thoughts for In-Context Learning

author.name: Rui Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Auto-CoT framework to automatically construct reasoning-enhanced demonstrations for in-context learning, generating intermediate reasoning chains for ICL examples to improve multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: Beyond Transcripts: Iterative Peer-Editing with Audio Unlocks High-Quality Human Summaries of Conversational Speech

entry.title: Sometin Beta Pass Notin (SBPN): Improving Multilingual ASR for Nigerian Languages via Knowledge Distillation

entry.title: Trajectory-Aware Adaptive Inference in Object Detection Models

author.name: Grigorios Papanikolaou, Ioannis Kontopoulos, Giannis Spiliopoulos, Dimitris Zissis, Konstantinos Tserpes

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision: A Quantum-enhanced State Space Model for Calibrated Mixed-type Wafer Defect Detection

author.name: Satwik Sai Prakash Sahoo, Jyoti Prakash Sahoo, Ting Wang, Subrota Kumar Mondal

entry.summary: Introduces Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision combining quantum computing with state-space models for wafer defect detection in semiconductor manufacturing, addressing class imbalance and computational efficiency.

entry.title: Neural Visual Decoding via Cognitive guided Adaptive Blurring and Information Constrained Alignment

author.name: Fan Yin, Chuhang Zheng, Peiliang Gong, Donghai Guan, Qi Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes CAIA framework for EEG-based visual decoding that simulates selective attention on visual side and leverages neural oscillation priors on EEG side with information bottleneck principles.

entry.title: DepthPolyp: Pseudo-Depth Guided Lightweight Segmentation for Real-Time Colonoscopy

author.name: Guanghua He, Hancan Zhu, Gaohang Yu, An Zhang

author.name: Houji Wen, Jiangyong Yu, Jun Li, Dawei Yang

author.name: Bin Yang, Alexandru Paul Condurache

entry.title: GeoHand: Unlocking Prior Geometry Knowledge for Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction

author.name: Bo Zhao, Maosheng Pang, Chen Zhang, Huan Yang, Yixin Cao, Wei Ji

entry.summary: Introduces UniPPTBench, a unified benchmark for presentation generation across diverse input settings (vague prompts, documents, multimodal materials) with scenario-aware evaluation framework.

entry.summary: Examines three strategies for building privacy-preserving facial expression recognition datasets: pseudo-labeling, diffusion-based synthesis, and task-specific generation. Addresses class imbalance and privacy constraints in FER.

entry.title: Deep learning-based compression of giga-resolution whole slide images

entry.summary: Explores deep learning-based compression for whole slide images in digital pathology, comparing learned compression methods against JPEG/JPEG-XL with tissue segmentation for glass removal.

author.name: Yu Li, Puchao Zhou, Yachun Mi, Yanfeng Wu, Xiaoming Wang, Shaohui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Global-Local Interaction Adapter for blind image quality assessment, enabling efficient fine-tuning of large pre-trained vision models for IQA tasks.

author.name: Huawei Jiang, Husna Mutahira, Shibo Wei, Jiahang Li, Vladimir Shin, Juneho Yi, Dongryeol Ryu, Wonyoung Park, Mannan Saeed Muhammad

entry.title: MARS: Technical Report for the CASTLE Challenge at EgoVis 2026

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Qiaohui Chu, Yisen Feng, Meng Liu, Weili Guan, Yaowei Wang, Liqiang Nie

entry.title: CineMatte: Background Matting for Virtual Production and Beyond

entry.title: NeRF-based Spacecraft Reconstruction from Close-Range Monocular Imagery Under Illumination Variability and Pose Uncertainty

author.name: Antoine Legrand, Renaud Detry, Christophe De Vleeschouwer

entry.summary: Extends NeRF for spacecraft 3D reconstruction from monocular imagery with per-image learnable appearance embeddings for illumination variability and pose corrections for orbit uncertainty.

author.name: Yifei Pei, Ying Liu, Nam Ling

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive fused prior transfer for controllable generative image compression at very low bitrates, using multiple prior sources rather than single-codebook approaches to better handle severe bit constraints.

entry.title: Real-Time Neural Hair Denoising

Achieves higher quality than existing hair denoising techniques for physically-based deferred shading.

entry.title: "I'm Not Mad, Just Focused'': Understanding Human Emotions in Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Seung Chan Hong, Dana Kuli\'c, Leimin Tian

entry.summary: Proposes a VLM-based emotion recognition system for human-robot collaboration that leverages contextual understanding. User study shows emotional awareness improves collaboration quality despite misclassification concerns.

entry.title: Stretch-ICP: A Continuous-Trajectory Registration and Deskewing Algorithm in Scenarios of Aggressive Motions

author.name: Simon-Pierre Desch\^enes, Veronica Vannini, Philippe Gigu\`ere, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau

entry.summary: Introduces Stretch-ICP for continuous-trajectory registration and deskewing under aggressive motions, along with the TIGS dataset of a LiDAR tumbling down a hill with extreme angular velocities.

entry.title: Optimal Knock-Pick Planning for Tightly Packed Tabletop Blocks With Parallel Grippers

author.name: Hao Lu, Rahul Shome

entry.title: A Dexterous and Compliant Gripper With Soft Hydraulic Actuation for Microgravity Manipulation

author.name: William Su, Jordan Kam, Yixiao Wang, Jianshu Zhou

entry.title: Scenario Generation in Roundabouts with Adjustable Interaction Intensity

entry.summary: Presents an interaction-aware roundabout scenario generator with continuously adjustable interaction intensity using latent-space autoencoders, enabling systematic AV safety testing.

entry.summary: Presents ATRACT, a drone-based decision support system for battlefield casualty triage, integrating drone video with wearable sensor data to assist frontline medics during the critical post-trauma period.

entry.summary: Develops efficient algorithms for computing the Volterra signature (generalizing the classical path signature with matrix-valued kernels), achieving quadratic general complexity and FFT-based acceleration for specific kernel classes.

entry.title: Coordinal: A Postmortem.

author.name: Ronak_Mehta

entry.title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control

author.name: Jingxuan Wei, Xi Bai, Shan Liu, Caijun Jia, Zheng Sun, Xinglong Xu, Siyuan Li, Linzhuang Sun, Bihui Yu, Conghui He, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: PAGER addresses precision-sensitive GUI tasks (like geometric construction) where actions must land on exact points rather than tolerant regions, requiring point-level accuracy and geometry-aware verification.

entry.title: Presupposition and Reasoning in Conditionals: A Theory-Based Study of Humans and LLMs

author.name: Tara Azin, Yongan Yu, Raj Singh, Olessia Jouravlev

entry.summary: Compares human and LLM processing of presupposition projection in conditionals through parallel behavioral studies. Finds humans integrate probabilistic and pragmatic cues while LLMs show variable alignment with human patterns.

entry.title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision

author.name: Jing Wang, Shang Liu, Hangan Zhou, Zhiyao Xie

entry.summary: RTL-BenchMT is an agentic framework for dynamically maintaining RTL generation benchmarks, automatically identifying flawed cases and detecting overfitting in hardware design benchmarks.

entry.title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices

author.name: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: TopoEvo is a topology-aware self-evolving multi-agent framework for root cause analysis in microservices that couples graph representation learning with topology-constrained reasoning to avoid symptom-amplification bias.

entry.title: CitePrism: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Citation Auditing and Editorial Integrity

author.name: Gowrika Mahesh, Budanur Madappa Darshan Gowda, Kavana Gopladevarahalli Papegowda, Prajwal Basavaraj, Binh Vu, Swati Chandna, Mehrdad Jalali

entry.summary: Presents CitePrism, a hybrid human-in-the-loop system for editorial citation auditing combining LLM reasoning, semantic similarity, metadata verification, and integrity flags to support manuscript review.

entry.title: Mirror Descent-Type Algorithms for the Variational Inequality Problem with Functional Constraints

author.name: Mohammad S. Alkousa, Fedor S. Stonyakin, Belal A. Alashqar, Seydamet S. Ablaev

entry.summary: Proposes mirror descent algorithms for variational inequality problems with functional constraints, with optimal convergence rates for bounded and monotone operators.

entry.title: Peak-Detector: Explainable Peak Detection via Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models in Physiological Sign

author.name: Jiahui Li, Yida Zhang, Zixuan Zeng, Jiayu Chen, Yingjian Song, Yin Xiao, Nishan Dong, Junjie Lu, Younghoon Kwon, Xiang Zhang, Jin Lu, Wenzhan Song, Fei Dou

entry.summary: Peak-Detector uses instruction-tuned LLMs for cross-modal physiological peak detection across ECG, PPG, BCG, and BSG signals, providing interpretable explanations for detected peaks.

entry.title: Learning Fill-in Reduction Ordering via Graph Policy Optimization for Sparse Matrices

author.name: Ziwei Li, Shuzi Niu, Huiyuan Li, Tao Yuan, Wenjia Wu

entry.summary: Proposes graph policy optimization for sparse matrix fill-in reduction, using multi-hop GNN with symbolic factorization feedback for both global and local fill-in views.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Sparse Matrix Reordering

author.name: Ziwei Li, Tao Yuan, Fangfang Liu, Shuzi Niu, Huiyuan Li, Wenjia Wu

entry.summary: Applies self-supervised learning to sparse matrix reordering using the Fill-Path Theorem, deriving triplet sampling from path inequalities and using multigrid graph networks for structural embedding.

entry.title: Uncertainty Reliability Under Domain Shift: An Investigation for Data-Driven Blood Pressure Estimation in Photoplethysmography

author.name: Mohammad Moulaeifard, Ciaran Bench, Philip J. Aston, Nils Strodthoff

entry.title: Bridging the Version Gap: Multi-version Training Improves ICD Code Prediction, Especially for Rare Codes

author.name: Jinghui Liu, Anthony Nguyen

entry.summary: Examines whether combining training data annotated with different ICD versions (ICD-9 and ICD-10) can improve clinical coding models, particularly for rare codes. Finds multi-version training helps address the long-tail distribution problem.

entry.title: Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Change Detection Based on Global Dynamic Context-Aware Network

author.name: Baogui Huan, Chuanzheng Gong, Dezhong Chen, Feng Gao, Junyu Dong, Qian Du

entry.summary: Proposes GDNet for SAR image change detection using global dynamic convolution that adapts kernel weights based on global semantic information, addressing limited receptive fields of standard CNNs.

entry.title: Inter-LPCM: Learning-based Inter-Frame Predictive Coding for LiDAR Point Cloud Compression

author.name: Chang Sun, Hui Yuan, Shiqi Jiang, Chongzhen Tian, Guanghui Zhang, Raouf Hamzaoui

entry.summary: Proposes Inter-LPCM, a learning-based inter-frame predictive coding method for LiDAR point cloud compression in spherical coordinates. Improves upon traditional linear prediction models for capturing complex motion patterns.

entry.title: Mapping the Fitness Landscape: A Structure-Guided Approach to Multi-Modal Optimization

author.name: Meng Xiang, Pei Yan

entry.summary: Introduces CLDE, a decision-space-centric framework for multimodal optimization that explicitly recovers peak-basin organization rather than relying on distance-based niching. Uses chaotic exploration and persistence-based topological analysis.

entry.title: Virtues of Ordered Chaos: Planning with Topple Actions in Tabletop Stack Rearrangement

author.name: Hao Lu, Rahul Shome

entry.summary: Studies augmenting tabletop stack rearrangement with topple actions that can compress long sequences of intermediate relocations, introducing a novel aggregating gadget for planning with both pick-and-place and topple.

entry.title: Towards Ubiquitous Mapping and Localization for Dynamic Indoor Environments

author.name: Halim Djerroud, Nico Steyn, Olivier Rabreau, Patrick Bonnin, Abderraouf Benali

entry.summary: Presents UbiSLAM using a network of fixed RGB-D cameras for real-time mapping and localization in dynamic indoor environments, providing robots with continuously updated global maps.

entry.title: Learning Gaussian Graphical Models under Total Positivity via Spectral Graph Sparsification

author.name: Ignacio Echave-Sustaeta Rodr\'iguez, Aida Abiad, Frank R\"ottger

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral graph sparsification approach for learning Gaussian graphical models under total positivity (MTP2) constraints, addressing the problem that MTP2-constrained graphs are typically too dense.

entry.title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol

author.name: Naruki Yoshikawa, Ryo Tamura

entry.summary: NIMO Controller is an SDL (self-driving laboratory) orchestrator built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), providing standardized interfaces for AI agents to control laboratory equipment and workflows.

entry.title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation

entry.summary: OmniManim addresses visual defects in LLM-generated educational animations by introducing render-feedback-aware code generation with explicit visual planning and scene state management.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Wildfire Smoke Density Classification from Satellite Imagery via CBAM-Augmented EfficientNet with Evidential Deep Learning

author.name: Ranjith Chodavarapu

entry.summary: Presents a probabilistic framework for wildfire smoke density classification from satellite imagery using EfficientNet with CBAM and evidential deep learning to provide decomposed epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: DeepArrhythmia: Segment-Contextualized ECG Arrhythmia Classification via Selective Evidence Acquisition

author.name: Jiahui Li, Ruili Fang, Zishuai Liu, WenZhan Song, Jin Lu, Fei Dou

entry.summary: DeepArrhythmia is a multimodal framework for beat-level ECG arrhythmia classification that combines raw ECG signals with rendered waveform images, using multi-beat rhythm context rather than treating beats as isolated instances.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Molecular Relational Learning: Leveraging Chemical Structure-Activity Analysis

author.name: Peiliang Zhang, Jingling Yuan, Shiqing Wu, Mengqing Hu, Chao Che, Yongjun Zhu, Lin Li

author.name: Chia-Ying Hsieh, Hsin-Yuan Fang, Chun-Shu Wei

entry.title: UNR-Explainer: Counterfactual Explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation Learning Models

author.name: Hyunju Kang, Geonhee Han, Hogun Park

entry.title: UniAlign: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Robust Network Traffic Classification under Distribution Shifts

author.name: Tongze Wang, Xiaohui Xie, Wenduo Wang, Chuyi Wang, Yong Cui

It addresses a practical problem in deploying ML models in changing network conditions.

entry.title: MR-SLAM: Immersive Spatial Supervision for Multi-Robot Mapping via Mixed Reality

author.name: Prakash Aryan, Cem Erdogdu, Kavinaya Kumarchokkappan, Timo Kehrer, Sebastiano Panichella

entry.title: An Algebraic Exposition of the Theory of Dyadic Morality

author.name: Vinil Pasupuleti, Siva Rama Krishna Varma Bayyavarapu, Shrey Tyagi

author.name: Debanshu Das, Lavi Nigam, Sunil Kumar Jang Bahadur, Gopala Dhar

entry.summary: Introduces Genflow, a compound AI system for brand-consistent video generation using retrieval-based 'Brand DNA' extraction and adversarial multi-agent quality control loops.

entry.title: A Systematic Survey on Deep Learning Architectures for Point Cloud Classification and Segmentation

author.name: Minhas Kamal, Hiranya Garbha Kumar, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran

entry.summary: Provides a systematic survey of deep learning architectures for point cloud classification and segmentation, covering processing strategies from early work to recent attention-based approaches.

author.name: Kaichuan Kong, Dongjie Liu, Xiaobo Jin, Guanggang Geng

author.name: Diego Casadei

entry.summary: Provides a unified perspective on structured flow modeling connecting continuous Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition with discrete Graph Vector Field framework and data-driven representations.

entry.title: Visual Search Patterns in 3D Pancreatic Imaging: An Eye Tracking Study

The method introduces quality-aware pseudo-label refinement and patch-level contrastive objectives.

entry.title: Historical Knowledge Graphs for Global Maritime Estimated Time of Arrival

author.name: Neofytos Dimitriou

entry.summary: Presents a methodology for constructing historical maritime knowledge graphs from AIS data for vessel ETA prediction, using Gaussian mixture model preprocessing and geohash-based graph construction spanning 5,433 nodes.

entry.title: Assessing Localization Technologies for Pedestrian Collision Avoidance

author.name: Joshua Varughese, Joseba Gorospe, Novel Certad, Cristina Olaverri-Monreal

entry.summary: Assesses UWB and Bluetooth 6.0 localization technologies for pedestrian collision avoidance systems, benchmarking against GNSS for vehicular safety applications.

entry.title: Data-Driven Dynamic Modeling of a Tendon-Actuated Continuum Robot

author.name: Harald Minde Hansen, Bj{\o}rn K{\aa}re S{\ae}b{\o}, Kristin Y. Pettersen, Jan Tommy Gravdahl, Mario Di Castro

entry.summary: Compares data-driven system identification methods (N4SID, ARX, SINDYc) for modeling a tendon-actuated continuum robot at CERN. Finds that a two-degree-of-freedom model captures the dynamics despite high joint count, and demonstrates model predictive control feasibility.

entry.title: Comparing Two Categorical Gini Correlations with Applications to Classification Problems

author.name: Sameera Hewage, Yongli Sang

entry.summary: Proposes an inferential framework for comparing predictor importance in classification via categorical Gini correlation differences, accommodating arbitrary dimensions and dependent predictor groups.

entry.title: Learning Selective Merge Policies for Deadline-Constrained Coded Caching via Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Amirhossein Yousefiramandi

entry.summary: Applies deep reinforcement learning to learn selective merge policies for deadline-constrained coded caching, formulating it as a masked discrete-action queue-state control problem.

entry.title: Edge-AI-Driven Learning-to-Rank for Decentralized Task Allocation in Circular Smart Manufacturing

author.name: Mohammadhossein Ghahramani, Yan Qiao, Mengchu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes an Edge-AI framework for decentralized task allocation in circular smart manufacturing using learning-to-rank for negotiation-based assignment of tasks to machines.

entry.title: QuChaTeR: A Hybrid Quantum-Chaotic Temporal Framework for Earthquake Prediction

author.name: Emir Kaan \"Ozdemir

entry.summary: QuChaTeR combines wavelet preprocessing, chaotic maps, and variational quantum circuits with recurrent structures for earthquake prediction. Benchmarked against classical and quantum baselines.

entry.title: Cross-modal Affinity-aligned Multimodal Learning Analytics for Predicting Student Collaboration Satisfaction in Game-Based Learning

author.name: Wen-Hsin Tsai, Chia-Ming Lee, Yuk-Ying Tung

entry.summary: AAMLA framework uses cross-modal affinity matrices to handle modality degradation in predicting student collaboration satisfaction in game-based learning environments.

entry.title: Progressive Generalization Augmentation with Deeply Coupled RND-PPO and Domain-Prioritized Noise Injection for Robust Crop Management Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Wu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes progressive generalization augmentation for agricultural RL with coupled RND-PPO and domain-prioritized noise injection, addressing robustness deficits in crop management policies.

entry.title: Integration of AI in Cybersecurity: Current Trends with a Focused Look at Intrusion Detection Applications

author.name: S. Tazili, A. Mansour, M. Y. Chkouri

entry.summary: Review paper covering AI integration in cybersecurity with focus on intrusion detection, discussing trends in generative AI, federated learning, and explainable AI for security.

entry.title: Human-Flow Digital Twin for Predicting the Effects of Mobility Introduction on Visitor Circulation

author.name: Chiharu Shima, Haruki Yonekura, Fukuharu Tanaka, Tatsuya Amano, Hirozumi Yamaguchi

entry.summary: Proposes a human-flow digital twin framework using multi-agent simulation to predict effects of mobility introduction on visitor circulation patterns, training agent decision models on pre-intervention data.

entry.title: QLIF-CAST: Quantum Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire for Time-Series Weather Forecasting

author.name: Alberto Marchisio, Aayan Ebrahim, Nouhaila Innan, Muhammad Kashif, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Adapts Quantum Leaky Integrate-and-Fire spiking neural network for time-series weather forecasting, embedding quantum neuron states in a hybrid quantum-classical recurrent architecture.

entry.title: How Loud Rumbles Hit Newsstands: A Data Analysis of Coverage and Spatial Bias in German News about Landslides Around the World

author.name: Brielen Madureira, Andreas Niekler, Marc Keuschnigg, Mariana Madruga de Brito

entry.summary: Analyzes spatial bias in German news coverage of landslides worldwide over 25 years using 60K articles about 5.5K events. Finds overreporting of Southern and Western Europe relative to actual landslide susceptibility.

entry.title: LLMs in Qualitative Research: Opportunities, Limitations, and Practical Considerations

author.name: Henry Salgado, Meagan R. Kendall, Martine Ceberio, Alexandra Coso Strong

entry.summary: Examines opportunities and limitations of LLMs in qualitative research, arguing researchers must critically engage with technical parameters (context window, temperature, prompt design) within epistemological commitments of qualitative methods.

entry.title: Optimising CSRNet with parameter-free attention mechanisms for crowd counting in public transport

author.name: Aida Rostamza, Enrico Del Re, Joshua Cherian Varughese, Cristina Olaverri-Monreal

entry.summary: Investigates parameter-free attention mechanisms for CSRNet-based crowd counting in public transport, aiming to maintain accuracy while reducing model size for edge deployment.

entry.title: CAX-Agent: A Lightweight Agent Harness for Reliable APDL Automation

author.name: Chenying Lin, Yichen Hai, Yi He, Ran Wang, Haiyan Qiang, Liang Yu

entry.summary: CAX-Agent is a lightweight agent harness for automating MAPDL finite-element simulations, featuring a three-layer architecture with a recovery ladder for handling failures.

entry.title: PDRNN: Modular Data-driven Pedestrian Dead Reckoning on Loosely Coupled Radio- and Inertial-Signalstreams

author.name: Peter Bauer, Andreas Porada, Felix Ott, Christopher Mutschler, Tobias Feigl

entry.summary: Proposes a modular RNN architecture for pedestrian dead reckoning that handles asynchronous, multi-modal sensor data streams with different sampling rates.

entry.title: A Unified Generative-AI Framework for Smart Energy Infrastructure: Intelligent Gas Distribution, Utility Billing, Carbon Analytics, and Quantum-Inspired Optimisation

author.name: Pavan Manjunath, Thomas pruefer

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework combining generative AI for smart energy infrastructure including gas distribution, utility billing, carbon analytics, and quantum-inspired optimization.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Based Pre-Test Risk Stratification for PCR-Confirmed Chlamydia Using Patient-Reported Data and Urine Biomarkers

author.name: Mehrab Mahdian, Marko Lehes, Katrin Krolov, Tamas Pardy

entry.summary: Evaluates ML-based pre-test risk stratification for Chlamydia using patient-reported data and urine biomarkers on 93 samples. Tests five classifiers with stratified cross-validation for potential screening optimization.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated Deep Learning for Heatwave Prediction and Urban Heat Risk Assessment

author.name: Adis Alihod\v{z}i\'c

entry.title: An Analytical Multiple Criteria Framework for Temporal and Dynamic Business-to-Business Customer Segmentation in Manufacturing

author.name: Muhammad Raees, Konstantinos Papangelis, Vassilis Javed Khan

entry.summary: Designs a dynamic multi-criteria B2B customer segmentation method extending RFM with stability and growth dimensions, using adaptive hierarchical processes and multivariate time-series clustering.

entry.title: Venom: A PyTorch Generative Modeling Toolkit

author.name: Liang Yan

entry.summary: Venom is an educational PyTorch toolkit that implements multiple generative modeling families (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs, energy-based models) under a unified MNIST-first interface for learning and comparison purposes.

entry.title: Evolutionary Extreme Learning Machine of ab-initio Energy Landscapes for Crystal Structure Prediction using Manta Ray Optimization with Levy Flight

author.name: Adrian Rubio-Solis

entry.summary: Proposes an evolutionary extreme learning machine using Manta Ray Foraging Optimization with Levy Flight for predicting crystal structure formation energies.

entry.title: From Imitation to Interaction: Mastering Game of Schnapsen with Shallow Reinforcement Learning

author.name: J\'an Kla\v{c}an, Sizhong Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates shallow RL agents for the card game Schnapsen, showing reinforcement learning substantially outperforms supervised imitation learning against strong search-based opponents.

entry.title: Buffer-Parameterized Machine Learning Surrogate Models for Cross-Technology Signal Integrity Analysis and Optimization

author.name: Julian With\"oft, Werner John, Emre Ecik, Ralf Br\"uning, J\"urgen G\"otze

entry.summary: Introduces buffer-parameterized ML surrogate models for signal integrity analysis that can handle cross-technology IC buffer variations without retraining, treating buffer characteristics as input parameters.

entry.title: The IsalProgram Programming Language

author.name: Ezequiel L\'opez-Rubio

entry.summary: Introduces IsalProgram, a novel assembly-like programming language that is a regular language (accepted by finite automaton), where every finite string is syntactically valid, and makes no explicit use of memory addresses.

entry.title: Fault tolerance estimation in digital circuits with visualised generative networks

author.name: Sascha Biel, Carl Alexander Gaede, Amiel Glaser, Jan Wolter, Alexej Schelle

entry.summary: Uses GANs to estimate fault tolerance of digital circuits by comparing generated ideal outputs with realistic signals including various error modes.

entry.title: AgriMind: An Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Plant Disease Classification

author.name: Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli, Fahima Haque Talukder Jely

entry.summary: Presents AgriMind, an ensemble of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, and DenseNet121 for plant disease classification achieving 99.23% accuracy on PlantVillage dataset with transfer learning.

entry.title: A Generative AI Framework for Intelligent Utility Billing CO 2 Analytics and Sustainable Resource Optimisation

author.name: Pavan Manjunath, Thomas Pruefer

entry.summary: Proposes a generative AI framework for utility billing with natural-language statements, transformer-based consumption forecasting, and carbon accounting.

entry.title: pyforce-1.0.0: Python Framework for data-driven model Order Reduction of multi-physiCs problEms

author.name: Stefano Riva, Yantao Luo, Carolina Introini, Antonio Cammi

entry.summary: pyforce is a Python package for data-driven reduced order modeling techniques applied to multi-physics problems in nuclear engineering, rewritten using pyvista as backend.

entry.title: An Efficient Machine Learning-based Framework for Detection and Prevention of Frauds in Telecom Networks

author.name: Praveen Hegde, Mishal Shah

entry.title: Sequential Structure in Intraday Futures Data: LSTM vs Gradient Boosting on MNQ

author.name: Mathias Mesfin

entry.summary: Compares LSTM and gradient boosting for intraday directional prediction in MNQ futures, finding no configuration produces statistically significant out-of-sample accuracy, providing a useful negative result.

entry.title: Hybrid Feature Combinations with CNN for Bangla Fake News Classification

author.name: Md Gulzar Hussain, Babe Sultana, Md Rinku Ali

author.name: Benedict Florance Arockiaraj, Elizabeth Dinella, Ankit Billa, Ajay Anand

entry.title: A Feature-Driven Framework for Software Fault Prediction

author.name: Ahmad Nauman Ghazi, Nagajyothi Devarapalli, Ashir Javeed, Sadi Alawadi, Fahed Alkhabbas, Khalid AlKharabsheh

entry.title: Robust Player-Conditional Champion Ranking for League of Legends: Style Similarity, Mastery Priors, and Archetype-Constrained Discovery

author.name: Min Heo, Pranav Kadiyam, Prasun Panthi

entry.summary: Formalizes champion recommendation in League of Legends as a player-conditional ranking problem combining population strength, player-style similarity, mastery priors, and archetype guardrails.

author.name: MKA Ariyaratne, Azwirman Gusrialdi, Yury Nikulin, Jaakko Peltonen

entry.summary: Proposes a Firefly Algorithm variant for automatic clustering with centroid movement strategy and multi-objective fitness function, applied to robotic sensor networks.

entry.title: A simple approach for biometrics: Finger-knuckle prints recognition based on a Sobel filter and similarity measures

author.name: E. O. Rodrigues, T. M. Porcino, Aura Conci, Aristofanes C. Silva

entry.title: Thoughts on interviewing candidates for AI safety fellowships

author.name: beyarkay

entry.summary: Practical advice for AI safety fellowship interviewers based on the author's experience applying to and being accepted into MATS. Offers suggestions for improving the fellowship interview process.

author.name: Benedict Florance Arockiaraj, Richard Chang, Wesley Yee

entry.summary: Explores transfer learning in deep reinforcement learning for car racing environments, comparing model-based and model-free approaches for zero-shot transfer between circuits.

entry.title: From BERT to T5: A Study of Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Mei Jia

entry.summary: Compares BERT (encoder-only with classification head) and T5 (seq2seq with few-shot prompts) for NER, including ablation studies and error analysis. A technical report rather than a research contribution.

entry.title: why pollen allergies?

author.name: bhauth

entry.title: MiniGPT: Rebuilding GPT from First Principles

author.name: Jibin Joseph

entry.summary: Presents MiniGPT, a from-scratch educational implementation of GPT-style language modeling in PyTorch, trained on Tiny Shakespeare with character-level tokenization.
